==> week_3/lib/students_page.dart <==
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'registration_page.dart';
import 'services/storage_service.dart';
import 'widgets/ccs_program_stats_grid_widget.dart';
import 'widgets/student_card.dart';
import 'widgets/student_kpi_row_widget.dart';

class StudentsPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const StudentsPage({super.key, this.useMockData = false});

  final bool useMockData;

  @override
  State<StudentsPage> createState() => _StudentsPageState();
}

class _StudentsPageState extends State<StudentsPage> {
  int _selectedTabIndex = 0; // 0: Students, 1: Program Stats
  late Future<List<Student>> _studentsFuture;
  final TextEditingController _searchController = TextEditingController();
  String _searchQuery = '';

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _studentsFuture = _loadStudents();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant StudentsPage oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<List<Student>> _loadStudents() => StorageService.getStudents();

  Future<void> _openAddStudent() async {
    await Navigator.push<void>(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const RegistrationPage()),
    );
    if (mounted) await _refresh();
  }

  Future<void> _refresh() async {
    setState(() => _studentsFuture = _loadStudents());
    await _studentsFuture;
  }

  void _openEditStudent(Student student) async {
    await Navigator.push<void>(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => RegistrationPage(student: student)),
    );
    _refresh();
  }

  void _showFilterSheet() {
    showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      showDragHandle: true,
      builder: (context) => SafeArea(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 8, 20, 24),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              const Text(
                'Filter Students',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              ListTile(
                leading: const Icon(
                  Icons.people_outline,
                  color: Color(0xFF800000),
                ),
                title: const Text('All Tracks'),
                onTap: () {
                  setState(() => _searchQuery = '');
                  _searchController.clear();
                  Navigator.pop(context);
                },
              ),
              ListTile(
                leading: const Icon(Icons.security, color: Color(0xFF800000)),
                title: const Text('BSIT-NS (Network & Security)'),
                onTap: () {
                  setState(() => _searchQuery = 'BSIT-NS');
                  _searchController.text = 'BSIT-NS';
                  Navigator.pop(context);
                },
              ),
              ListTile(
                leading: const Icon(Icons.devices, color: Color(0xFF800000)),
                title: const Text('BSIT-WM (Web & Mobile)'),
                onTap: () {
                  setState(() => _searchQuery = 'BSIT-WM');
                  _searchController.text = 'BSIT-WM';
                  Navigator.pop(context);
                },
              ),
              ListTile(
                leading: const Icon(
                  Icons.query_stats,
                  color: Color(0xFF800000),
                ),
                title: const Text('BSCS-DS (Data Science)'),
                onTap: () {
                  setState(() => _searchQuery = 'BSCS-DS');
                  _searchController.text = 'BSCS-DS';
                  Navigator.pop(context);
                },
              ),
              ListTile(
                leading: const Icon(Icons.code, color: Color(0xFF800000)),
                title: const Text('BSCS-SE (Software Engineering)'),
                onTap: () {
                  setState(() => _searchQuery = 'BSCS-SE');
                  _searchController.text = 'BSCS-SE';
                  Navigator.pop(context);
                },
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSegmentedToggle() {
    const maroonColor = Color(0xFF800000);
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final toggleBg = isDark ? const Color(0xFF262626) : const Color(0xFFE8E8EC);
    final selectedColor = isDark ? const Color(0xFFE0B0B0) : maroonColor;
    final inactiveTextColor = Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant;

    return Container(
      height: 38,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: toggleBg,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
      ),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(3),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Expanded(
            child: GestureDetector(
              onTap: () => setState(() => _selectedTabIndex = 0),
              child: AnimatedContainer(
                duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: _selectedTabIndex == 0
                      ? selectedColor
                      : Colors.transparent,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                ),
                alignment: Alignment.center,
                child: Text(
                  'Students',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontFamily: 'Inter',
                    fontSize: 13,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    color: _selectedTabIndex == 0
                        ? (isDark ? const Color(0xFF171717) : Colors.white)
                        : inactiveTextColor,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          Expanded(
            child: GestureDetector(
              onTap: () => setState(() => _selectedTabIndex = 1),
              child: AnimatedContainer(
                duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: _selectedTabIndex == 1
                      ? selectedColor
                      : Colors.transparent,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                ),
                alignment: Alignment.center,
                child: Text(
                  'Program Stats',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontFamily: 'Inter',
                    fontSize: 13,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    color: _selectedTabIndex == 1
                        ? (isDark ? const Color(0xFF171717) : Colors.white)
                        : inactiveTextColor,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSearchBar() {
    final cardColor = Theme.of(context).cardColor;
    final borderColor = Theme.of(context).dividerColor;
    return Row(
      children: [
        Expanded(
          child: Container(
            height: 44,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: cardColor,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              border: Border.all(color: borderColor),
            ),
            child: TextField(
              controller: _searchController,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontFamily: 'Inter',
                fontSize: 14,
                color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurface,
              ),
              onChanged: (val) => setState(() => _searchQuery = val.trim()),
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                hintText: 'Search students...',
                hintStyle: TextStyle(
                  fontFamily: 'Inter',
                  color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                  fontSize: 14,
                ),
                prefixIcon: Icon(
                  Icons.search,
                  color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                  size: 20,
                ),
                contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                  vertical: 10,
                  horizontal: 12,
                ),
                border: InputBorder.none,
                enabledBorder: InputBorder.none,
                focusedBorder: InputBorder.none,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 10),
        Container(
          height: 44,
          width: 44,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: cardColor,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            border: Border.all(color: borderColor),
          ),
          child: IconButton(
            icon: Icon(
              Icons.tune,
              color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
              size: 20,
            ),
            onPressed: _showFilterSheet,
            tooltip: 'Filter',
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildStudentsView(List<Student> students) {
    final filtered = students.where((s) {
      if (_searchQuery.isEmpty) return true;
      final q = _searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      return s.name.toLowerCase().contains(q) ||
          s.id.toLowerCase().contains(q) ||
          s.program.toLowerCase().contains(q) ||
          s.email.toLowerCase().contains(q);
    }).toList();

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        StudentKpiRowWidget(
          totalStudents: students.length,
          activeStudents: students
              .where((student) => student.status.toLowerCase() == 'active')
              .length,
          avgAttendance: students.isEmpty
              ? '0%'
              : '${(students.fold<double>(0, (sum, student) => sum + student.attendance) / students.length * 100).round()}%',
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 16),
        Row(
          children: [
            Expanded(
              child: Text(
                'Student List',
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 16,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurface,
                ),
              ),
            ),
            FilledButton.tonalIcon(
              onPressed: _openAddStudent,
              icon: const Icon(Icons.person_add_alt_1, size: 18),
              label: const Text('Add Student'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 10),
        _buildSearchBar(),
        const SizedBox(height: 14),
        if (filtered.isEmpty)
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: Theme.of(context).cardColor,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              border: Border.all(color: Theme.of(context).dividerColor),
            ),
            child: Center(
              child: Column(
                children: [
                  Icon(
                    Icons.person_search_outlined,
                    size: 40,
                    color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Text(
                    'No student records found',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontFamily: 'Inter',
                      color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          )
        else
          for (final student in filtered)
            StudentCard(
              student: student,
              onTap: () => _openEditStudent(student),
            ),
      ],
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      body: SafeArea(
        child: RefreshIndicator(
          onRefresh: _refresh,
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 14),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                _buildSegmentedToggle(),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                if (_selectedTabIndex == 1)
                  CcsProgramStatsGridWidget(
                    onProgramSelected: (programCode) {
                      setState(() {
                        _selectedTabIndex = 0;
                        _searchQuery = programCode;
                        _searchController.text = programCode;
                      });
                    },
                  )
                else
                  FutureBuilder<List<Student>>(
                    future: _studentsFuture,
                    builder: (context, snapshot) {
                      if (snapshot.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting) {
                        return const Center(
                          child: Padding(
                            padding: EdgeInsets.all(40),
                            child: CircularProgressIndicator(),
                          ),
                        );
                      }
                      if (snapshot.hasError) {
                        return Container(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: Theme.of(context).cardColor,
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                            border: Border.all(
                              color: Theme.of(context).dividerColor,
                            ),
                          ),
                          child: Text(
                            'Error loading students: ${snapshot.error}',
                          ),
                        );
                      }
                      final students = snapshot.data ?? [];
                      return _buildStudentsView(students);
                    },
                  ),
                const SizedBox(height: 20),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

==> week_3/lib/files_page.dart <==
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'services/file_service.dart';

class FilesPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const FilesPage({super.key});

  @override
  State<FilesPage> createState() => _FilesPageState();
}

class _FilesPageState extends State<FilesPage> {
  late Future<String> _fileContent;
  late Future<String> _filePath;
  bool _exporting = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadFile();
  }

  void _loadFile() {
    _fileContent = FileService.readExportedFile();
    _filePath = FileService.getFilePath();
  }

  Future<void> _exportFile() async {
    setState(() => _exporting = true);

    try {
      await FileService.exportStudents();

      if (!mounted) return;

      setState(_loadFile);

      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text(
            'Exported all records to ${await FileService.getFilePath()}',
          ),
        ),
      );
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;

      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
          .showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Export failed: $error')));
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _exporting = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return ListView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      children: [
        const Text(
          'Generated Files',
          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 26, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 6),
        Text(
          'Export and view your saved student records.',
          style: TextStyle(
            color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 20),

        Card(
          child: ListTile(
            leading: const CircleAvatar(
              child: Icon(Icons.description_outlined),
            ),
            title: const Text('student_info.txt'),
            subtitle: const Text(
              'All registered student records as plain text',
            ),
            trailing: const Icon(Icons.insert_drive_file_outlined),
          ),
        ),

        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        FilledButton.icon(
          onPressed: _exporting ? null : _exportFile,
          icon: const Icon(Icons.file_download_outlined),
          label: Text(
            _exporting ? 'Exporting...' : 'Export Student Information',
          ),
        ),

        const SizedBox(height: 20),
        const Text(
          'File Location',
          style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 18),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        FutureBuilder<String>(
          future: _filePath,
          builder: (context, snapshot) {
            return Card(
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                child: SelectableText(
                  snapshot.data ?? 'Loading file location...',
                ),
              ),
            );
          },
        ),

        const SizedBox(height: 20),
        const Text(
          'File Contents',
          style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 18),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        FutureBuilder<String>(
          future: _fileContent,
          builder: (context, snapshot) {
            if (snapshot.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting) {
              return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
            }

            if (snapshot.hasError) {
              return const Text('Unable to read the generated file.');
            }

            return Card(
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                child: SelectableText(
                  snapshot.data ?? 'No file contents available.',
                ),
              ),
            );
          },
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 24),
      ],
    );
  }
}

==> week_3/lib/services/storage_service.dart <==
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

class Student {
  final String name;
  final String id;
  final String email;
  final String program;
  final String yearLevel;
  final String contact;
  final String address;
  final String status;
  final double attendance;

  const Student({
    required this.name,
    required this.id,
    required this.email,
    required this.program,
    required this.yearLevel,
    this.contact = '',
    this.address = '',
    this.status = 'Active',
    this.attendance = 0.95,
  });

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
    'name': name,
    'id': id,
    'email': email,
    'program': program,
    'yearLevel': yearLevel,
    'contact': contact,
    'address': address,
    'status': status,
    'attendance': attendance,
  };

  factory Student.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    return Student(
      name: json['name'] ?? '',
      id: json['id'] ?? '',
      email: json['email'] ?? '',
      program: json['program'] ?? '',
      yearLevel: json['yearLevel'] ?? '',
      contact: json['contact'] ?? '',
      address: json['address'] ?? '',
      status: json['status'] ?? 'Active',
      attendance: (json['attendance'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.95,
    );
  }
}

class RecentActivity {
  final String title;
  final String detail;
  final DateTime timestamp;

  const RecentActivity({
    required this.title,
    required this.detail,
    required this.timestamp,
  });

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
    'title': title,
    'detail': detail,
    'timestamp': timestamp.toIso8601String(),
  };

  factory RecentActivity.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) => RecentActivity(
    title: json['title'] as String? ?? 'Activity',
    detail: json['detail'] as String? ?? '',
    timestamp:
        DateTime.tryParse(json['timestamp'] as String? ?? '') ?? DateTime.now(),
  );
}

class StorageService {
  static const String _key = 'lpu_students';
  static const String _profileKey = 'lpu_student_profile';
  static const String _activityKey = 'lpu_recent_activity';

  static Student? selectProfileStudent(Iterable<Student> students) {
    return students
            .where((student) => student.name.toLowerCase().contains('novy'))
            .firstOrNull ??
        students.firstOrNull;
  }

  static Future<List<RecentActivity>> getRecentActivity() async {
    final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final raw = preferences.getString(_activityKey);
    if (raw == null) {
      return [
        RecentActivity(
          title: 'Logged in to portal',
          detail: 'Cavite Campus Network',
          timestamp: DateTime.now().subtract(const Duration(minutes: 5)),
        ),
      ];
    }
    final decoded = jsonDecode(raw);
    if (decoded is! List) {
      throw const FormatException('Activity data must be a JSON list.');
    }
    final list = decoded
        .whereType<Map>()
        .map((item) => RecentActivity.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic>.from(item)))
        .toList();
    if (list.isEmpty) {
      return [
        RecentActivity(
          title: 'Logged in to portal',
          detail: 'Cavite Campus Network',
          timestamp: DateTime.now().subtract(const Duration(minutes: 5)),
        ),
      ];
    }
    return list;
  }

  static Future<void> recordActivity(String title, String detail) async {
    final activities = await getRecentActivity();
    activities.insert(
      0,
      RecentActivity(title: title, detail: detail, timestamp: DateTime.now()),
    );
    final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await preferences.setString(
      _activityKey,
      jsonEncode(activities.take(10).map((item) => item.toJson()).toList()),
    );
  }


  static Future<List<Student>> getStudents() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final raw = prefs.getString(_key);

    if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty) {
      return <Student>[];
    }

    final decoded = jsonDecode(raw);

    if (decoded is! List) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'Student data must be a JSON list.',
      );
    }

    return decoded
        .whereType<Map>()
        .map(
          (item) => Student.fromJson(
        Map<String, dynamic>.from(item),
      ),
    )
        .toList();
  }

  /// Returns the seeded student records separately.
  /// These records must never be written into the custom student list.
  static List<Student> getMockStudents() {
    return List<Student>.from(defaultStudents);
  }


  static Future<Student?> getProfile() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final raw = prefs.getString(_profileKey);
    if (raw != null) {
      final decoded = jsonDecode(raw);
      if (decoded is Map) {
        return Student.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic>.from(decoded));
      }
    }

    final existingProfile = selectProfileStudent(await getStudents());
    if (existingProfile != null) {
      await prefs.setString(_profileKey, jsonEncode(existingProfile.toJson()));
    }
    return existingProfile;
  }

  static Future<void> saveProfile(Student student) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final saved = await prefs.setString(
      _profileKey,
      jsonEncode(student.toJson()),
    );
    if (!saved) throw StateError('The profile could not be saved locally.');
    await recordActivity('Profile updated', student.name);
  }

  static Future<void> saveStudent(Student student) async {
    final students = await getStudents();

    final duplicate = students.any((existing) => existing.id == student.id);

    if (duplicate) {
      throw Exception('A student with this ID is already registered.');
    }

    students.add(student);

    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setString(
      _key,
      jsonEncode(students.map((s) => s.toJson()).toList()),
    );
    await recordActivity('Student registered', student.name);
  }

  static Future<void> updateStudent(String existingId, Student student) async {
    final students = await getStudents();
    final existingIndex = students.indexWhere(
      (existing) => existing.id == existingId,
    );
    if (existingIndex < 0) {
      throw Exception('The student record could not be found.');
    }
    final duplicate = students.any(
      (existing) => existing.id == student.id && existing.id != existingId,
    );
    if (duplicate) {
      throw Exception('A student with this ID is already registered.');
    }
    students[existingIndex] = student;

    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setString(
      _key,
      jsonEncode(students.map((item) => item.toJson()).toList()),
    );
    await recordActivity('Student profile updated', student.name);
  }

  static Future<void> deleteStudent(String id) async {
    final students = await getStudents();
    students.removeWhere((student) => student.id == id);

    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setString(
      _key,
      jsonEncode(students.map((s) => s.toJson()).toList()),
    );
    await recordActivity('Student record deleted', id);
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:connectivity_plus/connectivity_plus.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

import 'storage_service.dart';

/// Shared JSONPlaceholder source used by the student and faculty directories.
class PortalDataService {
  static const _usersCacheKey = 'jsonplaceholder_users_cache';
  static Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>>? _inFlightUsersRequest;

  // JSONPlaceholder-compatible offline snapshot for first launch without a
  // connection. Successful API responses replace this with a full cache.
  static const List<Map<String, dynamic>> _offlineUsers = [
    {
      'id': 1,
      'name': 'Leanne Graham',
      'email': 'Sincere@april.biz',
      'phone': '1-770-736-8031 x56442',
      'address': {'city': 'Gwenborough'},
      'company': {'name': 'Romaguera-Crona'},
    },
    {
      'id': 2,
      'name': 'Ervin Howell',
      'email': 'Shanna@melissa.tv',
      'phone': '010-692-6593 x09125',
      'address': {'city': 'Wisokyburgh'},
      'company': {'name': 'Deckow-Crist'},
    },
    {
      'id': 3,
      'name': 'Clementine Bauch',
      'email': 'Nathan@yesenia.net',
      'phone': '1-463-123-4447',
      'address': {'city': 'McKenziehaven'},
      'company': {'name': 'Romaguera-Jacobson'},
    },
    {
      'id': 4,
      'name': 'Patricia Lebsack',
      'email': 'Julianne.OConner@kory.org',
      'phone': '493-170-9623 x156',
      'address': {'city': 'South Elvis'},
      'company': {'name': 'Robel-Corkery'},
    },
  ];

  static Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> fetchUsers() {
    final currentRequest = _inFlightUsersRequest;
    if (currentRequest != null) return currentRequest;

    final request = _loadUsers();
    _inFlightUsersRequest = request;
    return request.whenComplete(() {
      if (identical(_inFlightUsersRequest, request)) {
        _inFlightUsersRequest = null;
      }
    });
  }

  /// Allows a fresh read from the cache as soon as connectivity changes, even
  /// if a request that started while online is still waiting on a timeout.
  static void resetInFlightRequest() {
    _inFlightUsersRequest = null;
  }

  static Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> _loadUsers() async {
    try {
      final connectivity = await Connectivity().checkConnectivity();
      final hasNetwork = connectivity.any(
        (result) => result != ConnectivityResult.none,
      );
      if (!hasNetwork) return await _getCachedOrBundledUsers();

      final response = await http
          .get(
            Uri.https('jsonplaceholder.typicode.com', '/users'),
            headers: const {'Accept': 'application/json'},
          )
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 8));
      if (response.statusCode != 200) {
        throw Exception(
          'JSONPlaceholder returned HTTP ${response.statusCode}.',
        );
      }
      final users = _decodeUsers(response.body);
      if (users.isEmpty) {
        throw const FormatException('JSONPlaceholder returned no users.');
      }
      try {
        final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
        await preferences.setString(_usersCacheKey, jsonEncode(users));
      } catch (_) {
        // Keep the live response if local caching is unavailable.
      }
      return users;
    } catch (_) {
      return _getCachedOrBundledUsers();
    }
  }

  static Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> _getCachedOrBundledUsers() async {
    try {
      final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final cached = preferences.getString(_usersCacheKey);
      if (cached != null) {
        final users = _decodeUsers(cached);
        if (users.isNotEmpty) return users;
      }
    } catch (_) {
      // Use the bundled snapshot if preferences are unavailable.
    }
    return _offlineUsers
        .map((user) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(user))
        .toList();
  }

  static List<Map<String, dynamic>> _decodeUsers(String body) {
    final decoded = jsonDecode(body);
    if (decoded is! List) {
      throw const FormatException('JSONPlaceholder users response is invalid.');
    }
    return decoded
        .whereType<Map>()
        .map((item) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(item))
        .toList();
  }

  static Student toStudent(Map<String, dynamic> user, int index) {
    final id = (user['id'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? index + 1;
    final address = user['address'] is Map
        ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(user['address'] as Map)
        : <String, dynamic>{};
    const programs = ['BSIT-WM', 'BSIT-NS', 'BSCS-DS', 'BSCS-SE'];
    return Student(
      name: user['name'] as String? ?? 'Student $id',
      id: 'JP-${id.toString().padLeft(4, '0')}',
      email: user['email'] as String? ?? 'student$id@example.test',
      program: programs[(id - 1) % programs.length],
      yearLevel: '${(id - 1) % 4 + 1}${_ordinal((id - 1) % 4 + 1)} Year',
      contact: user['phone'] as String? ?? '',
      address: address['city'] as String? ?? '',
      attendance: 0.80 + ((id * 7) % 20) / 100,
    );
  }

  static String _ordinal(int number) {
    if (number == 1) return 'st';
    if (number == 2) return 'nd';
    if (number == 3) return 'rd';
    return 'th';
  }
}

==> week_3/lib/services/file_service.dart <==
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:path_provider/path_provider.dart';

import 'storage_service.dart';

class FileService {
  static const _fileName = 'student_info.txt';

  /// Required app Documents copy, accessible through Android Studio's
  /// Device File Explorer.
  static Future<Directory> _internalExportDirectory() async {
    final directory = await getApplicationDocumentsDirectory();
    await directory.create(recursive: true);
    return directory;
  }

  static Future<File> _writeAndVerify(String content) async {
    final directory = await _internalExportDirectory();
    final file = File('${directory.path}/$_fileName');
    await file.writeAsString(content, flush: true);
    if (!await file.exists() || await file.length() == 0) {
      throw FileSystemException(
        'Export file was not written successfully',
        file.path,
      );
    }
    if (await file.readAsString() != content) {
      throw FileSystemException('Export file verification failed', file.path);
    }
    return file;
  }

  static Future<String> _reportContents() async {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final timestamp =
        '${now.year}-${now.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${now.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')} '
        '${now.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:${now.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:${now.second.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';

    final students = await StorageService.getStudents();
    final records = students.isEmpty
        ? 'No student records.'
        : students
              .map(
                (student) => [
                  'Name: ${student.name}',
                  'ID: ${student.id}',
                  'Program: ${student.program}',
                  'Year: ${student.yearLevel}',
                  'Email: ${student.email}',
                  if (student.contact.isNotEmpty) 'Contact: ${student.contact}',
                  if (student.address.isNotEmpty) 'Address: ${student.address}',
                  'Status: ${student.status}',
                  'Attendance: ${(student.attendance * 100).round()}%',
                ].join('\n'),
              )
              .join('\n\n');

    return 'STUDENT INFORMATION\n'
        'Generated: $timestamp\n'
        'Student count: ${students.length}\n\n'
        '$records\n';
  }

  static Future<File> exportStudents() async {
    final content = await _reportContents();
    final file = await _writeAndVerify(content);
    try {
      await StorageService.recordActivity(
        'Student records exported',
        'Saved to app-private Documents storage',
      );
    } catch (_) {
      // A history-write failure does not invalidate the saved file.
    }
    return file;
  }

  static Future<File?> _existingExport() async {
    final directory = await _internalExportDirectory();
    final file = File('${directory.path}/$_fileName');
    return await file.exists() ? file : null;
  }

  static Future<String> readExportedFile() async {
    final file = await _existingExport();
    if (file == null) {
      return 'No exported file yet.\n\nTap Export Student Records to create one.';
    }
    return file.readAsString();
  }

  static Future<String> getFilePath() async {
    final directory = await _internalExportDirectory();
    return '${directory.path}/$_fileName';
  }
}

==> week_3/lib/services/public_holiday_service.dart <==
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

class PublicHoliday {
  const PublicHoliday({required this.date, required this.name});

  final DateTime date;
  final String name;

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {'date': _dateKey(date), 'name': name};

  factory PublicHoliday.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) => PublicHoliday(
    date: DateTime.parse(json['date'] as String),
    name: json['name'] as String? ?? 'Public holiday',
  );

  static String _dateKey(DateTime value) =>
      '${value.year.toString().padLeft(4, '0')}-'
      '${value.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-'
      '${value.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
}

class HolidayCalendarData {
  const HolidayCalendarData({
    required this.holidays,
    required this.isOffline,
    required this.year,
  });

  final List<PublicHoliday> holidays;
  final bool isOffline;
  final int year;
}

class PublicHolidayService {
  static String _cacheKey(int year) => 'nager_ph_holidays_$year';

  static Future<HolidayCalendarData> fetch({required int year}) async {
    SharedPreferences? preferences;
    try {
      preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final response = await http
          .get(
            Uri.https('date.nager.at', '/api/v3/PublicHolidays/$year/PH'),
            headers: const {'Accept': 'application/json'},
          )
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 12));
      if (response.statusCode != 200) {
        throw Exception('Nager.Date returned HTTP ${response.statusCode}.');
      }

      final decoded = jsonDecode(response.body);
      if (decoded is! List) {
        throw const FormatException('Invalid Nager.Date response.');
      }
      final holidays =
          decoded
              .whereType<Map>()
              .map((entry) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(entry))
              .map((entry) {
                final date = DateTime.tryParse(entry['date'] as String? ?? '');
                final name =
                    entry['localName'] as String? ??
                    entry['name'] as String? ??
                    'Public holiday';
                if (date == null) return null;
                return PublicHoliday(
                  date: DateTime(date.year, date.month, date.day),
                  name: name,
                );
              })
              .whereType<PublicHoliday>()
              .toList()
            ..sort((first, second) => first.date.compareTo(second.date));

      try {
        await preferences.setString(
          _cacheKey(year),
          jsonEncode(holidays.map((holiday) => holiday.toJson()).toList()),
        );
      } catch (_) {
        // A cache write failure does not invalidate fresh API data.
      }
      return HolidayCalendarData(
        holidays: holidays,
        isOffline: false,
        year: year,
      );
    } catch (_) {
      final cached = preferences?.getString(_cacheKey(year));
      if (cached != null) {
        try {
          final decoded = jsonDecode(cached);
          if (decoded is List) {
            final holidays = decoded
                .whereType<Map>()
                .map(
                  (entry) =>
                      PublicHoliday.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic>.from(entry)),
                )
                .toList();
            return HolidayCalendarData(
              holidays: holidays,
              isOffline: true,
              year: year,
            );
          }
        } catch (_) {
          // An invalid cache is treated like an empty offline result.
        }
      }
      return HolidayCalendarData(
        holidays: const [],
        isOffline: true,
        year: year,
      );
    }
  }
}

==> week_3/lib/services/app_preferences.dart <==
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:math';
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:crypto/crypto.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

class AppPreferences extends ChangeNotifier {
  static const _darkModeKey = 'dark_mode';
  static const _mockDataKey = 'mock_data';
  static const _profilePhotoKey = 'profile_photo';
  static const _rememberMeKey = 'remember_me';
  static const _savedUserIdKey = 'saved_user_id';
  static const _savedPasswordKey = 'saved_password';
  static const _authAccountsKey = 'auth_accounts_v1';
  static const _activeSessionEmailKey = 'active_session_email';

  ThemeMode _themeMode = ThemeMode.light;
  bool _useMockData = false;
  bool _rememberMe = false;
  String _savedUserId = '';
  String _savedPassword = '';
  Map<String, dynamic> _authAccounts = {};
  String? _activeUserEmail;
  String? _activeUserName;
  String? _profilePhotoBase64;

  ThemeMode get themeMode => _themeMode;
  bool get isDarkMode => _themeMode == ThemeMode.dark;
  bool get useMockData => _useMockData;
  bool get rememberMe => _rememberMe;
  String get savedUserId => _savedUserId;
  String get savedPassword => _savedPassword;
  bool get hasActiveSession => _activeUserEmail != null;
  String? get activeUserEmail => _activeUserEmail;
  String? get activeUserName => _activeUserName;
  String? get profilePhotoBase64 => _profilePhotoBase64;

  Uint8List? get profilePhotoBytes {
    final encoded = _profilePhotoBase64;
    if (encoded == null) return null;
    try {
      return base64Decode(encoded);
    } on FormatException {
      return null;
    }
  }

  Future<void> load() async {
    final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final isDark = preferences.getBool(_darkModeKey) ?? false;
    _themeMode = isDark ? ThemeMode.dark : ThemeMode.light;
    _useMockData = preferences.getBool(_mockDataKey) ?? false;
    _rememberMe = preferences.getBool(_rememberMeKey) ?? false;
    _savedUserId = _rememberMe
        ? preferences.getString(_savedUserIdKey) ?? ''
        : '';
    _savedPassword = _rememberMe
        ? preferences.getString(_savedPasswordKey) ?? ''
        : '';
    final accountsJson = preferences.getString(_authAccountsKey);
    if (accountsJson != null) {
      try {
        final decoded = jsonDecode(accountsJson);
        if (decoded is Map) {
          _authAccounts = Map<String, dynamic>.from(decoded);
        }
      } on FormatException {
        _authAccounts = {};
      }
    }
    final sessionEmail = preferences.getString(_activeSessionEmailKey);
    final session = sessionEmail == null ? null : _authAccounts[sessionEmail];
    if (session is Map) {
      _activeUserEmail = sessionEmail;
      _activeUserName = session['name'] as String?;
    } else {
      await preferences.remove(_activeSessionEmailKey);
      _activeUserEmail = null;
      _activeUserName = null;
    }
    _profilePhotoBase64 = preferences.getString(_profilePhotoKey);
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> createLocalAccount({
    required String name,
    required String email,
    required String password,
  }) async {
    final cleanName = name.trim();
    final cleanEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (cleanName.isEmpty) {
      throw const FormatException('Full name is required.');
    }
    if (!_isInstitutionalEmail(cleanEmail)) {
      throw const FormatException('Use your @lpunetwork.edu.ph email.');
    }
    if (password.length < 8) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'Password must contain at least 8 characters.',
      );
    }
    if (_authAccounts.containsKey(cleanEmail)) {
      throw StateError('An account with this email already exists.');
    }

    final random = Random.secure();
    final salt = List.generate(
      16,
      (_) => random.nextInt(256),
    ).map((byte) => byte.toRadixString(16).padLeft(2, '0')).join();
    _authAccounts[cleanEmail] = {
      'name': cleanName,
      'salt': salt,
      'passwordHash': _passwordHash(salt, password),
    };
    await _persistAccountsAndSession(cleanEmail);
  }

  Future<void> authenticateLocalAccount({
    required String email,
    required String password,
  }) async {
    final cleanEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!_isInstitutionalEmail(cleanEmail)) {
      throw const FormatException('Use your @lpunetwork.edu.ph email.');
    }
    if (password.isEmpty) throw const FormatException('Password is required.');
    final account = _authAccounts[cleanEmail];
    if (account is! Map) {
      throw StateError(
        'No local account was found for this email. Sign up first.',
      );
    }
    final salt = account['salt'] as String? ?? '';
    final expected = account['passwordHash'] as String? ?? '';
    final actual = _passwordHash(salt, password);
    if (!_constantTimeEquals(expected, actual)) {
      throw StateError('The email or password is incorrect.');
    }
    await _persistAccountsAndSession(cleanEmail);
  }

  Future<void> logout() async {
    final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await preferences.remove(_activeSessionEmailKey);
    _activeUserEmail = null;
    _activeUserName = null;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  bool _isInstitutionalEmail(String email) => RegExp(
    r'^[^\s@]+@lpunetwork\.edu\.ph$',
    caseSensitive: false,
  ).hasMatch(email);

  String _passwordHash(String salt, String password) =>
      sha256.convert(utf8.encode('$salt:$password')).toString();

  bool _constantTimeEquals(String first, String second) {
    if (first.length != second.length) return false;
    var difference = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < first.length; i++) {
      difference |= first.codeUnitAt(i) ^ second.codeUnitAt(i);
    }
    return difference == 0;
  }

  Future<void> _persistAccountsAndSession(String email) async {
    final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final accountsSaved = await preferences.setString(
      _authAccountsKey,
      jsonEncode(_authAccounts),
    );
    final sessionSaved = await preferences.setString(
      _activeSessionEmailKey,
      email,
    );
    if (!accountsSaved || !sessionSaved) {
      throw StateError('The account session could not be saved locally.');
    }
    final account = _authAccounts[email] as Map;
    _activeUserEmail = email;
    _activeUserName = account['name'] as String?;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> setProfilePhoto(Uint8List? bytes) async {
    final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    if (bytes == null) {
      await preferences.remove(_profilePhotoKey);
      _profilePhotoBase64 = null;
    } else {
      final encoded = base64Encode(bytes);
      final saved = await preferences.setString(_profilePhotoKey, encoded);
      if (!saved) {
        throw StateError('The profile photo could not be saved locally.');
      }
      _profilePhotoBase64 = encoded;
    }
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> setDarkMode(bool enabled) async {
    final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await preferences.setBool(_darkModeKey, enabled);
    _themeMode = enabled ? ThemeMode.dark : ThemeMode.light;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> setRememberMe(
    bool enabled,
    String userId,
    String password,
  ) async {
    final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await preferences.setBool(_rememberMeKey, enabled);
    if (enabled && userId.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      await preferences.setString(_savedUserIdKey, userId.trim());
    } else {
      await preferences.remove(_savedUserIdKey);
      await preferences.remove(_savedPasswordKey);
    }
    if (enabled && userId.trim().isNotEmpty && password.isNotEmpty) {
      await preferences.setString(_savedPasswordKey, password);
    }
    _rememberMe = enabled;
    _savedUserId = enabled ? userId.trim() : '';
    _savedPassword = enabled ? password : '';
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> setUseMockData(bool enabled) async {
    _useMockData = enabled;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await preferences.setBool(_mockDataKey, enabled);
    } catch (error) {
      debugPrint('Could not persist mock data preference: $error');
    }
  }

  Future<void> clearLocalStorage() async {
    final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await preferences.clear();
    _themeMode = ThemeMode.light;
    _useMockData = false;
    _profilePhotoBase64 = null;
    _rememberMe = false;
    _savedUserId = '';
    _savedPassword = '';
    _authAccounts = {};
    _activeUserEmail = null;
    _activeUserName = null;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

==> week_3/lib/auth_page.dart <==
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'services/app_preferences.dart';
import 'theme/app_theme.dart';

class AuthPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const AuthPage({super.key, required this.preferences});

  final AppPreferences preferences;

  @override
  State<AuthPage> createState() => _AuthPageState();
}

class _AuthPageState extends State<AuthPage> {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final _nameController = TextEditingController();
  final _emailController = TextEditingController();
  final _passwordController = TextEditingController();
  final _confirmController = TextEditingController();
  bool _isSignup = false;
  bool _obscurePassword = true;
  bool _isLoading = false;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _nameController.dispose();
    _emailController.dispose();
    _passwordController.dispose();
    _confirmController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _switchMode(bool signup) {
    setState(() {
      _isSignup = signup;
      _formKey.currentState?.reset();
      _nameController.clear();
      _passwordController.clear();
      _confirmController.clear();
    });
  }

  String? _validateEmail(String? value) {
    final email = value?.trim() ?? '';
    if (email.isEmpty) return 'Institutional email is required.';
    if (!RegExp(
      r'^[^\s@]+@lpunetwork\.edu\.ph$',
      caseSensitive: false,
    ).hasMatch(email)) {
      return 'Use your @lpunetwork.edu.ph email.';
    }
    return null;
  }

  String? _validateName(String? value) {
    if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty) return 'Full name is required.';
    return null;
  }

  String? _validatePassword(String? value) {
    if (value == null || value.isEmpty) return 'Password is required.';
    if (_isSignup && value.length < 8) {
      return 'Use at least 8 characters.';
    }
    return null;
  }

  Future<void> _submit() async {
    final form = _formKey.currentState;
    if (form == null || !form.validate()) return;
    setState(() => _isLoading = true);
    try {
      if (_isSignup) {
        await widget.preferences.createLocalAccount(
          name: _nameController.text,
          email: _emailController.text,
          password: _passwordController.text,
        );
      } else {
        await widget.preferences.authenticateLocalAccount(
          email: _emailController.text,
          password: _passwordController.text,
        );
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      final message = error
          .toString()
          .replaceFirst('StateError: ', '')
          .replaceFirst('FormatException: ', '');
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
          .showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(message)));
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoading = false);
    }
  }

  Widget _requiredLabel(String label) => RichText(
    text: TextSpan(
      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.labelLarge,
      children: [
        TextSpan(text: label),
        const TextSpan(
          text: ' *',
          style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFFD32F2F)),
        ),
      ],
    ),
  );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
    body: SafeArea(
      child: Center(
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 24, 20, 28),
          child: ConstrainedBox(
            constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 364),
            child: AutofillGroup(
              child: Form(
                key: _formKey,
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: [
                    Image.asset(
                      'assets/img/lpu-logo.png',
                      width: 60,
                      height: 60,
                      errorBuilder: (_, _, _) => const Icon(
                        Icons.school_outlined,
                        size: 54,
                        color: AppTokens.maroonPrimary,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    Text(
                      _isSignup ? 'Create your account' : 'Welcome back',
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall
                          ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    Text(
                      _isSignup
                          ? 'Sign up with your LPU-Cavite student email.'
                          : 'Log in to continue to your student portal.',
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                        color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 26),
                    if (_isSignup) ...[
                      _requiredLabel('Full name'),
                      const SizedBox(height: 6),
                      TextFormField(
                        controller: _nameController,
                        textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.words,
                        autofillHints: const [AutofillHints.name],
                        textInputAction: TextInputAction.next,
                        validator: _validateName,
                        decoration: const InputDecoration(
                          hintText: 'Enter your full name',
                          prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.person_outline),
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 15),
                    ],
                    _requiredLabel('Institutional email'),
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    TextFormField(
                      controller: _emailController,
                      keyboardType: TextInputType.emailAddress,
                      textInputAction: TextInputAction.next,
                      autofillHints: const [AutofillHints.username],
                      autocorrect: false,
                      validator: _validateEmail,
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(
                        hintText: 'name@lpunetwork.edu.ph',
                        prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.alternate_email),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 15),
                    _requiredLabel('Password'),
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    TextFormField(
                      controller: _passwordController,
                      obscureText: _obscurePassword,
                      textInputAction: _isSignup
                          ? TextInputAction.next
                          : TextInputAction.done,
                      autofillHints: [
                        _isSignup
                            ? AutofillHints.newPassword
                            : AutofillHints.password,
                      ],
                      autocorrect: false,
                      enableSuggestions: false,
                      validator: _validatePassword,
                      decoration: InputDecoration(
                        hintText: 'Enter your password',
                        prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.lock_outline),
                        suffixIcon: IconButton(
                          tooltip: _obscurePassword
                              ? 'Show password'
                              : 'Hide password',
                          onPressed: () => setState(
                            () => _obscurePassword = !_obscurePassword,
                          ),
                          icon: Icon(
                            _obscurePassword
                                ? Icons.visibility_outlined
                                : Icons.visibility_off_outlined,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (_isSignup) ...[
                      const SizedBox(height: 15),
                      _requiredLabel('Confirm password'),
                      const SizedBox(height: 6),
                      TextFormField(
                        controller: _confirmController,
                        obscureText: _obscurePassword,
                        autofillHints: const [AutofillHints.newPassword],
                        textInputAction: TextInputAction.done,
                        validator: (value) {
                          if (value == null || value.isEmpty) {
                            return 'Confirm password is required.';
                          }
                          if (value != _passwordController.text) {
                            return 'Passwords do not match.';
                          }
                          return null;
                        },
                        decoration: const InputDecoration(
                          hintText: 'Re-enter your password',
                          prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.lock_outline),
                        ),
                        onFieldSubmitted: (_) => _submit(),
                      ),
                    ] else ...[
                      const SizedBox(height: 8),
                      Align(
                        alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
                        child: Text(
                          'Local account sign-in',
                          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall
                              ?.copyWith(
                                color: Theme.of(context)
                                    .colorScheme
                                    .onSurfaceVariant,
                              ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                    const SizedBox(height: 22),
                    SizedBox(
                      height: 50,
                      child: FilledButton(
                        onPressed: _isLoading ? null : _submit,
                        child: _isLoading
                            ? const SizedBox.square(
                                dimension: 20,
                                child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                                  strokeWidth: 2,
                                  color: Colors.white,
                                ),
                              )
                            : Text(_isSignup ? 'Sign Up' : 'Log In'),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    Wrap(
                      alignment: WrapAlignment.center,
                      crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          _isSignup
                              ? 'Already have an account? '
                              : 'Don’t have an account? ',
                        ),
                        TextButton(
                          onPressed: () => _switchMode(!_isSignup),
                          child: Text(_isSignup ? 'Log in' : 'Sign up'),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    Text(
                      '* Required field',
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                        color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    ),
  );
}

==> week_3/lib/settings_page.dart <==
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:connectivity_plus/connectivity_plus.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:image_picker/image_picker.dart';

import 'registration_page.dart';
import 'services/app_preferences.dart';
import 'services/file_service.dart';
import 'services/storage_service.dart';
import 'theme/app_theme.dart';
import 'widgets/profile_avatar.dart';

class SettingsPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const SettingsPage({
    super.key,
    required this.preferences,
    required this.onRefreshCache,
    this.showAppBar = true,
  });

  final AppPreferences preferences;
  final Future<void> Function() onRefreshCache;
  final bool showAppBar;

  @override
  State<SettingsPage> createState() => _SettingsPageState();
}

class _SettingsPageState extends State<SettingsPage> {
  late Future<Student?> _profileFuture;
  bool _exporting = false;
  bool _clearing = false;
  bool _refreshing = false;
  bool _changingMockData = false;
  final ImagePicker _imagePicker = ImagePicker();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadProfile();
  }

  void _loadProfile() {
    _profileFuture = StorageService.getProfile();
  }

  Future<void> _exportStudents() async {
    setState(() => _exporting = true);
    try {
      await FileService.exportStudents();
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text(
            'File exported successfully to ${await FileService.getFilePath()}',
          ),
          duration: const Duration(seconds: 4),
          backgroundColor: AppTokens.maroonPrimary,
          action: SnackBarAction(
            label: 'OK',
            textColor: Colors.white,
            onPressed: () {},
          ),
        ),
      );
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
          .showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Export failed: $error')));
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _exporting = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _logOut() async {
    final confirmed = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Log out?'),
        content: const Text(
          'Your local account will remain saved on this device.',
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
            child: const Text('Cancel'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
            child: const Text('Log Out'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (confirmed == true) await widget.preferences.logout();
  }

  Future<void> _clearLocalStorage() async {
    final confirmed = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Clear local storage?'),
        content: const Text(
          'This permanently removes saved student records and app preferences '
          'from this device.',
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
            child: const Text('Cancel'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
            child: const Text('Clear data'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (confirmed != true) return;

    setState(() => _clearing = true);
    try {
      await widget.preferences.clearLocalStorage();
      await widget.onRefreshCache();
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(_loadProfile);
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(
        context,
      ).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('Local storage cleared.')));
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text('Could not clear local storage: $error')),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _clearing = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _refreshCache() async {
    setState(() => _refreshing = true);
    try {
      await widget.onRefreshCache();
      await StorageService.recordActivity(
        'Dashboard data refreshed',
        'Manual refresh',
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(content: Text('Dashboard data refreshed.')),
      );
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text('Could not refresh dashboard data: $error')),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _refreshing = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _networkDiagnostics() async {
    final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
    try {
      final results = await Connectivity().checkConnectivity();
      final hasNetwork = results.any(
        (result) => result != ConnectivityResult.none,
      );
      if (!hasNetwork) {
        if (!mounted) return;
        await showDialog<void>(
          context: context,
          builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
            title: const Text('Network diagnostics'),
            content: const Text(
              'No network connection is available. Student and faculty data will use the last locally cached JSONPlaceholder records.',
            ),
            actions: [
              TextButton(
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                child: const Text('Done'),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        );
        return;
      }
      final response = await http
          .get(Uri.parse('https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users'))
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));
      if (!mounted) return;
      await showDialog<void>(
        context: context,
        builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
          title: const Text('Network diagnostics'),
          content: Text(
            'Network: ${results.map((result) => result.name).join(', ')}\n'
            'API check: HTTP ${response.statusCode}',
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
              child: const Text('Done'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      messenger.showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text('Network diagnostics failed: $error')),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _editProfile(Student? student) async {
    await Navigator.push<void>(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (_) =>
            RegistrationPage(student: student, isProfileEditor: true),
      ),
    );
    if (mounted) {
      setState(_loadProfile);
      await widget.onRefreshCache();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _editProfilePhoto() async {
    final source = await showModalBottomSheet<ImageSource>(
      context: context,
      showDragHandle: true,
      builder: (sheetContext) => SafeArea(
        child: Wrap(
          children: [
            ListTile(
              leading: const Icon(Icons.photo_library_outlined),
              title: const Text('Choose from photos'),
              onTap: () => Navigator.pop(sheetContext, ImageSource.gallery),
            ),
            ListTile(
              leading: const Icon(Icons.photo_camera_outlined),
              title: const Text('Take a photo'),
              onTap: () => Navigator.pop(sheetContext, ImageSource.camera),
            ),
            if (widget.preferences.profilePhotoBase64 != null)
              ListTile(
                leading: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline),
                title: const Text('Remove photo'),
                onTap: () async {
                  await _removeProfilePhoto();
                  if (sheetContext.mounted) Navigator.pop(sheetContext);
                },
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
    if (source == null) return;

    try {
      final photo = await _imagePicker.pickImage(
        source: source,
        maxWidth: 512,
        maxHeight: 512,
        imageQuality: 75,
      );
      if (photo == null) return;
      final Uint8List bytes = await photo.readAsBytes();
      await widget.preferences.setProfilePhoto(bytes);
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text('Could not update profile photo: $error')),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _removeProfilePhoto() async {
    try {
      await widget.preferences.setProfilePhoto(null);
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text('Could not remove profile photo: $error')),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _changeDarkMode(bool enabled) async {
    try {
      await widget.preferences.setDarkMode(enabled);
      await StorageService.recordActivity(
        enabled ? 'Dark mode enabled' : 'Dark mode disabled',
        'Display settings',
      );
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(
        context,
      ).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Could not update theme: $error')));
    }
  }

  Future<void> _changeMockData(bool enabled) async {
    if (_changingMockData || enabled == widget.preferences.useMockData) return;
    setState(() => _changingMockData = true);
    try {
      await widget.preferences.setUseMockData(enabled);
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text(enabled ? 'Mock data enabled.' : 'Live data restored.'),
          duration: const Duration(seconds: 2),
        ),
      );
      _recordMockDataActivity(enabled);
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text('Could not update data mode: $error')),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _changingMockData = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _recordMockDataActivity(bool enabled) async {
    try {
      await StorageService.recordActivity(
        enabled ? 'Mock data enabled' : 'Mock data disabled',
        enabled
            ? 'Using JSONPlaceholder directory data'
            : 'Using saved portal data',
      );
    } catch (error) {
      debugPrint('Could not record mock data activity: $error');
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: widget.preferences,
      builder: (context, child) {
        final content = ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
          children: [
            const Text(
              'Settings',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 26, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            FutureBuilder<Student?>(
              future: _profileFuture,
              builder: (context, snapshot) {
                if (snapshot.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting) {
                  return const Card(
                    child: Padding(
                      padding: EdgeInsets.all(20),
                      child: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
                    ),
                  );
                }
                if (snapshot.hasError) {
                  return Card(
                    child: ListTile(
                      title: const Text('Unable to load profile'),
                      subtitle: Text('${snapshot.error}'),
                      trailing: IconButton(
                        tooltip: 'Retry',
                        onPressed: () => setState(_loadProfile),
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                }
                final student = snapshot.data;
                final name = student?.name ?? 'Novy Chariz Tablac';
                final nameParts = name
                    .trim()
                    .split(RegExp(r'\s+'))
                    .where((part) => part.isNotEmpty)
                    .toList();
                final initials = nameParts.isEmpty
                    ? 'NT'
                    : nameParts.length > 1
                    ? '${nameParts.first[0]}${nameParts.last[0]}'.toUpperCase()
                    : nameParts.first[0].toUpperCase();

                return Card(
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                    child: Row(
                      children: [
                        ProfileAvatar(
                          bytes: widget.preferences.profilePhotoBytes,
                          initials: initials,
                          radius: 30,
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 14),
                        Expanded(
                          child: Column(
                            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                            children: [
                              Text(
                                name,
                                style: const TextStyle(
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                  fontSize: 16,
                                ),
                              ),
                              Text(
                                student?.id ?? '2023-1-00123',
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  color: Theme.of(context)
                                      .colorScheme
                                      .onSurfaceVariant,
                                ),
                              ),
                              Text(
                                student?.program ?? 'BSIT-WM',
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  color: Theme.of(context)
                                      .colorScheme
                                      .secondary,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                ),
                              ),
                              Text(
                                student?.email ?? 'novy.tablac@lpu.edu.ph',
                                maxLines: 1,
                                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  color: Theme.of(context)
                                      .colorScheme
                                      .onSurfaceVariant,
                                  fontSize: 12,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                        PopupMenuButton<String>(
                          tooltip: 'Edit profile',
                          onSelected: (action) {
                            if (action == 'photo') _editProfilePhoto();
                            if (action == 'details') _editProfile(student);
                          },
                          itemBuilder: (context) => const [
                            PopupMenuItem(
                              value: 'photo',
                              child: Text('Edit profile photo'),
                            ),
                            PopupMenuItem(
                              value: 'details',
                              child: Text('Edit account details'),
                            ),
                          ],
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.edit_outlined),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                );
              },
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 20),
            _sectionTitle('App & Data'),
            Card(
              child: Column(
                children: [
                  ListTile(
                    leading: const Icon(Icons.file_download_outlined),
                    title: const Text('Export Student Records to File'),
                    subtitle: const Text(
                      'Save a plain-text file on this device',
                    ),
                    trailing: _exporting
                        ? const SizedBox(
                            width: 20,
                            height: 20,
                            child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
                          )
                        : const Icon(Icons.chevron_right),
                    onTap: _exporting ? null : _exportStudents,
                  ),
                  const Divider(height: 1, indent: 16, endIndent: 16),
                  SwitchListTile(
                    secondary: const Icon(Icons.dark_mode_outlined),
                    title: const Text('Dark mode'),
                    value: widget.preferences.themeMode == ThemeMode.dark,
                    onChanged: _changeDarkMode,
                  ),
                  const Divider(height: 1, indent: 16, endIndent: 16),
                  ListTile(
                    leading: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline),
                    title: const Text('Clear Local Storage'),
                    subtitle: const Text(
                      'Remove saved records and preferences',
                    ),
                    trailing: _clearing
                        ? const SizedBox(
                            width: 20,
                            height: 20,
                            child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
                          )
                        : const Icon(Icons.chevron_right),
                    onTap: _clearing ? null : _clearLocalStorage,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 18),
            _sectionTitle('API & System'),
            Card(
              child: Column(
                children: [
                  SwitchListTile(
                    secondary: const Icon(Icons.api_outlined),
                    title: const Text('Use mock data'),
                    subtitle: const Text(
                      'Switch Users and Faculty directories to sample data',
                    ),
                    value: widget.preferences.useMockData,
                    onChanged: _changingMockData ? null : _changeMockData,
                  ),
                  const Divider(height: 1, indent: 16, endIndent: 16),
                  ListTile(
                    leading: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
                    title: const Text('Refresh dashboard data'),
                    subtitle: const Text(
                      'Reload weather, calendar, and statuses',
                    ),
                    trailing: _refreshing
                        ? const SizedBox(
                            width: 20,
                            height: 20,
                            child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
                          )
                        : const Icon(Icons.chevron_right),
                    onTap: _refreshing ? null : _refreshCache,
                  ),
                  const Divider(height: 1, indent: 16, endIndent: 16),
                  ListTile(
                    leading: const Icon(Icons.network_check),
                    title: const Text('Network Diagnostics'),
                    trailing: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right),
                    onTap: _networkDiagnostics,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 18),
            Card(
              child: ListTile(
                leading: const Icon(Icons.logout),
                title: const Text('Log Out'),
                subtitle: Text(
                  widget.preferences.activeUserEmail ?? 'End this session',
                ),
                onTap: _logOut,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        );
        if (!widget.showAppBar) return content;
        return Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Settings')),
          body: content,
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _sectionTitle(String title) => Padding(
    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
    child: Text(
      title,
      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
    ),
  );
}
