==> week_3/lib/db/services/storage_service.dart <==
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

class Student {
  final String name;
  final String id;
  final String email;
  final String program;
  final String yearLevel;
  final String contact;
  final String address;

  const Student({
    required this.name,
    required this.id,
    required this.email,
    required this.program,
    required this.yearLevel,
    this.contact = '',
    this.address = '',
  });

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
    'name': name,
    'id': id,
    'email': email,
    'program': program,
    'yearLevel': yearLevel,
    'contact': contact,
    'address': address,
  };

  factory Student.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    return Student(
      name: json['name'] ?? '',
      id: json['id'] ?? '',
      email: json['email'] ?? '',
      program: json['program'] ?? '',
      yearLevel: json['yearLevel'] ?? '',
      contact: json['contact'] ?? '',
      address: json['address'] ?? '',
    );
  }
}

class RecentActivity {
  final String title;
  final String detail;
  final DateTime timestamp;

  const RecentActivity({
    required this.title,
    required this.detail,
    required this.timestamp,
  });

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
    'title': title,
    'detail': detail,
    'timestamp': timestamp.toIso8601String(),
  };

  factory RecentActivity.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) => RecentActivity(
    title: json['title'] as String? ?? 'Activity',
    detail: json['detail'] as String? ?? '',
    timestamp:
        DateTime.tryParse(json['timestamp'] as String? ?? '') ?? DateTime.now(),
  );
}

class StorageService {
  static const String _key = 'lpu_students';
  static const String _activityKey = 'lpu_recent_activity';

  static Future<List<RecentActivity>> getRecentActivity() async {
    final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final raw = preferences.getString(_activityKey);
    if (raw == null) return [];
    final decoded = jsonDecode(raw);
    if (decoded is! List) {
      throw const FormatException('Activity data must be a JSON list.');
    }
    return decoded
        .whereType<Map>()
        .map(
          (item) => RecentActivity.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic>.from(item)),
        )
        .toList();
  }

  static Future<void> recordActivity(String title, String detail) async {
    final activities = await getRecentActivity();
    activities.insert(
      0,
      RecentActivity(title: title, detail: detail, timestamp: DateTime.now()),
    );
    final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await preferences.setString(
      _activityKey,
      jsonEncode(activities.take(10).map((item) => item.toJson()).toList()),
    );
  }

  static Future<List<Student>> getStudents() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final raw = prefs.getString(_key);

    if (raw == null) return [];

    final List<dynamic> decoded = jsonDecode(raw);
    return decoded
        .map((item) => Student.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic>.from(item)))
        .toList();
  }

  static Future<void> saveStudent(Student student) async {
    final students = await getStudents();

    final duplicate = students.any((existing) => existing.id == student.id);

    if (duplicate) {
      throw Exception('A student with this ID is already registered.');
    }

    students.add(student);

    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setString(
      _key,
      jsonEncode(students.map((s) => s.toJson()).toList()),
    );
    await recordActivity('Student registered', student.name);
  }

  static Future<void> updateStudent(String existingId, Student student) async {
    final students = await getStudents();
    final existingIndex = students.indexWhere(
      (existing) => existing.id == existingId,
    );
    if (existingIndex < 0) {
      throw Exception('The student record could not be found.');
    }
    final duplicate = students.any(
      (existing) => existing.id == student.id && existing.id != existingId,
    );
    if (duplicate) {
      throw Exception('A student with this ID is already registered.');
    }
    students[existingIndex] = student;

    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setString(
      _key,
      jsonEncode(students.map((item) => item.toJson()).toList()),
    );
    await recordActivity('Student profile updated', student.name);
  }

  static Future<void> deleteStudent(String id) async {
    final students = await getStudents();
    students.removeWhere((student) => student.id == id);

    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setString(
      _key,
      jsonEncode(students.map((s) => s.toJson()).toList()),
    );
  }
}

==> week_3/lib/db/services/file_service.dart <==
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:path_provider/path_provider.dart';

import 'storage_service.dart';

class FileService {
  static Future<File> exportStudents() async {
    final students = await StorageService.getStudents();

    final directory = await getApplicationDocumentsDirectory();
    final file = File('${directory.path}/student_info.txt');

    final buffer = StringBuffer()
      ..writeln('LPU STUDENT INFORMATION')
      ..writeln('Generated: ${DateTime.now()}')
      ..writeln('Total Students: ${students.length}')
      ..writeln(List.filled(35, '=').join())
      ..writeln();

    for (final student in students) {
      buffer
        ..writeln('Student Name: ${student.name}')
        ..writeln('Student ID: ${student.id}')
        ..writeln('Email: ${student.email}')
        ..writeln('Program: ${student.program}')
        ..writeln('Year Level: ${student.yearLevel}')
        ..writeln('Contact: ${student.contact}')
        ..writeln('Address: ${student.address}')
        ..writeln(List.filled(35, '-').join())
        ..writeln();
    }

    await file.writeAsString(buffer.toString());
    await StorageService.recordActivity(
      'Student records exported',
      '${students.length} record${students.length == 1 ? '' : 's'} exported',
    );
    return file;
  }

  static Future<String> readExportedFile() async {
    final directory = await getApplicationDocumentsDirectory();
    final file = File('${directory.path}/student_info.txt');

    if (!await file.exists()) {
      return 'No exported file yet.\n\nTap Export Student Information to create one.';
    }

    return file.readAsString();
  }

  static Future<String> getFilePath() async {
    final directory = await getApplicationDocumentsDirectory();
    return '${directory.path}/student_info.txt';
  }
}

==> week_3/lib/db/services/app_preferences.dart <==
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

class AppPreferences extends ChangeNotifier {
  static const _darkModeKey = 'dark_mode';
  static const _mockDataKey = 'mock_data';
  static const _profilePhotoKey = 'profile_photo';

  ThemeMode _themeMode = ThemeMode.light;
  bool _useMockData = false;
  String? _profilePhotoBase64;

  ThemeMode get themeMode => _themeMode;
  bool get useMockData => _useMockData;
  String? get profilePhotoBase64 => _profilePhotoBase64;

  Uint8List? get profilePhotoBytes {
    final encoded = _profilePhotoBase64;
    if (encoded == null) return null;
    try {
      return base64Decode(encoded);
    } on FormatException {
      return null;
    }
  }

  Future<void> load() async {
    final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    _themeMode = preferences.getBool(_darkModeKey) ?? false
        ? ThemeMode.dark
        : ThemeMode.light;
    _useMockData = preferences.getBool(_mockDataKey) ?? false;
    _profilePhotoBase64 = preferences.getString(_profilePhotoKey);
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> setProfilePhoto(Uint8List? bytes) async {
    final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    if (bytes == null) {
      await preferences.remove(_profilePhotoKey);
      _profilePhotoBase64 = null;
    } else {
      final encoded = base64Encode(bytes);
      final saved = await preferences.setString(_profilePhotoKey, encoded);
      if (!saved) {
        throw StateError('The profile photo could not be saved locally.');
      }
      _profilePhotoBase64 = encoded;
    }
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> setDarkMode(bool enabled) async {
    final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await preferences.setBool(_darkModeKey, enabled);
    _themeMode = enabled ? ThemeMode.dark : ThemeMode.light;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> setUseMockData(bool enabled) async {
    final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await preferences.setBool(_mockDataKey, enabled);
    _useMockData = enabled;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> clearLocalStorage() async {
    final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await preferences.clear();
    _themeMode = ThemeMode.light;
    _useMockData = false;
    _profilePhotoBase64 = null;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:connectivity_plus/connectivity_plus.dart';

class SettingsPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const SettingsPage({
    super.key,
    required this.preferences,
    required this.onRefreshCache,
    this.showAppBar = true,
  });

  final AppPreferences preferences;
  final Future<void> Function() onRefreshCache;
  final bool showAppBar;

  @override
  State<SettingsPage> createState() => _SettingsPageState();
}

class _SettingsPageState extends State<SettingsPage> {
  late Future<List<Student>> _studentsFuture;
  bool _exporting = false;
  bool _clearing = false;
  bool _refreshing = false;
  final ImagePicker _imagePicker = ImagePicker();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadStudent();
  }

  void _loadStudent() {
    _studentsFuture = StorageService.getStudents();
  }

  Future<void> _exportStudents() async {
    setState(() => _exporting = true);
    try {
      final file = await FileService.exportStudents();
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text('Student records exported to ${file.path}')),
      );
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
          .showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Export failed: $error')));
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _exporting = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _clearLocalStorage() async {
    final confirmed = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Clear local storage?'),
        content: const Text(
          'This permanently removes saved student records and app preferences '
          'from this device.',
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
            child: const Text('Cancel'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
            child: const Text('Clear data'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (confirmed != true) return;

    setState(() => _clearing = true);
    try {
      await widget.preferences.clearLocalStorage();
      await widget.onRefreshCache();
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(_loadStudent);
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(
        context,
      ).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('Local storage cleared.')));
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text('Could not clear local storage: $error')),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _clearing = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _refreshCache() async {
    setState(() => _refreshing = true);
    try {
      await widget.onRefreshCache();
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(content: Text('Dashboard data refreshed.')),
      );
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text('Could not refresh dashboard data: $error')),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _refreshing = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _networkDiagnostics() async {
    final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
    try {
      final results = await Connectivity().checkConnectivity();
      final response = await http
          .get(Uri.parse('https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users'))
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));
      if (!mounted) return;
      await showDialog<void>(
        context: context,
        builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
          title: const Text('Network diagnostics'),
          content: Text(
            'Network: ${results.map((result) => result.name).join(', ')}\n'
            'API check: HTTP ${response.statusCode}',
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
              child: const Text('Done'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      messenger.showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text('Network diagnostics failed: $error')),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _editProfile(Student? student) async {
    await Navigator.push<void>(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => RegistrationPage(student: student)),
    );
    if (mounted) {
      setState(_loadStudent);
      await widget.onRefreshCache();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _editProfilePhoto() async {
    final source = await showModalBottomSheet<ImageSource>(
      context: context,
      showDragHandle: true,
      builder: (sheetContext) => SafeArea(
        child: Wrap(
          children: [
            ListTile(
              leading: const Icon(Icons.photo_library_outlined),
              title: const Text('Choose from photos'),
              onTap: () => Navigator.pop(sheetContext, ImageSource.gallery),
            ),
            ListTile(
              leading: const Icon(Icons.photo_camera_outlined),
              title: const Text('Take a photo'),
              onTap: () => Navigator.pop(sheetContext, ImageSource.camera),
            ),
            if (widget.preferences.profilePhotoBase64 != null)
              ListTile(
                leading: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline),
                title: const Text('Remove photo'),
                onTap: () async {
                  await _removeProfilePhoto();
                  if (sheetContext.mounted) Navigator.pop(sheetContext);
                },
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
    if (source == null) return;

    try {
      final photo = await _imagePicker.pickImage(
        source: source,
        maxWidth: 512,
        maxHeight: 512,
        imageQuality: 75,
      );
      if (photo == null) return;
      final Uint8List bytes = await photo.readAsBytes();
      await widget.preferences.setProfilePhoto(bytes);
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text('Could not update profile photo: $error')),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _removeProfilePhoto() async {
    try {
      await widget.preferences.setProfilePhoto(null);
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text('Could not remove profile photo: $error')),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _changeDarkMode(bool enabled) async {

      await widget.preferences.setDarkMode(enabled);
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(
        context,
      ).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Could not update theme: $error')));
    }
  }

  Future<void> _changeMockData(bool enabled) async {
    try {
      await widget.preferences.setUseMockData(enabled);
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(

      );

  }

  void _showPrivacyPolicy() {
    showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Privacy Policy'),

        ),
        actions: [

            child: const Text('Close'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

  void _showSystemInfo() {
    final size = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context);
    showDialog<void>(

      builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('System information'),

          'Screen: ${size.width.round()} × ${size.height.round()} logical pixels\n'

        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(

            child: const Text('Close'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

==> week_3/lib/db/widgets/profile_avatar.dart <==
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class ProfileAvatar extends StatelessWidget {
  const ProfileAvatar({
    super.key,
    required this.bytes,
    required this.initials,
    this.radius = 22,
    this.backgroundColor = const Color(0xFF800000),
    this.foregroundColor = Colors.white,
  });

  final Uint8List? bytes;
  final String initials;
  final double radius;
  final Color backgroundColor;
  final Color foregroundColor;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final image = bytes;
    return CircleAvatar(
      radius: radius,
      backgroundColor: backgroundColor,
      child: image == null
          ? Text(
              initials.isEmpty ? 'NT' : initials,
              style: TextStyle(
                color: foregroundColor,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
              ),
            )
          : ClipOval(
              child: Image.memory(
                image,
                width: radius * 2,
                height: radius * 2,
                fit: BoxFit.cover,
                errorBuilder: (context, error, stackTrace) => Center(
                  child: Text(
                    initials.isEmpty ? 'NT' : initials,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: foregroundColor,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
    );
  }
}

==> week_3/lib/widgets/student_card.dart <==
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../services/storage_service.dart';

class StudentCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const StudentCard({super.key, required this.student, this.onTap});

  final Student student;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;

  String _getInitials(String name) {
    final parts = name
        .trim()
        .split(RegExp(r'\s+'))
        .where((part) => part.isNotEmpty)
        .toList();
    if (parts.isEmpty) return 'S';
    if (parts.length == 1) return parts.first[0].toUpperCase();
    return parts.first[0].toUpperCase();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final bool isActive =
        student.status.toLowerCase() != 'inactive' &&
        student.status.toLowerCase() != 'warning';
    final int attendancePercent = (student.attendance * 100).round();

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: theme.cardColor,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(color: theme.dividerColor),
        boxShadow: isDark
            ? null
            : [
                BoxShadow(
                  color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.03),
                  blurRadius: 4,
                  offset: const Offset(0, 2),
                ),
              ],
      ),
      child: Material(
        color: Colors.transparent,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        child: InkWell(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          onTap: onTap,
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Row(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    CircleAvatar(
                      radius: 20,
                      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF800000),
                      child: Text(
                        _getInitials(student.name),
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          color: Colors.white,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          fontSize: 16,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 10),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          Text(
                            student.name,
                            maxLines: 1,
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 15,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 2),
                          Text(
                            '${student.id} • ${student.program}',
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 11,
                              color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 4),
                          Row(
                            children: [
                              Icon(
                                Icons.email_outlined,
                                size: 12,
                                color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(width: 4),
                              Expanded(
                                child: Text(
                                  student.email,
                                  maxLines: 1,
                                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 11,
                                    color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                          if (student.contact.isNotEmpty) ...[
                            const SizedBox(height: 2),
                            Row(
                              children: [
                                Icon(
                                  Icons.phone_outlined,
                                  size: 12,
                                  color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                                ),
                                const SizedBox(width: 4),
                                Text(
                                  student.contact,
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 11,
                                    color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ],
                            ),
                          ],
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                        horizontal: 8,
                        vertical: 3,
                      ),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: isDark
                            ? (isActive
                                  ? const Color(0xFF24382A)
                                  : const Color(0xFF40272A))
                            : (isActive
                                  ? const Color(0xFFE8F5E9)
                                  : const Color(0xFFFFEBEE)),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                      ),
                      child: Text(
                        isActive ? 'Active' : 'Inactive',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 10,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                          color: isActive
                              ? (isDark
                                    ? const Color(0xFFE0B0B0)
                                    : const Color(0xFF2E7D32))
                              : (isDark
                                    ? const Color(0xFFD88A8A)
                                    : const Color(0xFFC62828)),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Expanded(
                      child: ClipRRect(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                        child: LinearProgressIndicator(
                          value: student.attendance.clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble(),
                          minHeight: 5,
                          backgroundColor: theme.dividerColor,
                          valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(
                            isActive
                                ? (isDark
                                      ? const Color(0xFFE0B0B0)
                                      : const Color(0xFF2E7D32))
                                : (isDark
                                      ? const Color(0xFFD88A8A)
                                      : const Color(0xFFC62828)),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 10),
                    Text(
                      '$attendancePercent%',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 11,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

==> week_3/lib/widgets/quick_action_button.dart <==
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class QuickActionButton extends StatelessWidget {
  const QuickActionButton({
    super.key,
    required this.label,
    required this.icon,
    required this.onTap,
    this.iconColor = const Color(0xFF800000),
    this.statusDotColor,
    this.statusText,
  });

  final String label;
  final IconData icon;
  final VoidCallback onTap;
  final Color iconColor;
  final Color? statusDotColor;
  final String? statusText;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: theme.cardColor,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(color: theme.dividerColor),
        boxShadow: isDark
            ? null
            : [
                BoxShadow(
                  color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.02),
                  blurRadius: 3,
                  offset: const Offset(0, 1),
                ),
              ],
      ),
      child: Material(
        color: Colors.transparent,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        child: InkWell(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          onTap: onTap,
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8, horizontal: 6),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
              children: [
                Stack(
                  clipBehavior: Clip.none,
                  children: [
                    Icon(
                      icon,
                      color: isDark ? const Color(0xFFE0B0B0) : iconColor,
                      size: 24,
                    ),
                    if (statusDotColor != null)
                      Positioned(
                        right: -3,
                        top: -2,
                        child: Container(
                          width: 8,
                          height: 8,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: statusDotColor,
                            shape: BoxShape.circle,
                            border: Border.all(
                              color: theme.cardColor,
                              width: 1.5,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                Text(
                  label,
                  maxLines: 2,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 11.5,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                    color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                  ),
                ),
                if (statusText != null) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 1),
                  Text(
                    statusText!,
                    maxLines: 2,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 8.5,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                      color: statusDotColor ?? Colors.grey.shade600,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class KpiCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const KpiCard({
    super.key,
    required this.title,
    required this.value,
    this.badge,
    this.badgeColor,
    this.badgeTextColor,
    this.icon,
    this.iconColor,
  });

  final String title;
  final String value;
  final String? badge;
  final Color? badgeColor;
  final Color? badgeTextColor;
  final IconData? icon;
  final Color? iconColor;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: theme.cardColor,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(color: theme.dividerColor),
        boxShadow: isDark
            ? null
            : [
                BoxShadow(
                  color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.03),
                  blurRadius: 4,
                  offset: const Offset(0, 2),
                ),
              ],
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  title,
                  maxLines: 2,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 11,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                    color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              if (icon != null)
                Icon(
                  icon,
                  size: 14,
                  color: iconColor ?? const Color(0xFF800000),
                ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          Row(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.baseline,
            textBaseline: TextBaseline.alphabetic,
            children: [
              Text(
                value,
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 22,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                ),
              ),
              if (badge != null) ...[
                const SizedBox(width: 4),
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                    horizontal: 4,
                    vertical: 2,
                  ),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color:
                        badgeColor ??
                        (isDark
                            ? const Color(0xFF333333)
                            : const Color(0xFFE8F5E9)),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                  ),
                  child: Text(
                    badge!,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 9,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      color:
                          badgeTextColor ??
                          (isDark
                              ? const Color(0xFFE0B0B0)
                              : const Color(0xFF2E7D32)),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

==> week_3/lib/widgets/ccs_program_stats_grid_widget.dart <==
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class CcsProgramData {
  final String code;
  final String name;
  final int count;
  final IconData icon;
  final Color iconColor;
  final Color iconBackgroundColor;
  final String statusText;

  const CcsProgramData({
    required this.code,
    required this.name,
    required this.count,
    required this.icon,
    required this.iconColor,
    required this.iconBackgroundColor,
    this.statusText = 'Actively Enrolled',
  });
}

  Widget _buildCard(BuildContext context, CcsProgramData program) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final cardColor = isDark ? const Color(0xFF262626) : Colors.white;
    final textColor = isDark
        ? const Color(0xFFFAFDEA)
        : const Color(0xFF171717);
    final secondaryTextColor = Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant;
    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: cardColor,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(color: Theme.of(context).dividerColor),
        boxShadow: isDark
            ? null
            : [
                BoxShadow(
                  color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.03),
                  blurRadius: 4,
                  offset: const Offset(0, 2),
                ),
              ],
      ),
      child: Material(
        color: Colors.transparent,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        child: InkWell(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          onTap: () => onProgramSelected?.call(program.code),
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
              children: [
                Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      program.code,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 14,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        color: textColor,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 2),
                    Text(
                      program.name,
                      maxLines: 2,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 9,
                        color: secondaryTextColor,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                Row(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
                  children: [
                    Container(
                      width: 44,
                      height: 44,
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: isDark
                            ? const Color(0xFF333333)
                            : program.iconBackgroundColor,
                        shape: BoxShape.circle,
                      ),
                      child: Icon(
                        program.icon,
                        color: isDark
                            ? const Color(0xFFE0B0B0)
                            : program.iconColor,
                        size: 24,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 10),
                    Expanded(
                      child: FittedBox(
                        alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                        fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
                        child: Text(
                          '${program.count}',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 26,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                            color: textColor,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 6),
                Text(
                  program.statusText,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 10,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                    color: secondaryTextColor,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Text(
          'CCS Programmes',
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: 16,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
            color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurface,
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        LayoutBuilder(
          builder: (context, constraints) => GridView.builder(
            shrinkWrap: true,
            physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
            itemCount: programs.length,
            gridDelegate: SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
              crossAxisCount: 2,
              crossAxisSpacing: 12,
              mainAxisSpacing: 12,
              mainAxisExtent: constraints.maxWidth < 360 ? 156 : 148,
            ),
            itemBuilder: (context, index) =>
                _buildCard(context, programs[index]),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class FacultyCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const FacultyCard({
    super.key,
    required this.name,
    required this.department,
    required this.email,
    required this.phone,
    this.initials,
    this.onEmailTap,
    this.onCallTap,
  });

  final String name;
  final String department;
  final String email;
  final String phone;
  final String? initials;
  final VoidCallback? onEmailTap;
  final VoidCallback? onCallTap;

  String _deriveInitials() {
    if (initials != null && initials!.isNotEmpty) return initials!;
    // Strip prefixes like Dr., Prof.
    final clean = name.replaceAll(
      RegExp(r'^(Dr\.|Prof\.|Mr\.|Ms\.|Mrs\.)\s*'),
      '',
    );
    final parts = clean.trim().split(RegExp(r'\s+'));
    if (parts.isEmpty) return 'F';
    return parts.first[0].toUpperCase();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    const maroonColor = Color(0xFF800000);
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: theme.cardColor,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(color: theme.dividerColor),
        boxShadow: isDark
            ? null
            : [
                BoxShadow(
                  color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.03),
                  blurRadius: 4,
                  offset: const Offset(0, 2),
                ),
              ],
      ),
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Row(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                CircleAvatar(
                  radius: 20,
                  backgroundColor: maroonColor,
                  child: Text(
                    _deriveInitials(),
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      color: Colors.white,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      fontSize: 16,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        name,
                        maxLines: 1,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 15,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 2),
                      Text(
                        department,
                        maxLines: 2,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 11,
                          color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 4),
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          Icon(
                            Icons.email_outlined,
                            size: 12,
                            color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 4),
                          Expanded(
                            child: Text(
                              email,
                              maxLines: 1,
                              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 11,
                                color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 2),
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          Icon(
                            Icons.phone_outlined,
                            size: 12,
                            color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 4),
                          Text(
                            phone,
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 11,
                              color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: SizedBox(
                    height: 32,
                    child: ElevatedButton.icon(
                      style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: maroonColor,
                        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                        elevation: 0,
                        padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                        ),

                      onPressed: onEmailTap,
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.email_outlined, size: 14),

                          fontSize: 12,

                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                Expanded(
                  child: SizedBox(
                    height: 32,
                    child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                      style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                        foregroundColor: isDark
                            ? const Color(0xFFE0B0B0)
                            : maroonColor,
                        side: BorderSide(
                          color: isDark ? const Color(0xFFE0B0B0) : maroonColor,
                        ),
                        padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),

==> week_3/lib/widgets/profile_avatar.dart <==
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class ProfileAvatar extends StatelessWidget {
  const ProfileAvatar({
    super.key,
    required this.bytes,
    required this.initials,
    this.radius = 22,
    this.backgroundColor = const Color(0xFF800000),
    this.foregroundColor = Colors.white,
  });

  final Uint8List? bytes;
  final String initials;
  final double radius;
  final Color backgroundColor;
  final Color foregroundColor;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final image = bytes;
    return CircleAvatar(
      radius: radius,
      backgroundColor: backgroundColor,
      child: image == null
          ? Text(
              initials.isEmpty ? 'NT' : initials,
              style: TextStyle(
                color: foregroundColor,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
              ),
            )
          : ClipOval(
              child: Image.memory(
                image,
                width: radius * 2,
                height: radius * 2,
                fit: BoxFit.cover,
                errorBuilder: (context, error, stackTrace) => Center(
                  child: Text(
                    initials.isEmpty ? 'NT' : initials,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: foregroundColor,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class StudentKpiRowWidget extends StatelessWidget {
  const StudentKpiRowWidget({
    super.key,
    this.totalStudents = 0,
    this.activeStudents = 0,
    this.avgAttendance = '0%',
  });

  final int totalStudents;
  final int activeStudents;
  final String avgAttendance;

  Widget _statCard(
    BuildContext context, {
    required String title,
    required String value,
  }) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    return SizedBox(
      height: 92,
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 10),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: theme.cardColor,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          border: Border.all(color: theme.dividerColor),
        ),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            SizedBox(
              height: 26,
              child: Align(
                alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                child: Text(
                  title,
                  maxLines: 2,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 10,
                    height: 1.15,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                    color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            Row(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: FittedBox(
                    fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
                    alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                    child: Text(
                      value,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 27,
                        height: 1,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                        color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, constraints) {
        const columns = 3;
        final gap = 8.0;
        final width = (constraints.maxWidth - gap * (columns - 1)) / columns;
        return Wrap(
          spacing: gap,
          runSpacing: gap,
          children: [
            SizedBox(
              width: width,
              child: _statCard(
                context,
                title: 'Total students',
                value: '$totalStudents',
              ),
            ),
            SizedBox(
              width: width,
              child: _statCard(
                context,
                title: 'Active students',
                value: '$activeStudents',
              ),
            ),
            SizedBox(
              width: width,
              child: _statCard(
                context,
                title: 'Avg. attendance',
                value: avgAttendance,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

==> week_3/lib/widgets/swipeable_week_calendar_widget.dart <==
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../services/public_holiday_service.dart';

class SwipeableWeekCalendarWidget extends StatefulWidget {
  const SwipeableWeekCalendarWidget({
    super.key,
    required this.selectedDate,
    required this.onDateSelected,
    this.eventText = 'No upcoming events.',
    this.holidays = const [],
    this.holidaysOffline = false,
  });

  final DateTime selectedDate;
  final ValueChanged<DateTime> onDateSelected;
  final String eventText;
  final List<PublicHoliday> holidays;
  final bool holidaysOffline;

  static const Color maroonColor = Color(0xFF800000);

  @override
  State<SwipeableWeekCalendarWidget> createState() =>
      _SwipeableWeekCalendarWidgetState();
}

class _SwipeableWeekCalendarWidgetState
    extends State<SwipeableWeekCalendarWidget> {
  static const int _initialPage = 5000;
  late final PageController _pageController;
  late DateTime _referenceMonday;
  late DateTime _currentDisplayedMonth;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    // Anchor reference Monday to the Monday of widget.selectedDate
    _referenceMonday = _findMonday(widget.selectedDate);
    _currentDisplayedMonth = widget.selectedDate;
    _pageController = PageController(initialPage: _initialPage);
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant SwipeableWeekCalendarWidget oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.selectedDate != widget.selectedDate) {
      _currentDisplayedMonth = widget.selectedDate;
      final newMonday = _findMonday(widget.selectedDate);
      final differenceInDays = newMonday.difference(_referenceMonday).inDays;
      final targetPage = _initialPage + (differenceInDays / 7).round();
      if (_pageController.hasClients &&
          _pageController.page?.round() != targetPage) {
        _pageController.jumpToPage(targetPage);
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _pageController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  DateTime _findMonday(DateTime date) {
    return DateTime(
      date.year,
      date.month,
      date.day,
    ).subtract(Duration(days: date.weekday - 1));
  }

  DateTime _getMondayForPage(int page) {
    final weekOffset = page - _initialPage;
    return _referenceMonday.add(Duration(days: weekOffset * 7));
  }

  String _monthName(int month) {
    const months = [
      'January',
      'February',
      'March',
      'April',
      'May',
      'June',
      'July',
      'August',
      'September',
      'October',
      'November',
      'December',
    ];
    return months[month - 1];
  }

  String _weekdayAbbreviation(int weekday) {
    const weekdays = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thur', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'];
    return weekdays[weekday - 1];
  }

  Future<void> _openMonthYearPicker() async {
    final picked = await showDatePicker(
      context: context,
      initialDate: widget.selectedDate,
      firstDate: DateTime(2020),
      lastDate: DateTime(2035),
      builder: (context, child) {
        final appTheme = Theme.of(context);
        final isDark = appTheme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
        return Theme(
          data: appTheme.copyWith(
            colorScheme: appTheme.colorScheme.copyWith(
              primary: isDark
                  ? const Color(0xFFE0B0B0)
                  : SwipeableWeekCalendarWidget.maroonColor,
              onPrimary: isDark ? const Color(0xFF171717) : Colors.white,
              onSurface: appTheme.colorScheme.onSurface,
            ),
          ),
          child: child ?? const SizedBox(),
        );
      },
    );

    if (picked != null) {
      widget.onDateSelected(picked);
      final targetMonday = _findMonday(picked);
      final offset = (targetMonday.difference(_referenceMonday).inDays / 7)
          .round();
      final targetPage = _initialPage + offset;
      if (_pageController.hasClients) {
        _pageController.animateToPage(
          targetPage,
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
          curve: Curves.easeInOut,
        );
      }
      setState(() {
        _currentDisplayedMonth = picked;
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final displayedTitle =
        '${_monthName(_currentDisplayedMonth.month)} ${_currentDisplayedMonth.year}';

    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: theme.cardColor,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        border: Border.all(color: theme.dividerColor),
        boxShadow: isDark
            ? null
            : [
                BoxShadow(
                  color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.03),
                  blurRadius: 4,
                  offset: const Offset(0, 2),
                ),
              ],
      ),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          // Month/Year Picker Button Header
          InkWell(
            onTap: _openMonthYearPicker,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 2, horizontal: 2),
              child: Row(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    displayedTitle,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 14,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 4),
                  Icon(
                    Icons.chevron_right,
                    size: 18,
                    color: isDark
                        ? const Color(0xFFE0B0B0)
                        : const Color(0xFF800000),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          // Swipeable Week View (PageView)
          SizedBox(
            height: 64,
            child: PageView.builder(
              controller: _pageController,
              onPageChanged: (page) {
                final monday = _getMondayForPage(page);
                final nextSelectedDate = monday.add(
                  Duration(days: widget.selectedDate.weekday - 1),
                );
                setState(() {
                  _currentDisplayedMonth = nextSelectedDate;
                });
                widget.onDateSelected(nextSelectedDate);
              },
              itemBuilder: (context, page) {
                final monday = _getMondayForPage(page);
                final days = List.generate(
                  7,
                  (i) => monday.add(Duration(days: i)),
                );

                return Row(
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                  children: days.map((day) {
                    final hasHoliday = widget.holidays.any(
                      (holiday) => DateUtils.isSameDay(holiday.date, day),
                    );
                    final isSelected =
                        day.year == widget.selectedDate.year &&
                        day.month == widget.selectedDate.month &&
                        day.day == widget.selectedDate.day;

                    return GestureDetector(
                      onTap: () {
                        widget.onDateSelected(day);
                      },
                      behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                      child: Column(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        children: [
                          Text(
                            _weekdayAbbreviation(day.weekday),
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 10,
                              color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 6),
                          Container(
                            width: 28,
                            height: 28,
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: isSelected
                                  ? (isDark
                                        ? const Color(0xFFE0B0B0)
                                        : SwipeableWeekCalendarWidget
                                              .maroonColor)
                                  : Colors.transparent,
                              shape: BoxShape.circle,
                            ),
                            alignment: Alignment.center,
                            child: Text(
                              '${day.day}',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 12,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                color: isSelected
                                    ? (isDark
                                          ? const Color(0xFF171717)
                                          : Colors.white)
                                    : theme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 3),
                          Container(
                            width: 4,
                            height: 4,
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: hasHoliday
                                  ? (isSelected
                                        ? theme.colorScheme.onPrimary
                                        : SwipeableWeekCalendarWidget
                                              .maroonColor)
                                  : Colors.transparent,
                              shape: BoxShape.circle,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    );
                  }).toList(),
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          const Divider(height: 1),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          _buildSelectedDateEvents(theme),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSelectedDateEvents(ThemeData theme) {
    final selectedHolidays = widget.holidays
        .where(
          (holiday) => DateUtils.isSameDay(holiday.date, widget.selectedDate),
        )
        .toList();
    if (selectedHolidays.isNotEmpty) {
      return Wrap(
        spacing: 6,
        runSpacing: 4,
        children: selectedHolidays
            .map(
              (holiday) => Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 5),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: const Color(0xFFF9EAEA),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                ),
                child: Row(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    const Icon(
                      Icons.celebration_outlined,
                      size: 14,
                      color: SwipeableWeekCalendarWidget.maroonColor,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 5),
                    Flexible(
                      child: Text(
                        holiday.name,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 11,
                          color: SwipeableWeekCalendarWidget.maroonColor,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            )
            .toList(),
      );
    }

    final message = widget.holidaysOffline
        ? widget.holidays.isEmpty
              ? 'Holiday dates are unavailable offline. Reconnect to sync.'
              : 'Offline · Showing saved Nager.Date holidays.'
        : widget.eventText;
    return Text(
      message,
      style: TextStyle(
        fontSize: 11,
        color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
      ),
    );
  }
}

    await tester.pump(const Duration(milliseconds: 100));

==> week_4/.dart_tool/dartpad/web_plugin_registrant.dart <==
// Flutter web plugin registrant file.
//
// Generated file. Do not edit.
//

// @dart = 2.13
// ignore_for_file: type=lint

import 'package:connectivity_plus/src/connectivity_plus_web.dart';
import 'package:geolocator_web/geolocator_web.dart';
import 'package:image_picker_for_web/image_picker_for_web.dart';
import 'package:permission_handler_html/permission_handler_html.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences_web/shared_preferences_web.dart';
import 'package:flutter_web_plugins/flutter_web_plugins.dart';

void registerPlugins([final Registrar? pluginRegistrar]) {
  final Registrar registrar = pluginRegistrar ?? webPluginRegistrar;
  ConnectivityPlusWebPlugin.registerWith(registrar);
  GeolocatorPlugin.registerWith(registrar);
  ImagePickerPlugin.registerWith(registrar);
  WebPermissionHandler.registerWith(registrar);
  SharedPreferencesPlugin.registerWith(registrar);
  registrar.registerMessageHandler();
}

==> week_4/lib/online_directory_page.dart <==
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:connectivity_plus/connectivity_plus.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

import 'services/portal_data_service.dart';
import 'theme/app_theme.dart';

class OnlineDirectoryPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const OnlineDirectoryPage({super.key, this.useMockData = false});

  final bool useMockData;

  @override
  State<OnlineDirectoryPage> createState() => _OnlineDirectoryPageState();
}

class _OnlineDirectoryPageState extends State<OnlineDirectoryPage> {
  static const _cacheKey = 'week4_online_directory_cache';
  static const _updatedKey = 'week4_online_directory_updated';

  Timer? _timer;
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _users = const [];
  DateTime? _lastUpdated;
  String _syncStatus = 'Syncing';
  bool _online = false;
  bool _syncing = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _restoreCache();
    _sync();
    _timer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 15), (_) => _sync());
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant OnlineDirectoryPage oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.useMockData != widget.useMockData) _sync();
  }

  Future<void> _restoreCache() async {
    if (widget.useMockData) return;
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final rawUsers = prefs.getString(_cacheKey);
      final updated = prefs.getString(_updatedKey);
      if (rawUsers == null) return;
      final decoded = jsonDecode(rawUsers);
      if (decoded is! List) return;
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _users = decoded
            .whereType<Map>()
            .map((item) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(item))
            .toList();
        _lastUpdated = DateTime.tryParse(updated ?? '');
      });
    } catch (_) {
      // A corrupt cache is ignored; the next successful sync replaces it.
    }
  }

  Future<void> _sync() async {
    if (_syncing) return;
    if (mounted) setState(() => _syncing = true);
    if (widget.useMockData) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _users = PortalDataService.mockUsers;
          _lastUpdated = null;
          _online = false;
          _syncStatus = 'Mock Data';
          _syncing = false;
        });
      }
      return;
    }
    try {
      final connections = await Connectivity().checkConnectivity();
      final connected = connections.any(
        (result) => result != ConnectivityResult.none,
      );
      if (!connected) {
        if (mounted) {
          setState(() {
            _online = false;
            _syncStatus = 'Offline';
          });
        }
        await _restoreCache();
        return;
      }

      final response = await http
          .get(
            Uri.https('jsonplaceholder.typicode.com', '/users'),
            headers: const {'Accept': 'application/json'},
          )
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));
      if (response.statusCode != 200) {
        throw Exception('API returned HTTP ${response.statusCode}.');
      }
      final decoded = jsonDecode(response.body);
      if (decoded is! List) {
        throw const FormatException('Invalid API response.');
      }
      final users = decoded
          .whereType<Map>()
          .map((item) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(item))
          .toList();
      final now = DateTime.now();
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.setString(_cacheKey, jsonEncode(users));
      await prefs.setString(_updatedKey, now.toIso8601String());
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _users = users;
        _lastUpdated = now;
        _online = true;
        _syncStatus = 'Sync Successful';
      });
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _online = false;
          _syncStatus = 'Sync Failed';
        });
      }
      await _restoreCache();
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _syncing = false);
    }
  }

  String _formatUpdated(DateTime? value) {
    if (value == null) return 'No successful sync yet';
    final local = value.toLocal();
    final date = '${local.month}/${local.day}/${local.year}';
    final hour = local.hour % 12 == 0 ? 12 : local.hour % 12;
    final minute = local.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    return '$date · $hour:$minute ${local.hour < 12 ? 'AM' : 'PM'}';
  }

  Widget _statusBadge(String label, bool active, Color color) => Container(
    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 5),
    decoration: BoxDecoration(
      color: active ? color.withValues(alpha: 0.12) : Colors.transparent,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
      border: Border.all(
        color: active ? color : Theme.of(context).dividerColor,
      ),
    ),
    child: Text(
      label,
      style: TextStyle(
        color: active ? color : Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
        fontSize: 10,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
      ),
    ),
  );

  Widget _syncStatusCard() {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 14, 16, 10),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: theme.cardColor,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        border: Border.all(color: theme.dividerColor),
        boxShadow: AppTokens.softCardShadow,
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              Icon(
                _online ? Icons.cloud_done_outlined : Icons.cloud_off_outlined,
                color: _online
                    ? const Color(0xFF2E7D32)
                    : theme.colorScheme.error,
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Text(
                _online ? 'Online' : _syncStatus,
                style: theme.textTheme.titleSmall?.copyWith(
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                ),
              ),
              const Spacer(),
              if (_syncing)
                const SizedBox(
                  width: 18,
                  height: 18,
                  child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
                ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text('Last updated · ${_formatUpdated(_lastUpdated)}'),
          Text('Users retrieved · ${_users.length}'),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          Wrap(
            spacing: 6,
            runSpacing: 6,
            children: [
              _statusBadge(
                'Sync Successful',
                _syncStatus == 'Sync Successful',
                const Color(0xFF2E7D32),
              ),
              _statusBadge(
                'Sync Failed',
                _syncStatus == 'Sync Failed',
                const Color(0xFFC62828),
              ),
              _statusBadge(
                'Offline',
                _syncStatus == 'Offline',
                const Color(0xFF6B7280),
              ),
              _statusBadge(
                'Mock Data',
                _syncStatus == 'Mock Data',
                const Color(0xFF7B2CBF),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _userCard(Map<String, dynamic> user) {
    final company = user['company'] is Map
        ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(user['company'] as Map)
        : <String, dynamic>{};
    final name = user['name'] as String? ?? 'Unknown user';
    final initials = name
        .trim()
        .split(RegExp(r'\s+'))
        .where((part) => part.isNotEmpty)
        .take(2)
        .map((part) => part[0].toUpperCase())
        .join();
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 0, 16, 10),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: theme.cardColor,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        border: Border.all(color: theme.dividerColor),
        boxShadow: AppTokens.softCardShadow,
      ),
      child: Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          CircleAvatar(
            backgroundColor: AppTokens.maroonPrimary,
            child: Text(
              initials.isEmpty ? 'U' : initials,
              style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 10),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text(name, style: theme.textTheme.titleSmall),
                Text(user['email'] as String? ?? 'No email listed'),
                Text('Phone · ${user['phone'] ?? 'Not listed'}'),
                Text('Company · ${company['name'] ?? 'Not listed'}'),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
    appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Online Directory')),
    body: Column(
      children: [
        _syncStatusCard(),
        Expanded(
          child: _users.isEmpty
              ? Center(
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                    child: Text(
                      _syncing ? 'Loading online directory…' : 'No cached user records are available. Connect to sync.',
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    ),
                  ),
                )
              : ListView.builder(
                  itemCount: _users.length,
                  itemBuilder: (context, index) => _userCard(_users[index]),
                ),
        ),
      ],
    ),
    floatingActionButton: FloatingActionButton.extended(
      onPressed: _syncing ? null : _sync,
      icon: const Icon(Icons.sync),
      label: const Text('Sync'),
    ),
  );
}

==> week_4/lib/summary_page.dart <==
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'services/storage_service.dart';
import 'services/file_service.dart';

class SummaryPage extends StatelessWidget {
  final Student student;
  final bool isUpdate;

  const SummaryPage({super.key, required this.student, this.isUpdate = false});

  Widget _detail(BuildContext context, String label, String value) {
    final colors = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    return ListTile(
      contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
      title: Text(
        label,
        style: TextStyle(color: colors.onSurfaceVariant, fontSize: 13),
      ),
      subtitle: Text(
        value.isEmpty ? 'Not provided' : value,
        style: TextStyle(
          color: colors.onSurface,
          fontSize: 16,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _export(BuildContext context) async {
    try {
      await FileService.exportStudents();
      final exportLocation = await FileService.getFilePath();

      if (!context.mounted) return;

      showDialog(
        context: context,
        builder: (dialogContext) => AlertDialog(
          icon: const Icon(Icons.check_circle, color: Colors.green, size: 42),
          title: const Text('Export Successful'),
          content: SelectableText(
            'Student information was exported to:\n\n$exportLocation',
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext),
              child: const Text('Done'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    } catch (error) {
      if (!context.mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
          .showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Export failed: $error')));
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Student Summary')),
      body: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
        children: [
          CircleAvatar(
            radius: 42,
            backgroundColor: Theme.of(context)
                .colorScheme
                .surfaceContainerHighest,
            child: Icon(
              Icons.person,
              size: 48,
              color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.secondary,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          Text(
            isUpdate ? 'Profile Updated' : 'Registration Complete',
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 23, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          Text(
            isUpdate
                ? 'Your student profile has been updated on this device.'
                : 'The student information has been saved on this device.',
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: TextStyle(
              color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 24),
          Card(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  const Text(
                    'Student Details',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 19, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                  ),
                  const Divider(height: 24),
                  _detail(context, 'Student Name', student.name),
                  _detail(context, 'Student ID', student.id),
                  _detail(context, 'Email', student.email),
                  _detail(context, 'Program', student.program),
                  _detail(context, 'Year Level', student.yearLevel),
                  _detail(context, 'Contact Number', student.contact),
                  _detail(context, 'Address', student.address),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 20),
          FilledButton.icon(
            onPressed: () => _export(context),
            icon: const Icon(Icons.file_download_outlined),
            label: const Text('Export Student Information'),
            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
              minimumSize: const Size.fromHeight(52),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          OutlinedButton.icon(
            onPressed: () =>
                Navigator.popUntil(context, (route) => route.isFirst),
            icon: const Icon(Icons.home_outlined),
            label: const Text('Back to Dashboard'),
            style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
              minimumSize: const Size.fromHeight(48),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
