import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'auth_page.dart';
import 'home_page.dart';
import 'services/app_preferences.dart';
import 'theme/app_theme.dart';

Future<void> main() async {
  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
  final preferences = AppPreferences();
  await preferences.load();
  runApp(LpuStudentApp(preferences: preferences));
}

class LpuStudentApp extends StatelessWidget {
  const LpuStudentApp({super.key, required this.preferences});

  final AppPreferences preferences;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AnimatedBuilder(
    animation: preferences,
    builder: (context, _) => MaterialApp(
      title: 'LPU-Cavite Student Dashboard',
      debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
      themeMode: preferences.themeMode,
      theme: AppTokens.buildTheme(Brightness.light),
      darkTheme: AppTokens.buildTheme(Brightness.dark),
      home: preferences.hasActiveSession
          ? HomePage(preferences: preferences)
          : AuthPage(preferences: preferences),
    ),
  );
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'services/portal_data_service.dart';
import 'widgets/faculty_card.dart';

class FacultyMember {
  final String name;
  final String department;
  final String email;
  final String phone;
  final String initials;

  const FacultyMember({
    required this.name,
    required this.department,
    required this.email,
    required this.phone,
    this.initials = 'J',
  });
}

class FacultyPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const FacultyPage({super.key, this.useMockData = false});

  final bool useMockData;

  @override
  State<FacultyPage> createState() => _FacultyPageState();
}

class _FacultyPageState extends State<FacultyPage> {
  final TextEditingController _searchController = TextEditingController();
  String _searchQuery = '';
  late Future<List<FacultyMember>> _facultyFuture;

  static const List<FacultyMember> _defaultFaculty = [
    FacultyMember(
      name: 'Dr. Jane Doe',
      department:
          'College of Information Technology and Computer Science (CCS)',
      email: '2024-2-00294@lpunetwork.edu.ph',
      phone: '+63 234 508 2435',
      initials: 'J',
    ),
    FacultyMember(
      name: 'Dr. Jane Doe',
      department:
          'College of Information Technology and Computer Science (CCS)',
      email: '2024-2-00294@lpunetwork.edu.ph',
      phone: '+63 234 508 2435',
      initials: 'J',
    ),
    FacultyMember(
      name: 'Dr. Jane Doe',
      department:
          'College of Information Technology and Computer Science (CCS)',
      email: '2024-2-00294@lpunetwork.edu.ph',
      phone: '+63 234 508 2435',
      initials: 'J',
    ),
    FacultyMember(
      name: 'Dr. Jane Doe',
      department:
          'College of Information Technology and Computer Science (CCS)',
      email: '2024-2-00294@lpunetwork.edu.ph',
      phone: '+63 234 508 2435',
      initials: 'J',
    ),
    FacultyMember(
      name: 'Dr. Jane Doe',
      department:
          'College of Information Technology and Computer Science (CCS)',
      email: '2024-2-00294@lpunetwork.edu.ph',
      phone: '+63 234 508 2435',
      initials: 'J',
    ),
    FacultyMember(
      name: 'Dr. Jane Doe',
      department:
          'College of Information Technology and Computer Science (CCS)',
      email: '2024-2-00294@lpunetwork.edu.ph',
      phone: '+63 234 508 2435',
      initials: 'J',
    ),
  ];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _facultyFuture = _loadFaculty();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant FacultyPage oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.useMockData != widget.useMockData) {
      setState(() {
        _facultyFuture = _loadFaculty();
      });
    }
  }

  Future<List<FacultyMember>> _loadFaculty() async {
    if (!widget.useMockData) return _defaultFaculty;
    final users = await PortalDataService.fetchUsers();
    return users.map((user) {
      return FacultyMember(
        name: user['name'] as String? ?? 'Faculty member',
        department: user['company'] is Map
            ? (user['company'] as Map)['name'] as String? ?? 'Academic Affairs'
            : 'Academic Affairs',
        email: user['email'] as String? ?? '',
        phone: user['phone'] as String? ?? '',
        initials: (user['name'] as String? ?? 'F')
            .trim()
            .split(RegExp(r'\s+'))
            .where((part) => part.isNotEmpty)
            .take(2)
            .map((part) => part[0].toUpperCase())
            .join(),
      );
    }).toList();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _showFilterSheet() {
    showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      showDragHandle: true,
      builder: (context) => SafeArea(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 8, 20, 24),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              const Text(
                'Filter Faculty',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              ListTile(
                leading: const Icon(Icons.school, color: Color(0xFF800000)),
                title: const Text('All Departments'),
                onTap: () {
                  setState(() => _searchQuery = '');
                  _searchController.clear();
                  Navigator.pop(context);
                },
              ),
              ListTile(
                leading: const Icon(Icons.computer, color: Color(0xFF800000)),
                title: const Text('Computer Studies (CCS)'),
                onTap: () {
                  setState(() => _searchQuery = 'CCS');
                  _searchController.text = 'CCS';
                  Navigator.pop(context);
                },
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final cardColor = Theme.of(context).cardColor;
    final borderColor = Theme.of(context).dividerColor;
    return Scaffold(
      body: SafeArea(
        child: FutureBuilder<List<FacultyMember>>(
          future: _facultyFuture,
          builder: (context, snapshot) {
            final source =
                snapshot.data ??
                (widget.useMockData ? <FacultyMember>[] : _defaultFaculty);
            final filtered = source.where((f) {
              if (_searchQuery.isEmpty) return true;
              final q = _searchQuery.toLowerCase();
              return f.name.toLowerCase().contains(q) ||
                  f.department.toLowerCase().contains(q) ||
                  f.email.toLowerCase().contains(q);
            }).toList();
            return ListView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 14),
              children: [
                if (snapshot.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting)
                  const LinearProgressIndicator(),
                if (snapshot.hasError)
                  Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                    child: Text(
                      'Could not load faculty mock data: ${snapshot.error}',
                    ),
                  ),
                // Search Bar with Filter Icon
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Expanded(
                      child: Container(
                        height: 44,
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: cardColor,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                          border: Border.all(color: borderColor),
                        ),
                        child: TextField(
                          controller: _searchController,
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontFamily: 'Inter',
                            fontSize: 14,
                            color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurface,
                          ),
                          onChanged: (val) =>
                              setState(() => _searchQuery = val.trim()),
                          decoration: InputDecoration(
                            hintText: 'Search faculty...',
                            hintStyle: TextStyle(
                              fontFamily: 'Inter',
                              color: Theme.of(context)
                                  .colorScheme
                                  .onSurfaceVariant,
                              fontSize: 14,
                            ),
                            prefixIcon: Icon(
                              Icons.search,
                              color: Theme.of(context)
                                  .colorScheme
                                  .onSurfaceVariant,
                              size: 20,
                            ),
                            contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                              vertical: 10,
                              horizontal: 12,
                            ),
                            border: InputBorder.none,
                            enabledBorder: InputBorder.none,
                            focusedBorder: InputBorder.none,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 10),
                    Container(
                      height: 44,
                      width: 44,
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: cardColor,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                        border: Border.all(color: borderColor),
                      ),
                      child: IconButton(
                        icon: Icon(
                          Icons.tune,
                          color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                          size: 20,
                        ),
                        onPressed: _showFilterSheet,
                        tooltip: 'Filter',
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                if (filtered.isEmpty)
                  Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: cardColor,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                      border: Border.all(color: borderColor),
                    ),
                    child: Center(
                      child: Column(
                        children: [
                          Icon(
                            Icons.search_off,
                            size: 40,
                            color: Theme.of(context)
                                .colorScheme
                                .onSurfaceVariant,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 8),
                          Text(
                            'No faculty members found',
                            style: TextStyle(
                              color: Theme.of(context)
                                  .colorScheme
                                  .onSurfaceVariant,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  )
                else
                  for (final faculty in filtered)
                    FacultyCard(
                      name: faculty.name,
                      department: faculty.department,
                      email: faculty.email,
                      phone: faculty.phone,
                      initials: faculty.initials,
                      onEmailTap: () {
                        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                          SnackBar(
                            content: Text(
                              'Composing email to ${faculty.email}',
                            ),
                          ),
                        );
                      },
                      onCallTap: () {
                        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                          SnackBar(content: Text('Calling ${faculty.phone}')),
                        );
                      },
                    ),
              ],
            );
          },
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

==> week_4/lib/registration_page.dart <==
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'services/storage_service.dart';
import 'summary_page.dart';

class RegistrationPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const RegistrationPage({
    super.key,
    this.student,
    this.isProfileEditor = false,
  });

  final Student? student;
  final bool isProfileEditor;

  @override
  State<RegistrationPage> createState() => _RegistrationPageState();
}

class _RegistrationPageState extends State<RegistrationPage> {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();

  final _nameController = TextEditingController(text: 'Juan Dela Cruz');
  final _idController = TextEditingController();
  final _emailController = TextEditingController();
  final _contactController = TextEditingController();
  final _addressController = TextEditingController();
  final _gradeController = TextEditingController();

  String? _program;
  String? _yearLevel;
  bool _saving = false;

  final List<String> _programs = [
    'BSIT',
    'BSCS',
    'BSIS',
    'BSIT-NS',
    'BSIT-WM',
    'BSCS-DS',
    'BSCS-SE',
    'BS Information Technology',
    'BS Computer Science',
    'BS Business Administration',
    'BS Hospitality Management',
  ];

  final List<String> _yearLevels = [
    '1st Year',
    '2nd Year',
    '3rd Year',
    '4th Year',
    '5th Year',
  ];

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _nameController.dispose();
    _idController.dispose();
    _emailController.dispose();
    _contactController.dispose();
    _addressController.dispose();
    _gradeController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final student = widget.student;
    if (student == null) return;
    _nameController.text = student.name;
    _idController.text = student.id;
    _emailController.text = student.email;
    _contactController.text = student.contact;
    _addressController.text = student.address;
    _gradeController.text = student.grade.toStringAsFixed(1);
    if (_programs.contains(student.program)) _program = student.program;
    if (_yearLevels.contains(student.yearLevel)) _yearLevel = student.yearLevel;
  }

  Future<void> _saveStudent() async {
    if (!_formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;

    if (_program == null || _yearLevel == null) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Please select a program and year level.'),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    setState(() => _saving = true);

    final student = Student(
      name: _nameController.text.trim(),
      id: _idController.text.trim(),
      email: _emailController.text.trim(),
      program: _program!,
      yearLevel: _yearLevel!,
      contact: _contactController.text.trim(),
      address: _addressController.text.trim(),
      grade: double.parse(_gradeController.text.trim()),
    );

    try {
      if (widget.isProfileEditor) {
        await StorageService.saveProfile(student);
      } else if (widget.student == null) {
        await StorageService.saveStudent(student);
      } else {
        await StorageService.updateStudent(widget.student!.id, student);
      }

      if (!mounted) return;

      if (widget.isProfileEditor || widget.student != null) {
        Navigator.pop(context);
      } else {
        await Navigator.push(
          context,
          MaterialPageRoute(
            builder: (_) => SummaryPage(student: student, isUpdate: false),
          ),
        );
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;

      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text(error.toString().replaceFirst('Exception: ', '')),
        ),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _saving = false);
    }
  }

  Widget _textField(
    String label,
    TextEditingController controller, {
    String? hint,
    TextInputType keyboardType = TextInputType.text,
    String? Function(String?)? validator,
    IconData? icon,
    bool isRequired = true,
  }) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16),
      child: TextFormField(
        controller: controller,
        keyboardType: keyboardType,
        validator: validator,
        decoration: InputDecoration(
          label: _fieldLabel(label, isRequired),
          hintText: hint,
          prefixIcon: icon == null ? null : Icon(icon),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _fieldLabel(String label, [bool isRequired = true]) => RichText(
    text: TextSpan(
      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium,
      children: [
        TextSpan(text: label),
        if (isRequired)
          const TextSpan(
            text: ' *',
            style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFFD32F2F)),
          ),
      ],
    ),
  );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(
          widget.student == null ? 'Student Registration' : 'Edit Profile',
        ),
      ),
      body: Form(
        key: _formKey,
        autovalidateMode: AutovalidateMode.onUserInteraction,
        child: ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 20, 20, 32),
          children: [
            Text(
              widget.student == null
                  ? 'Student details'
                  : 'Edit student details',
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall
                  ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
            ),
            Text(
              'Fields marked with * are required. Contact number and address are optional.',
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 24),

            _textField(
              'Student Name',
              _nameController,
              icon: Icons.person_outline,
              validator: (value) => value == null || value.trim().isEmpty
                  ? 'Enter the student name'
                  : null,
            ),
            _textField(
              'Student ID',
              _idController,
              icon: Icons.badge_outlined,
              validator: (value) => value == null || value.trim().isEmpty
                  ? 'Enter the student ID'
                  : null,
            ),
            _textField(
              'Email Address',
              _emailController,
              icon: Icons.email_outlined,
              keyboardType: TextInputType.emailAddress,
              validator: (value) {
                if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty) {
                  return 'Enter the email address';
                }
                if (!RegExp(r'^[^@]+@[^@]+\.[^@]+$').hasMatch(value.trim())) {
                  return 'Enter a valid email address';
                }
                return null;
              },
            ),

            DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
              initialValue: _program,
              isExpanded: true,
              validator: (value) => value == null ? 'Select a program' : null,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                label: _fieldLabel('Program'),
                prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.school_outlined),
              ),
              items: _programs
                  .map(
                    (program) =>
                        DropdownMenuItem(value: program, child: Text(program)),
                  )
                  .toList(),
              onChanged: (value) => setState(() => _program = value),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),

            DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
              initialValue: _yearLevel,
              validator: (value) =>
                  value == null ? 'Select a year level' : null,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                label: _fieldLabel('Year level'),
                prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.calendar_month_outlined),
              ),
              items: _yearLevels
                  .map(
                    (year) => DropdownMenuItem(value: year, child: Text(year)),
                  )
                  .toList(),
              onChanged: (value) => setState(() => _yearLevel = value),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),

            _textField(
              'Grade (0–100)',
              _gradeController,
              icon: Icons.grade_outlined,
              keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(
                decimal: true,
              ),
              validator: (value) {
                final grade = double.tryParse(value?.trim() ?? '');
                if (grade == null || grade < 0 || grade > 100) {
                  return 'Enter a grade between 0 and 100';
                }
                return null;
              },
            ),

            _textField(
              'Contact Number (Optional)',
              _contactController,
              icon: Icons.phone_outlined,
              keyboardType: TextInputType.phone,
              isRequired: false,
            ),
            _textField(
              'Address (Optional)',
              _addressController,
              icon: Icons.home_outlined,
              isRequired: false,
            ),

            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            FilledButton.icon(
              onPressed: _saving ? null : _saveStudent,
              icon: _saving
                  ? const SizedBox(
                      width: 18,
                      height: 18,
                      child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
                    )
                  : const Icon(Icons.save_outlined),
              label: Text(
                _saving
                    ? 'Saving...'
                    : widget.student == null
                    ? 'Save Student'
                    : 'Update Student',
              ),
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                minimumSize: const Size.fromHeight(52),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

class HomePage extends StatefulWidget {
  const HomePage({super.key, required this.preferences});

  final AppPreferences preferences;

  @override
  State<HomePage> createState() => _HomePageState();
}

class _HomePageState extends State<HomePage> {
  int _selectedIndex = 0;
  bool _hasUnreadNotifications = true;
  final _dashboardKey = GlobalKey<_DashboardPageState>();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    widget.preferences.addListener(_onPreferencesChanged);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    widget.preferences.removeListener(_onPreferencesChanged);
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _onPreferencesChanged() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  Future<void> _refreshDashboard() async {
    await _dashboardKey.currentState?._refreshDashboard();
  }

  Future<void> _openRegistration() async {
    await Navigator.push<void>(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const RegistrationPage()),
    );
    await _refreshDashboard();
  }

  void _openSettings() {
    setState(() => _selectedIndex = 3);
  }

  void _showNotifications() {
    setState(() => _hasUnreadNotifications = false);
    showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      showDragHandle: true,
      builder: (context) => SafeArea(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 8, 20, 24),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              const Text(
                'Recent notifications',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 20, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              FutureBuilder<List<RecentActivity>>(
                future: StorageService.getRecentActivity(),
                builder: (context, snapshot) {
                  if (snapshot.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting) {
                    return const ListTile(
                      leading: SizedBox(
                        width: 22,
                        height: 22,
                        child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
                      ),
                      title: Text('Loading notifications'),
                    );
                  }
                  if (snapshot.hasError) {
                    return ListTile(
                      leading: const Icon(Icons.warning_amber_outlined),
                      title: const Text('Could not load notifications'),
                      subtitle: Text('${snapshot.error}'),
                    );
                  }
                  final activities = (snapshot.data ?? []).take(4).toList();
                  if (activities.isEmpty) {
                    return const ListTile(
                      leading: Icon(Icons.notifications_none),
                      title: Text('No recent notifications'),
                    );
                  }
                  return Column(
                    children: [
                      for (final activity in activities)
                        ListTile(
                          leading: const Icon(Icons.notifications_none),
                          title: Text(activity.title),
                          subtitle: Text(activity.detail),
                          trailing: Text(
                            _formatActivityTime(activity.timestamp),
                          ),
                        ),
                    ],
                  );
                },
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  String _formatActivityTime(DateTime time) {
    final elapsed = DateTime.now().difference(time);
    if (elapsed.inMinutes < 1) return 'Now';
    if (elapsed.inHours < 1) return '${elapsed.inMinutes}m';
    if (elapsed.inDays < 1) return '${elapsed.inHours}h';
    return '${elapsed.inDays}d';
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    const maroonColor = Color(0xFF800000);

    final pages = [
      DashboardPage(
        key: _dashboardKey,
        preferences: widget.preferences,
        onOpenSettings: _openSettings,
        onRegisterStudent: _openRegistration,
      ),
      StudentsPage(
        key: const ValueKey<String>('portal-students-page'),
        useMockData: widget.preferences.useMockData,
      ),
      FacultyPage(
        key: const ValueKey<String>('portal-faculty-page'),
        useMockData: widget.preferences.useMockData,
      ),
      SettingsPage(
        key: const ValueKey<String>('portal-settings'),
        preferences: widget.preferences,
        onRefreshCache: _refreshDashboard,
        showAppBar: false,
      ),
    ];

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor: maroonColor,
        elevation: 0,
        leadingWidth: 48,
        leading: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 12),
          child: Image.asset(
            'assets/img/lpu-logo.png',
            fit: BoxFit.contain,
            errorBuilder: (context, error, stackTrace) =>
                const Icon(Icons.school, size: 26, color: Colors.white),
          ),
        ),
        title: const Text(
          'LPU-Cavite Student Dashboard',
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: 16,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
            color: Colors.white,
          ),
        ),
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            tooltip: 'About LPU',
            icon: const Icon(Icons.info_outline, size: 24, color: Colors.white),
            onPressed: () => showAboutLpuModal(context),
          ),
          IconButton(
            tooltip: 'Notifications',
            icon: Stack(
              clipBehavior: Clip.none,
              children: [
                const Icon(
                  Icons.notifications_outlined,
                  size: 24,
                  color: Colors.white,
                ),
                if (_hasUnreadNotifications)
                  Positioned(
                    right: 0,
                    top: 0,
                    child: Container(
                      width: 8,
                      height: 8,
                      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                        color: Colors.white,
                        shape: BoxShape.circle,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
            onPressed: _showNotifications,
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
        ],
      ),
      body: IndexedStack(index: _selectedIndex, children: pages),
      bottomNavigationBar: BottomNavigationBar(
        currentIndex: _selectedIndex,
        onTap: (index) {
          setState(() {
            _selectedIndex = index;
            _hasUnreadNotifications = true;
          });
          const sections = ['Home', 'Students', 'Faculty', 'Settings'];
          StorageService.recordActivity(
            'Opened ${sections[index]}',
            'Portal navigation',
          ).then((_) => _dashboardKey.currentState?._refreshActivity());
        },
        type: BottomNavigationBarType.fixed,
        selectedFontSize: 12,
        unselectedFontSize: 12,
        elevation: 8,
        items: const [
          BottomNavigationBarItem(
            icon: Icon(Icons.home_outlined),
            activeIcon: Icon(Icons.home),
            label: 'Home',
          ),
          BottomNavigationBarItem(
            icon: Icon(Icons.people_outline),
            activeIcon: Icon(Icons.people),
            label: 'Users',
          ),
          BottomNavigationBarItem(
            icon: Icon(Icons.badge_outlined),
            activeIcon: Icon(Icons.badge),
            label: 'Faculty',
          ),
          BottomNavigationBarItem(
            icon: Icon(Icons.settings_outlined),
            activeIcon: Icon(Icons.settings),
            label: 'Settings',
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class DashboardPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const DashboardPage({
    super.key,
    required this.preferences,
    required this.onOpenSettings,
    required this.onRegisterStudent,
  });

  final AppPreferences preferences;
  final VoidCallback onOpenSettings;
  final VoidCallback onRegisterStudent;

  @override
  State<DashboardPage> createState() => _DashboardPageState();
}

class _DashboardPageState extends State<DashboardPage> {
  static const double _caviteLatitude = 14.386;
  static const double _caviteLongitude = 120.881;

  late Future<List<Student>> _studentsFuture;
  late Future<Student?> _profileStudentFuture;
  late Future<Map<String, dynamic>> _weatherFuture;
  late Future<HolidayCalendarData> _calendarFuture;
  late Future<String> _apiStatusFuture;
  late Future<String> _wifiStatusFuture;
  late Future<String> _gpsStatusFuture;
  late Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> _onlineUsersFuture;
  StreamSubscription<List<ConnectivityResult>>? _connectivitySubscription;
  bool _isWifiConnected = false;
  bool _hasConnectivityUpdate = false;
  bool _isGpsActive = true;
  String _gpsStatusLabel = 'Checking';
  String _weatherLocationLabel = 'LPU Cavite';
  late DateTime _clockNow;
  Timer? _clockTimer;
  int _studentCount = 0;
  late Future<List<RecentActivity>> _activityFuture;
  late DateTime _selectedCalendarDate;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _connectivitySubscription = Connectivity().onConnectivityChanged.listen(
      _handleConnectivityChange,
    );
    _clockNow = DateTime.now();
    _selectedCalendarDate = DateTime.now();
    _clockTimer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 30), (_) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _clockNow = DateTime.now());
    });
    _reloadDashboard();
    _refreshLocationAndWeather(
      announce: false,
      openSettingsIfDeniedForever: false,
    );
    _recordDashboardOpen();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _clockTimer?.cancel();
    _connectivitySubscription?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _reloadDashboard() {
    _studentsFuture = StorageService.getStudents();
    _profileStudentFuture = StorageService.getProfile();
    _activityFuture = StorageService.getRecentActivity();
    _weatherFuture = _fetchWeather();
    _calendarFuture = _fetchCalendar();
    _apiStatusFuture = _checkApiStatus();
    _onlineUsersFuture = PortalDataService.fetchUsers();
    _wifiStatusFuture = _checkWifiStatus();
    _gpsStatusFuture = _checkGpsStatus();
    _studentsFuture.then(
      (students) {
        if (mounted) {
          setState(() {
            _studentCount = students.length;
          });
        }
      },
      onError: (Object error, StackTrace stackTrace) {
        debugPrint('Could not load student count: $error');
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> _recordDashboardOpen() async {
    await StorageService.recordActivity('Portal session started', 'Home');
    await StorageService.recordActivity('Dashboard opened', 'Home overview');
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => _activityFuture = StorageService.getRecentActivity());
  }

  void _refreshActivity() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => _activityFuture = StorageService.getRecentActivity());
  }

  Future<String> _checkApiStatus() async {
    try {
      final connectivity = await Connectivity().checkConnectivity();
      if (connectivity.every((result) => result == ConnectivityResult.none)) {
        return 'Offline (using cached data)';
      }
      await Future.wait([
        _weatherFuture,
        _calendarFuture.then((calendar) {
          if (calendar.isOffline) {
            throw const FormatException(
              'Public holidays are using offline data.',
            );
          }
        }),
        http
            .get(Uri.parse('https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users'))
            .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10))
            .then((response) {
              if (response.statusCode != 200) {
                throw Exception('API returned ${response.statusCode}');
              }
            }),
      ]);
      return 'Online';
    } catch (error) {
      return 'Active';
    }
  }

  Future<String> _checkWifiStatus() async {
    try {
      final results = await Connectivity().checkConnectivity();
      _handleConnectivityChange(results, announce: false);
      return _isWifiConnected ? 'Connected' : 'Disconnected';
    } catch (_) {
      _handleConnectivityChange(const [
        ConnectivityResult.none,
      ], announce: false);
      return 'Disconnected';
    }
  }

  void _handleConnectivityChange(
    List<ConnectivityResult> results, {
    bool announce = true,
  }) {
    final isConnected = results.any(
      (result) => result != ConnectivityResult.none,
    );
    final wasInitialized = _hasConnectivityUpdate;
    final changed = isConnected != _isWifiConnected;
    _hasConnectivityUpdate = true;
    if (!changed && wasInitialized) return;

    if (!mounted) {
      _isWifiConnected = isConnected;
      return;
    }

    setState(() {
      _isWifiConnected = isConnected;
      _wifiStatusFuture = Future.value(
        isConnected ? 'Connected' : 'Disconnected',
      );
      PortalDataService.resetInFlightRequest();
      _reloadDashboard();
    });

    if (changed && wasInitialized && announce) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text(
            isConnected
                ? 'Connection restored. Portal data is syncing.'
                : 'You are offline. Showing locally cached portal data.',
          ),
          duration: const Duration(seconds: 3),
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<String> _checkGpsStatus() async {
    try {
      final enabled = await Geolocator.isLocationServiceEnabled();
      final permission = await Geolocator.checkPermission();
      final label = !enabled
          ? 'Location off'
          : permission == LocationPermission.deniedForever
          ? 'Allow in settings'
          : permission == LocationPermission.denied
          ? 'Permission needed'
          : 'Active';
      final available = label == 'Active';
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _isGpsActive = available;
          _gpsStatusLabel = label;
        });
      }
      return label;
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _isGpsActive = false;
          _gpsStatusLabel = 'Unavailable';
        });
      }
      return 'Unavailable';
    }
  }

  Future<void> _refreshLocationAndWeather({
    bool announce = true,
    bool openSettingsIfDeniedForever = true,
  }) async {
    try {
      var permission = await Geolocator.checkPermission();
      if (permission == LocationPermission.denied) {
        permission = await Geolocator.requestPermission();
      }
      if (permission == LocationPermission.deniedForever &&
          openSettingsIfDeniedForever) {
        await Geolocator.openAppSettings();
      }
    } catch (_) {
      // Weather falls back to the LPU Cavite coordinates if location is unavailable.
    }
    setState(() {
      _gpsStatusFuture = _checkGpsStatus();
      _weatherFuture = _fetchWeather();
    });
    final status = await _gpsStatusFuture;
    await _weatherFuture;
    if (mounted && announce) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text(
            'GPS & Weather Synced ($status): $_weatherLocationLabel',
          ),
          duration: const Duration(seconds: 2),
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _refreshDashboard() async {
    setState(_reloadDashboard);
    try {
      await Future.wait([
        _studentsFuture,
        _weatherFuture,
        _calendarFuture,
        _onlineUsersFuture,
      ]);
    } catch (error) {
      debugPrint('Dashboard refresh error: $error');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _openOnlineDirectory() async {
    await Navigator.push<void>(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (_) =>
            OnlineDirectoryPage(useMockData: widget.preferences.useMockData),
      ),
    );
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() => _onlineUsersFuture = PortalDataService.fetchUsers());
    }
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> _fetchWeather() async {
    try {
      var latitude = _caviteLatitude;
      var longitude = _caviteLongitude;
      var locationLabel = 'LPU Cavite';
      final locationEnabled = await Geolocator.isLocationServiceEnabled();
      final permission = await Geolocator.checkPermission();
      if (locationEnabled &&
          (permission == LocationPermission.whileInUse ||
              permission == LocationPermission.always)) {
        final position = await Geolocator.getCurrentPosition(
          locationSettings: const LocationSettings(
            accuracy: LocationAccuracy.medium,
            timeLimit: Duration(seconds: 8),
          ),
        );
        latitude = position.latitude;
        longitude = position.longitude;
        locationLabel = await _resolveLocationName(latitude, longitude);
        _isGpsActive = true;
      }
      _weatherLocationLabel = locationLabel;
      final uri = Uri.https('api.open-meteo.com', '/v1/forecast', {
        'latitude': '$latitude',
        'longitude': '$longitude',
        'current': 'temperature_2m,relative_humidity_2m,apparent_temperature,weather_code,wind_speed_10m',
        'timezone': 'auto',
      });
      final response = await http.get(uri).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));
      if (response.statusCode != 200) {
        throw Exception('Weather API returned ${response.statusCode}');
      }
      final decoded = jsonDecode(response.body);
      if (decoded is Map<String, dynamic> &&
          decoded['current'] is Map<String, dynamic>) {
        return Map<String, dynamic>.from(decoded['current'] as Map);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Weather fetch error: $e');
    }
    return {
      'temperature_2m': 31,
      'relative_humidity_2m': 56,
      'wind_speed_10m': 7,
      'weather_code': 0,
    };
  }

  Future<String> _resolveLocationName(double latitude, double longitude) async {
    try {
      final places = await Geocoding().placemarkFromCoordinates(
        latitude,
        longitude,
      );
      if (places.isNotEmpty) {
        final place = places.first;
        const broadAreas = {
          'cavite',
          'calabarzon',
          'region iv-a',
          'philippines',
        };
        final localityCandidates =
            [place.locality, place.subAdministrativeArea, place.subLocality]
                .whereType<String>()
                .map((value) => value.trim())
                .where(
                  (value) =>
                      value.isNotEmpty &&
                      !broadAreas.contains(value.toLowerCase()),
                );
        final locality = localityCandidates.firstOrNull;
        if (locality != null) {
          final region = [place.subAdministrativeArea, place.administrativeArea]
              .whereType<String>()
              .map((value) => value.trim())
              .firstWhere(
                (value) =>
                    value.isNotEmpty &&
                    value.toLowerCase() != locality.toLowerCase() &&
                    !{
                      'calabarzon',
                      'region iv-a',
                      'philippines',
                    }.contains(value.toLowerCase()),
                orElse: () => '',
              );
          final parts = [
            locality,
            region,
          ].where((part) => part.isNotEmpty).toList();
          return parts.join(', ');
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      debugPrint('Reverse geocoding failed: $error');
    }
    return 'GPS ${latitude.toStringAsFixed(3)}, ${longitude.toStringAsFixed(3)}';
  }

  Future<HolidayCalendarData> _fetchCalendar() =>
      PublicHolidayService.fetch(year: _selectedCalendarDate.year);

  void _selectCalendarDate(DateTime date) {
    final yearChanged = date.year != _selectedCalendarDate.year;
    setState(() {
      _selectedCalendarDate = date;
      if (yearChanged) {
        _calendarFuture = PublicHolidayService.fetch(year: date.year);
        _apiStatusFuture = _checkApiStatus();
      }
    });
  }

  Future<void> _showReports() async {
    await showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Dashboard Report'),
        content: Text(
          'Total registered student records: $_studentCount\n'
          'CCS Programs: 4\n'
          'Active Students: 401\n'
          'Average Attendance: 93%',
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
            child: const Text('Close'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _showDeviceInfo() async {
    final size = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context);
    final platform = Theme.of(context).platform.name;
    final orientation = MediaQuery.orientationOf(context).name;
    await showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Device Information'),
        content: Text(
          'Platform: $platform\n'
          'Resolution: ${size.width.round()} × ${size.height.round()} dp\n'
          'Orientation: $orientation\n'
          'Status: Normal',
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
            child: const Text('Close'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _showApiStatus() async {
    setState(() {
      _weatherFuture = _fetchWeather();
      _calendarFuture = _fetchCalendar();
      _apiStatusFuture = _checkApiStatus();
    });
    await _showStatusDialog(
      'API Status',
      _apiStatusFuture,
      'Weather, Public Holiday, and Portal APIs are connected.',
    );
  }

  Future<void> _showNetworkStatus() async {
    setState(() => _wifiStatusFuture = _checkWifiStatus());
    await _showStatusDialog(
      'Network Status',
      _wifiStatusFuture,
      'When there is no network, student and faculty data is read from the local cache.',
    );
  }

  Future<void> _showStatusDialog(
    String title,
    Future<String> status,
    String description,
  ) async {
    await showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
        title: Text(title),
        content: FutureBuilder<String>(
          future: status,
          builder: (context, snapshot) {
            if (snapshot.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting) {
              return const SizedBox(
                height: 50,
                child: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
              );
            }
            if (snapshot.hasError) {
              return Text('Status: ${snapshot.error}');
            }
            return Text('${snapshot.data}\n\n$description');
          },
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
            child: const Text('Close'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showFullProfile({
    required String name,
    required String studentId,
    required String email,
    required String program,
    required String yearLevel,
    required String contact,
    required String address,
  }) {
    showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      showDragHandle: true,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      builder: (context) => SafeArea(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 8, 20, 24),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Text(
                name,
                style: const TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 20,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 4),
              Text(
                '$program • $yearLevel',
                style: const TextStyle(
                  color: Color(0xFF800000),
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                ),
              ),
              const Divider(height: 24),
              ListTile(
                contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                leading: const Icon(
                  Icons.badge_outlined,
                  color: Color(0xFF800000),
                ),
                title: const Text('Student ID'),
                subtitle: Text(studentId),
              ),
              ListTile(
                contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                leading: const Icon(
                  Icons.email_outlined,
                  color: Color(0xFF800000),
                ),
                title: const Text('Email'),
                subtitle: Text(email),
              ),
              if (contact.isNotEmpty)
                ListTile(
                  contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                  leading: const Icon(
                    Icons.phone_outlined,
                    color: Color(0xFF800000),
                  ),
                  title: const Text('Contact'),
                  subtitle: Text(contact),
                ),
              if (address.isNotEmpty)
                ListTile(
                  contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                  leading: const Icon(
                    Icons.location_on_outlined,
                    color: Color(0xFF800000),
                  ),
                  title: const Text('Address'),
                  subtitle: Text(address),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // 1. Weather Header Card Widget (Overflow-safe with GPS sync)
  Widget _buildWeatherHeader() {
    final hour = _clockNow.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    final minute = _clockNow.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    final timeStr = '$hour:$minute';
    const weekdays = [
      'Monday',
      'Tuesday',
      'Wednesday',
      'Thursday',
      'Friday',
      'Saturday',
      'Sunday',
    ];
    const months = [
      'January',
      'February',
      'March',
      'April',
      'May',
      'June',
      'July',
      'August',
      'September',
      'October',
      'November',
      'December',
    ];
    final dateStr =
        '${weekdays[_clockNow.weekday - 1]}, ${_clockNow.day} ${months[_clockNow.month - 1]} ${_clockNow.year}';

    return FutureBuilder<Map<String, dynamic>>(
      future: _weatherFuture,
      builder: (context, snapshot) {
        final data = snapshot.data;
        final temp = (data?['temperature_2m'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 31;
        final wind = (data?['wind_speed_10m'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 7;
        final humidity = (data?['relative_humidity_2m'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 56;

        return WeatherHeaderCardWidget(
          temperature: temp,
          condition: 'Sunny',
          windSpeed: wind,
          humidity: humidity,
          time: timeStr,
          date: dateStr,
          location: _weatherLocationLabel,
          isGpsActive: _isGpsActive,
          onLocationTap: () => _refreshLocationAndWeather(),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  // 2. User Overview Card Widget
  Widget _buildDashboardStatistics() => FutureBuilder<List<Student>>(
    future: _studentsFuture,
    builder: (context, studentSnapshot) {
      final students = studentSnapshot.data ?? const <Student>[];
      final averageGrade = students.isEmpty
          ? 0.0
          : students.fold<double>(0, (sum, student) => sum + student.grade) /
                students.length;
      Student? topPerformer;
      for (final student in students) {
        if (topPerformer == null || student.grade > topPerformer.grade) {
          topPerformer = student;
        }
      }

      return GridView.count(
        crossAxisCount: 2,
        crossAxisSpacing: 10,
        mainAxisSpacing: 10,
        childAspectRatio: 1.48,
        shrinkWrap: true,
        physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
        children: [
          _dashboardStatCard(
            title: 'Total Students',
            value: studentSnapshot.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting
                ? '…'
                : '${students.length}',
            subtitle: 'Saved student records',
            icon: Icons.people_outline,
          ),
          _dashboardStatCard(
            title: 'Average Grade',
            value: '${averageGrade.toStringAsFixed(1)}%',
            subtitle: 'Across registered students',
            icon: Icons.insights_outlined,
          ),
          _dashboardStatCard(
            title: 'Top Performer',
            value: topPerformer?.name ?? 'No records',
            subtitle: topPerformer == null
                ? 'Highest grade unavailable'
                : 'Highest grade · ${topPerformer.grade.toStringAsFixed(1)}%',
            icon: Icons.emoji_events_outlined,
          ),
          FutureBuilder<List<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
            future: _onlineUsersFuture,
            builder: (context, onlineSnapshot) => _dashboardStatCard(
              title: 'Online Users',
              value: onlineSnapshot.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting
                  ? '…'
                  : '${onlineSnapshot.data?.length ?? 0}',
              subtitle: 'JSONPlaceholder API data',
              icon: Icons.cloud_done_outlined,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      );
    },
  );

  Widget _dashboardStatCard({
    required String title,
    required String value,
    required String subtitle,
    required IconData icon,
  }) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: theme.cardColor,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        border: Border.all(color: theme.dividerColor),
        boxShadow: AppTokens.softCardShadow,
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              Icon(icon, size: 17, color: AppTokens.maroonPrimary),
              const SizedBox(width: 6),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  title,
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: theme.textTheme.labelMedium?.copyWith(
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          Text(
            value,
            maxLines: 1,
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            style: theme.textTheme.titleLarge?.copyWith(
              fontSize: title == 'Top Performer' ? 15 : 22,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
            ),
          ),
          Text(
            subtitle,
            maxLines: 1,
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(fontSize: 10),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildOverviewCard() {
    return FutureBuilder<Student?>(
      future: _profileStudentFuture,
      builder: (context, snapshot) {
        final student = snapshot.data;
        final name = student?.name ?? 'Student profile';
        final id = student?.id ?? 'Register a student to complete your profile';
        final program = student?.program ?? '';
        final year = student?.yearLevel ?? '';
        final email = student?.email ?? '';
        return OverviewCardWidget(
          name: name,
          studentId: id,
          program: program,
          yearLevel: year,
          email: email,
          profilePhotoBytes: widget.preferences.profilePhotoBytes,
          onEditProfile: student == null
              ? widget.onRegisterStudent
              : () async {
                  await Navigator.push<void>(
                    context,
                    MaterialPageRoute(
                      builder: (_) => RegistrationPage(
                        student: student,
                        isProfileEditor: true,
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                  if (mounted) setState(_reloadDashboard);
                },
          onViewFullProfile: student == null
              ? widget.onRegisterStudent
              : () => _showFullProfile(
                  name: student.name,
                  studentId: student.id,
                  email: student.email,
                  program: student.program,
                  yearLevel: student.yearLevel,
                  contact: student.contact,
                  address: student.address,
                ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  // 3. Quick Actions Grid with dynamic network & GPS status
  Widget _buildQuickActions() {
    return GridView.count(
      crossAxisCount: 3,
      crossAxisSpacing: 10,
      mainAxisSpacing: 10,
      childAspectRatio: 1.25,
      shrinkWrap: true,
      physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
      children: [
        QuickActionButton(
          label: 'Device',
          icon: Icons.devices_outlined,
          onTap: _showDeviceInfo,
        ),
        QuickActionButton(
          label: 'GPS',
          icon: Icons.gps_fixed_outlined,
          statusDotColor: _isGpsActive
              ? const Color(0xFF2E7D32)
              : const Color(0xFFC62828),

          onTap: _refreshLocationAndWeather,

        QuickActionButton(
          label: 'API',

          onTap: _showApiStatus,
        ),
        QuickActionButton(
          label: 'Network',
          icon: Icons.wifi,
          statusDotColor: _isWifiConnected
              ? const Color(0xFF2E7D32)
              : const Color(0xFFC62828),
          statusText: _isWifiConnected ? 'Online' : 'Offline',
          onTap: _showNetworkStatus,
        ),
        QuickActionButton(
          label: 'Reports',
          icon: Icons.bar_chart_rounded,
          onTap: _showReports,

          label: 'Online Users',

          onTap: _openOnlineDirectory,
