==> week_4/lib/widgets/swipeable_week_calendar_widget.dart <==
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../services/public_holiday_service.dart';

class SwipeableWeekCalendarWidget extends StatefulWidget {
  const SwipeableWeekCalendarWidget({
    super.key,
    required this.selectedDate,
    required this.onDateSelected,
    this.eventText = 'No upcoming events.',
    this.holidays = const [],
    this.holidaysOffline = false,
  });

  final DateTime selectedDate;
  final ValueChanged<DateTime> onDateSelected;
  final String eventText;
  final List<PublicHoliday> holidays;
  final bool holidaysOffline;

  static const Color maroonColor = Color(0xFF800000);

  @override
  State<SwipeableWeekCalendarWidget> createState() =>
      _SwipeableWeekCalendarWidgetState();
}

class _SwipeableWeekCalendarWidgetState
    extends State<SwipeableWeekCalendarWidget> {
  static const int _initialPage = 5000;
  late final PageController _pageController;
  late DateTime _referenceMonday;
  late DateTime _currentDisplayedMonth;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    // Anchor reference Monday to the Monday of widget.selectedDate
    _referenceMonday = _findMonday(widget.selectedDate);
    _currentDisplayedMonth = widget.selectedDate;
    _pageController = PageController(initialPage: _initialPage);
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant SwipeableWeekCalendarWidget oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.selectedDate != widget.selectedDate) {
      _currentDisplayedMonth = widget.selectedDate;
      final newMonday = _findMonday(widget.selectedDate);
      final differenceInDays = newMonday.difference(_referenceMonday).inDays;
      final targetPage = _initialPage + (differenceInDays / 7).round();
      if (_pageController.hasClients &&
          _pageController.page?.round() != targetPage) {
        _pageController.jumpToPage(targetPage);
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _pageController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  DateTime _findMonday(DateTime date) {
    return DateTime(
      date.year,
      date.month,
      date.day,
    ).subtract(Duration(days: date.weekday - 1));
  }

  DateTime _getMondayForPage(int page) {
    final weekOffset = page - _initialPage;
    return _referenceMonday.add(Duration(days: weekOffset * 7));
  }

  String _monthName(int month) {
    const months = [
      'January',
      'February',
      'March',
      'April',
      'May',
      'June',
      'July',
      'August',
      'September',
      'October',
      'November',
      'December',
    ];
    return months[month - 1];
  }

  String _weekdayAbbreviation(int weekday) {
    const weekdays = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thur', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'];
    return weekdays[weekday - 1];
  }

  Future<void> _openMonthYearPicker() async {
    final picked = await showDatePicker(
      context: context,
      initialDate: widget.selectedDate,
      firstDate: DateTime(2020),
      lastDate: DateTime(2035),
      builder: (context, child) {
        final appTheme = Theme.of(context);
        final isDark = appTheme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
        return Theme(
          data: appTheme.copyWith(
            colorScheme: appTheme.colorScheme.copyWith(
              primary: isDark
                  ? const Color(0xFFE0B0B0)
                  : SwipeableWeekCalendarWidget.maroonColor,
              onPrimary: isDark ? const Color(0xFF171717) : Colors.white,
              onSurface: appTheme.colorScheme.onSurface,
            ),
          ),
          child: child ?? const SizedBox(),
        );
      },
    );

    if (picked != null) {
      widget.onDateSelected(picked);
      final targetMonday = _findMonday(picked);
      final offset = (targetMonday.difference(_referenceMonday).inDays / 7)
          .round();
      final targetPage = _initialPage + offset;
      if (_pageController.hasClients) {
        _pageController.animateToPage(
          targetPage,
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
          curve: Curves.easeInOut,
        );
      }
      setState(() {
        _currentDisplayedMonth = picked;
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final displayedTitle =
        '${_monthName(_currentDisplayedMonth.month)} ${_currentDisplayedMonth.year}';

    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: theme.cardColor,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        border: Border.all(color: theme.dividerColor),
        boxShadow: isDark
            ? null
            : [
                BoxShadow(
                  color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.03),
                  blurRadius: 4,
                  offset: const Offset(0, 2),
                ),
              ],
      ),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          // Month/Year Picker Button Header
          InkWell(
            onTap: _openMonthYearPicker,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 2, horizontal: 2),
              child: Row(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    displayedTitle,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 14,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 4),
                  Icon(
                    Icons.chevron_right,
                    size: 18,
                    color: isDark
                        ? const Color(0xFFE0B0B0)
                        : const Color(0xFF800000),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          // Swipeable Week View (PageView)
          SizedBox(
            height: 64,
            child: PageView.builder(
              controller: _pageController,
              onPageChanged: (page) {
                final monday = _getMondayForPage(page);
                final nextSelectedDate = monday.add(
                  Duration(days: widget.selectedDate.weekday - 1),
                );
                setState(() {
                  _currentDisplayedMonth = nextSelectedDate;
                });
                widget.onDateSelected(nextSelectedDate);
              },
              itemBuilder: (context, page) {
                final monday = _getMondayForPage(page);
                final days = List.generate(
                  7,
                  (i) => monday.add(Duration(days: i)),
                );

                return Row(
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                  children: days.map((day) {
                    final hasHoliday = widget.holidays.any(
                      (holiday) => DateUtils.isSameDay(holiday.date, day),
                    );
                    final isSelected =
                        day.year == widget.selectedDate.year &&
                        day.month == widget.selectedDate.month &&
                        day.day == widget.selectedDate.day;

                    return GestureDetector(
                      onTap: () {
                        widget.onDateSelected(day);
                      },
                      behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                      child: Column(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        children: [
                          Text(
                            _weekdayAbbreviation(day.weekday),
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 10,
                              color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 6),
                          Container(
                            width: 28,
                            height: 28,
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: isSelected
                                  ? (isDark
                                        ? const Color(0xFFE0B0B0)
                                        : SwipeableWeekCalendarWidget
                                              .maroonColor)
                                  : Colors.transparent,
                              shape: BoxShape.circle,
                            ),
                            alignment: Alignment.center,
                            child: Text(
                              '${day.day}',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 12,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                color: isSelected
                                    ? (isDark
                                          ? const Color(0xFF171717)
                                          : Colors.white)
                                    : theme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 3),
                          Container(
                            width: 4,
                            height: 4,
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: hasHoliday
                                  ? (isSelected
                                        ? theme.colorScheme.onPrimary
                                        : SwipeableWeekCalendarWidget
                                              .maroonColor)
                                  : Colors.transparent,
                              shape: BoxShape.circle,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    );
                  }).toList(),
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          const Divider(height: 1),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          _buildSelectedDateEvents(theme),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSelectedDateEvents(ThemeData theme) {
    final selectedHolidays = widget.holidays
        .where(
          (holiday) => DateUtils.isSameDay(holiday.date, widget.selectedDate),
        )
        .toList();
    if (selectedHolidays.isNotEmpty) {
      return Wrap(
        spacing: 6,
        runSpacing: 4,
        children: selectedHolidays
            .map(
              (holiday) => Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 5),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: const Color(0xFFF9EAEA),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                ),
                child: Row(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    const Icon(
                      Icons.celebration_outlined,
                      size: 14,
                      color: SwipeableWeekCalendarWidget.maroonColor,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 5),
                    Flexible(
                      child: Text(
                        holiday.name,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 11,
                          color: SwipeableWeekCalendarWidget.maroonColor,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            )
            .toList(),
      );
    }

    final message = widget.holidaysOffline
        ? widget.holidays.isEmpty
              ? 'Holiday dates are unavailable offline. Reconnect to sync.'
              : 'Offline · Showing saved Nager.Date holidays.'
        : widget.eventText;
    return Text(
      message,
      style: TextStyle(
        fontSize: 11,
        color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
      ),
    );
  }
}

// Flutter web plugin registrant file.
//
// Generated file. Do not edit.
//

// @dart = 2.13
// ignore_for_file: type=lint

import 'package:connectivity_plus/src/connectivity_plus_web.dart';
import 'package:geolocator_web/geolocator_web.dart';
import 'package:image_picker_for_web/image_picker_for_web.dart';
import 'package:permission_handler_html/permission_handler_html.dart';
import 'package:sensors_plus/src/sensors_plus_web.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences_web/shared_preferences_web.dart';
import 'package:flutter_web_plugins/flutter_web_plugins.dart';

void registerPlugins([final Registrar? pluginRegistrar]) {
  final Registrar registrar = pluginRegistrar ?? webPluginRegistrar;
  ConnectivityPlusWebPlugin.registerWith(registrar);
  GeolocatorPlugin.registerWith(registrar);
  ImagePickerPlugin.registerWith(registrar);
  WebPermissionHandler.registerWith(registrar);
  WebSensorsPlugin.registerWith(registrar);
  SharedPreferencesPlugin.registerWith(registrar);
  registrar.registerMessageHandler();
}

==> week_5/lib/online_directory_page.dart <==
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:connectivity_plus/connectivity_plus.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

import 'services/portal_data_service.dart';
import 'theme/app_theme.dart';

class OnlineDirectoryPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const OnlineDirectoryPage({super.key, this.useMockData = false});

  final bool useMockData;

  @override
  State<OnlineDirectoryPage> createState() => _OnlineDirectoryPageState();
}

class _OnlineDirectoryPageState extends State<OnlineDirectoryPage> {
  static const _cacheKey = 'week5_online_directory_cache';
  static const _updatedKey = 'week5_online_directory_updated';

  Timer? _timer;
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _users = const [];
  DateTime? _lastUpdated;
  String _syncStatus = 'Syncing';
  bool _online = false;
  bool _syncing = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _restoreCache();
    _sync();
    _timer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 15), (_) => _sync());
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant OnlineDirectoryPage oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.useMockData != widget.useMockData) _sync();
  }

  Future<void> _restoreCache() async {
    if (widget.useMockData) return;
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final rawUsers = prefs.getString(_cacheKey);
      final updated = prefs.getString(_updatedKey);
      if (rawUsers == null) return;
      final decoded = jsonDecode(rawUsers);
      if (decoded is! List) return;
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _users = decoded
            .whereType<Map>()
            .map((item) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(item))
            .toList();
        _lastUpdated = DateTime.tryParse(updated ?? '');
      });
    } catch (_) {
      // A corrupt cache is ignored; the next successful sync replaces it.
    }
  }

  Future<void> _sync() async {
    if (_syncing) return;
    if (mounted) setState(() => _syncing = true);
    if (widget.useMockData) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _users = PortalDataService.mockUsers;
          _lastUpdated = null;
          _online = false;
          _syncStatus = 'Mock Data';
          _syncing = false;
        });
      }
      return;
    }
    try {
      final connections = await Connectivity().checkConnectivity();
      final connected = connections.any(
        (result) => result != ConnectivityResult.none,
      );
      if (!connected) {
        if (mounted) {
          setState(() {
            _online = false;
            _syncStatus = 'Offline';
          });
        }
        await _restoreCache();
        return;
      }

      final response = await http
          .get(
            Uri.https('jsonplaceholder.typicode.com', '/users'),
            headers: const {'Accept': 'application/json'},
          )
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));
      if (response.statusCode != 200) {
        throw Exception('API returned HTTP ${response.statusCode}.');
      }
      final decoded = jsonDecode(response.body);
      if (decoded is! List) {
        throw const FormatException('Invalid API response.');
      }
      final users = decoded
          .whereType<Map>()
          .map((item) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(item))
          .toList();
      final now = DateTime.now();
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.setString(_cacheKey, jsonEncode(users));
      await prefs.setString(_updatedKey, now.toIso8601String());
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _users = users;
        _lastUpdated = now;
        _online = true;
        _syncStatus = 'Sync Successful';
      });
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _online = false;
          _syncStatus = 'Sync Failed';
        });
      }
      await _restoreCache();
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _syncing = false);
    }
  }

  String _formatUpdated(DateTime? value) {
    if (value == null) return 'No successful sync yet';
    final local = value.toLocal();
    final date = '${local.month}/${local.day}/${local.year}';
    final hour = local.hour % 12 == 0 ? 12 : local.hour % 12;
    final minute = local.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    return '$date · $hour:$minute ${local.hour < 12 ? 'AM' : 'PM'}';
  }

  Widget _statusBadge(String label, bool active, Color color) => Container(
    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 5),
    decoration: BoxDecoration(
      color: active ? color.withValues(alpha: 0.12) : Colors.transparent,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
      border: Border.all(
        color: active ? color : Theme.of(context).dividerColor,
      ),
    ),
    child: Text(
      label,
      style: TextStyle(
        color: active ? color : Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
        fontSize: 10,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
      ),
    ),
  );

  Widget _syncStatusCard() {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 14, 16, 10),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: theme.cardColor,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        border: Border.all(color: theme.dividerColor),
        boxShadow: AppTokens.softCardShadow,
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              Icon(
                _online ? Icons.cloud_done_outlined : Icons.cloud_off_outlined,
                color: _online
                    ? const Color(0xFF2E7D32)
                    : theme.colorScheme.error,
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Text(
                _online ? 'Online' : _syncStatus,
                style: theme.textTheme.titleSmall?.copyWith(
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                ),
              ),
              const Spacer(),
              if (_syncing)
                const SizedBox(
                  width: 18,
                  height: 18,
                  child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
                ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text('Last updated · ${_formatUpdated(_lastUpdated)}'),
          Text('Users retrieved · ${_users.length}'),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          Wrap(
            spacing: 6,
            runSpacing: 6,
            children: [
              _statusBadge(
                'Sync Successful',
                _syncStatus == 'Sync Successful',
                const Color(0xFF2E7D32),
              ),
              _statusBadge(
                'Sync Failed',
                _syncStatus == 'Sync Failed',
                const Color(0xFFC62828),
              ),
              _statusBadge(
                'Offline',
                _syncStatus == 'Offline',
                const Color(0xFF6B7280),
              ),
              _statusBadge(
                'Mock Data',
                _syncStatus == 'Mock Data',
                const Color(0xFF7B2CBF),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _userCard(Map<String, dynamic> user) {
    final company = user['company'] is Map
        ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(user['company'] as Map)
        : <String, dynamic>{};
    final name = user['name'] as String? ?? 'Unknown user';
    final initials = name
        .trim()
        .split(RegExp(r'\s+'))
        .where((part) => part.isNotEmpty)
        .take(2)
        .map((part) => part[0].toUpperCase())
        .join();
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 0, 16, 10),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: theme.cardColor,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        border: Border.all(color: theme.dividerColor),
        boxShadow: AppTokens.softCardShadow,
      ),
      child: Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          CircleAvatar(
            backgroundColor: AppTokens.maroonPrimary,
            child: Text(
              initials.isEmpty ? 'U' : initials,
              style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 10),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text(name, style: theme.textTheme.titleSmall),
                Text(user['email'] as String? ?? 'No email listed'),
                Text('Phone · ${user['phone'] ?? 'Not listed'}'),
                Text('Company · ${company['name'] ?? 'Not listed'}'),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
    appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Online Directory')),
    body: Column(
      children: [
        _syncStatusCard(),
        Expanded(
          child: _users.isEmpty
              ? Center(
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                    child: Text(
                      _syncing ? 'Loading online directory…' : 'No cached user records are available. Connect to sync.',
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    ),
                  ),
                )
              : ListView.builder(
                  itemCount: _users.length,
                  itemBuilder: (context, index) => _userCard(_users[index]),
                ),
        ),
      ],
    ),
    floatingActionButton: FloatingActionButton.extended(
      onPressed: _syncing ? null : _sync,
      icon: const Icon(Icons.sync),
      label: const Text('Sync'),
    ),
  );
}

==> week_5/lib/summary_page.dart <==
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'services/storage_service.dart';
import 'services/file_service.dart';

class SummaryPage extends StatelessWidget {
  final Student student;
  final bool isUpdate;

  const SummaryPage({super.key, required this.student, this.isUpdate = false});

  Widget _detail(BuildContext context, String label, String value) {
    final colors = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    return ListTile(
      contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
      title: Text(
        label,
        style: TextStyle(color: colors.onSurfaceVariant, fontSize: 13),
      ),
      subtitle: Text(
        value.isEmpty ? 'Not provided' : value,
        style: TextStyle(
          color: colors.onSurface,
          fontSize: 16,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _export(BuildContext context) async {
    try {
      await FileService.exportStudents();
      final exportLocation = await FileService.getFilePath();

      if (!context.mounted) return;

      showDialog(
        context: context,
        builder: (dialogContext) => AlertDialog(
          icon: const Icon(Icons.check_circle, color: Colors.green, size: 42),
          title: const Text('Export Successful'),
          content: SelectableText(
            'Student information was exported to:\n\n$exportLocation',
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext),
              child: const Text('Done'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    } catch (error) {
      if (!context.mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
          .showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Export failed: $error')));
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Student Summary')),
      body: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
        children: [
          CircleAvatar(
            radius: 42,
            backgroundColor: Theme.of(context)
                .colorScheme
                .surfaceContainerHighest,
            child: Icon(
              Icons.person,
              size: 48,
              color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.secondary,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          Text(
            isUpdate ? 'Profile Updated' : 'Registration Complete',
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 23, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          Text(
            isUpdate
                ? 'Your student profile has been updated on this device.'
                : 'The student information has been saved on this device.',
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: TextStyle(
              color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 24),
          Card(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  const Text(
                    'Student Details',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 19, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                  ),
                  const Divider(height: 24),
                  _detail(context, 'Student Name', student.name),
                  _detail(context, 'Student ID', student.id),
                  _detail(context, 'Email', student.email),
                  _detail(context, 'Program', student.program),
                  _detail(context, 'Year Level', student.yearLevel),
                  _detail(context, 'Contact Number', student.contact),
                  _detail(context, 'Address', student.address),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 20),
          FilledButton.icon(
            onPressed: () => _export(context),
            icon: const Icon(Icons.file_download_outlined),
            label: const Text('Export Student Information'),
            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
              minimumSize: const Size.fromHeight(52),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          OutlinedButton.icon(
            onPressed: () =>
                Navigator.popUntil(context, (route) => route.isFirst),
            icon: const Icon(Icons.home_outlined),
            label: const Text('Back to Dashboard'),
            style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
              minimumSize: const Size.fromHeight(48),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'auth_page.dart';
import 'home_page.dart';
import 'services/app_preferences.dart';
import 'theme/app_theme.dart';

Future<void> main() async {
  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
  final preferences = AppPreferences();
  await preferences.load();
  runApp(LpuStudentApp(preferences: preferences));
}

class LpuStudentApp extends StatelessWidget {
  const LpuStudentApp({super.key, required this.preferences});

  final AppPreferences preferences;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AnimatedBuilder(
    animation: preferences,
    builder: (context, _) => MaterialApp(
      title: 'LPU-Cavite Student Dashboard',
      debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
      themeMode: preferences.themeMode,
      theme: AppTokens.buildTheme(Brightness.light),
      darkTheme: AppTokens.buildTheme(Brightness.dark),
      home: preferences.hasActiveSession
          ? HomePage(preferences: preferences)
          : AuthPage(preferences: preferences),
    ),
  );

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'services/portal_data_service.dart';
import 'widgets/faculty_card.dart';

class FacultyMember {
  final String name;
  final String department;
  final String email;
  final String phone;
  final String initials;

  const FacultyMember({
    required this.name,
    required this.department,
    required this.email,
    required this.phone,
    this.initials = 'J',
  });
}

class FacultyPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const FacultyPage({super.key, this.useMockData = false});

  final bool useMockData;

  @override
  State<FacultyPage> createState() => _FacultyPageState();
}

class _FacultyPageState extends State<FacultyPage> {
  final TextEditingController _searchController = TextEditingController();
  String _searchQuery = '';
  late Future<List<FacultyMember>> _facultyFuture;

  static const List<FacultyMember> _defaultFaculty = [
    FacultyMember(
      name: 'Dr. Jane Doe',
      department:
          'College of Information Technology and Computer Science (CCS)',
      email: '2024-2-00294@lpunetwork.edu.ph',
      phone: '+63 234 508 2435',
      initials: 'J',
    ),
    FacultyMember(
      name: 'Dr. Jane Doe',
      department:
          'College of Information Technology and Computer Science (CCS)',
      email: '2024-2-00294@lpunetwork.edu.ph',
      phone: '+63 234 508 2435',
      initials: 'J',
    ),
    FacultyMember(
      name: 'Dr. Jane Doe',
      department:
          'College of Information Technology and Computer Science (CCS)',
      email: '2024-2-00294@lpunetwork.edu.ph',
      phone: '+63 234 508 2435',
      initials: 'J',
    ),
    FacultyMember(
      name: 'Dr. Jane Doe',
      department:
          'College of Information Technology and Computer Science (CCS)',
      email: '2024-2-00294@lpunetwork.edu.ph',
      phone: '+63 234 508 2435',
      initials: 'J',
    ),
    FacultyMember(
      name: 'Dr. Jane Doe',
      department:
          'College of Information Technology and Computer Science (CCS)',
      email: '2024-2-00294@lpunetwork.edu.ph',
      phone: '+63 234 508 2435',
      initials: 'J',
    ),
    FacultyMember(
      name: 'Dr. Jane Doe',
      department:
          'College of Information Technology and Computer Science (CCS)',
      email: '2024-2-00294@lpunetwork.edu.ph',
      phone: '+63 234 508 2435',
      initials: 'J',
    ),
  ];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _facultyFuture = _loadFaculty();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant FacultyPage oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.useMockData != widget.useMockData) {
      setState(() {
        _facultyFuture = _loadFaculty();
      });
    }
  }

  Future<List<FacultyMember>> _loadFaculty() async {
    if (!widget.useMockData) return _defaultFaculty;
    final users = await PortalDataService.fetchUsers();
    return users.map((user) {
      return FacultyMember(
        name: user['name'] as String? ?? 'Faculty member',
        department: user['company'] is Map
            ? (user['company'] as Map)['name'] as String? ?? 'Academic Affairs'
            : 'Academic Affairs',
        email: user['email'] as String? ?? '',
        phone: user['phone'] as String? ?? '',
        initials: (user['name'] as String? ?? 'F')
            .trim()
            .split(RegExp(r'\s+'))
            .where((part) => part.isNotEmpty)
            .take(2)
            .map((part) => part[0].toUpperCase())
            .join(),
      );
    }).toList();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _showFilterSheet() {
    showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      showDragHandle: true,
      builder: (context) => SafeArea(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 8, 20, 24),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              const Text(
                'Filter Faculty',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              ListTile(
                leading: const Icon(Icons.school, color: Color(0xFF800000)),
                title: const Text('All Departments'),
                onTap: () {
                  setState(() => _searchQuery = '');
                  _searchController.clear();
                  Navigator.pop(context);
                },
              ),
              ListTile(
                leading: const Icon(Icons.computer, color: Color(0xFF800000)),
                title: const Text('Computer Studies (CCS)'),
                onTap: () {
                  setState(() => _searchQuery = 'CCS');
                  _searchController.text = 'CCS';
                  Navigator.pop(context);
                },
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final cardColor = Theme.of(context).cardColor;
    final borderColor = Theme.of(context).dividerColor;
    return Scaffold(
      body: SafeArea(
        child: FutureBuilder<List<FacultyMember>>(
          future: _facultyFuture,
          builder: (context, snapshot) {
            final source =
                snapshot.data ??
                (widget.useMockData ? <FacultyMember>[] : _defaultFaculty);
            final filtered = source.where((f) {
              if (_searchQuery.isEmpty) return true;
              final q = _searchQuery.toLowerCase();
              return f.name.toLowerCase().contains(q) ||
                  f.department.toLowerCase().contains(q) ||
                  f.email.toLowerCase().contains(q);
            }).toList();
            return ListView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 14),
              children: [
                if (snapshot.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting)
                  const LinearProgressIndicator(),
                if (snapshot.hasError)
                  Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                    child: Text(
                      'Could not load faculty mock data: ${snapshot.error}',
                    ),
                  ),
                // Search Bar with Filter Icon
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Expanded(
                      child: Container(
                        height: 44,
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: cardColor,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                          border: Border.all(color: borderColor),
                        ),
                        child: TextField(
                          controller: _searchController,
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontFamily: 'Inter',
                            fontSize: 14,
                            color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurface,
                          ),
                          onChanged: (val) =>
                              setState(() => _searchQuery = val.trim()),
                          decoration: InputDecoration(
                            hintText: 'Search faculty...',
                            hintStyle: TextStyle(
                              fontFamily: 'Inter',
                              color: Theme.of(context)
                                  .colorScheme
                                  .onSurfaceVariant,
                              fontSize: 14,
                            ),
                            prefixIcon: Icon(
                              Icons.search,
                              color: Theme.of(context)
                                  .colorScheme
                                  .onSurfaceVariant,
                              size: 20,
                            ),
                            contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                              vertical: 10,
                              horizontal: 12,
                            ),
                            border: InputBorder.none,
                            enabledBorder: InputBorder.none,
                            focusedBorder: InputBorder.none,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 10),
                    Container(
                      height: 44,
                      width: 44,
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: cardColor,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                        border: Border.all(color: borderColor),
                      ),
                      child: IconButton(
                        icon: Icon(
                          Icons.tune,
                          color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                          size: 20,
                        ),
                        onPressed: _showFilterSheet,
                        tooltip: 'Filter',
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                if (filtered.isEmpty)
                  Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: cardColor,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                      border: Border.all(color: borderColor),
                    ),
                    child: Center(
                      child: Column(
                        children: [
                          Icon(
                            Icons.search_off,
                            size: 40,
                            color: Theme.of(context)
                                .colorScheme
                                .onSurfaceVariant,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 8),
                          Text(
                            'No faculty members found',
                            style: TextStyle(
                              color: Theme.of(context)
                                  .colorScheme
                                  .onSurfaceVariant,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  )
                else
                  for (final faculty in filtered)
                    FacultyCard(
                      name: faculty.name,
                      department: faculty.department,
                      email: faculty.email,
                      phone: faculty.phone,
                      initials: faculty.initials,
                      onEmailTap: () {
                        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                          SnackBar(
                            content: Text(
                              'Composing email to ${faculty.email}',
                            ),
                          ),
                        );
                      },
                      onCallTap: () {
                        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                          SnackBar(content: Text('Calling ${faculty.phone}')),
                        );
                      },
                    ),
              ],
            );
          },
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

==> week_5/lib/registration_page.dart <==
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'services/storage_service.dart';
import 'summary_page.dart';

class RegistrationPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const RegistrationPage({
    super.key,
    this.student,
    this.isProfileEditor = false,
  });

  final Student? student;
  final bool isProfileEditor;

  @override
  State<RegistrationPage> createState() => _RegistrationPageState();
}

class _RegistrationPageState extends State<RegistrationPage> {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();

  final _nameController = TextEditingController(text: 'Juan Dela Cruz');
  final _idController = TextEditingController();
  final _emailController = TextEditingController();
  final _contactController = TextEditingController();
  final _addressController = TextEditingController();
  final _gradeController = TextEditingController();

  String? _program;
  String? _yearLevel;
  bool _saving = false;

  final List<String> _programs = [
    'BSIT',
    'BSCS',
    'BSIS',
    'BSIT-NS',
    'BSIT-WM',
    'BSCS-DS',
    'BSCS-SE',
    'BS Information Technology',
    'BS Computer Science',
    'BS Business Administration',
    'BS Hospitality Management',
  ];

  final List<String> _yearLevels = [
    '1st Year',
    '2nd Year',
    '3rd Year',
    '4th Year',
    '5th Year',
  ];

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _nameController.dispose();
    _idController.dispose();
    _emailController.dispose();
    _contactController.dispose();
    _addressController.dispose();
    _gradeController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final student = widget.student;
    if (student == null) return;
    _nameController.text = student.name;
    _idController.text = student.id;
    _emailController.text = student.email;
    _contactController.text = student.contact;
    _addressController.text = student.address;
    _gradeController.text = student.grade.toStringAsFixed(1);
    if (_programs.contains(student.program)) _program = student.program;
    if (_yearLevels.contains(student.yearLevel)) _yearLevel = student.yearLevel;
  }

  Future<void> _saveStudent() async {
    if (!_formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;

    if (_program == null || _yearLevel == null) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Please select a program and year level.'),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    setState(() => _saving = true);

    final student = Student(
      name: _nameController.text.trim(),
      id: _idController.text.trim(),
      email: _emailController.text.trim(),
      program: _program!,
      yearLevel: _yearLevel!,
      contact: _contactController.text.trim(),
      address: _addressController.text.trim(),
      grade: double.parse(_gradeController.text.trim()),
    );

    try {
      if (widget.isProfileEditor) {
        await StorageService.saveProfile(student);
      } else if (widget.student == null) {
        await StorageService.saveStudent(student);
      } else {
        await StorageService.updateStudent(widget.student!.id, student);
      }

      if (!mounted) return;

      if (widget.isProfileEditor || widget.student != null) {
        Navigator.pop(context);
      } else {
        await Navigator.push(
          context,
          MaterialPageRoute(
            builder: (_) => SummaryPage(student: student, isUpdate: false),
          ),
        );
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;

      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text(error.toString().replaceFirst('Exception: ', '')),
        ),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _saving = false);
    }
  }

  Widget _textField(
    String label,
    TextEditingController controller, {
    String? hint,
    TextInputType keyboardType = TextInputType.text,
    String? Function(String?)? validator,
    IconData? icon,
    bool isRequired = true,
  }) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16),
      child: TextFormField(
        controller: controller,
        keyboardType: keyboardType,
        validator: validator,
        decoration: InputDecoration(
          label: _fieldLabel(label, isRequired),
          hintText: hint,
          prefixIcon: icon == null ? null : Icon(icon),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _fieldLabel(String label, [bool isRequired = true]) => RichText(
    text: TextSpan(
      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium,
      children: [
        TextSpan(text: label),
        if (isRequired)
          const TextSpan(
            text: ' *',
            style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFFD32F2F)),
          ),
      ],
    ),
  );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(
          widget.student == null ? 'Student Registration' : 'Edit Profile',
        ),
      ),
      body: Form(
        key: _formKey,
        autovalidateMode: AutovalidateMode.onUserInteraction,
        child: ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 20, 20, 32),
          children: [
            Text(
              widget.student == null
                  ? 'Student details'
                  : 'Edit student details',
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall
                  ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
            ),
            Text(
              'Fields marked with * are required. Contact number and address are optional.',
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 24),

            _textField(
              'Student Name',
              _nameController,
              icon: Icons.person_outline,
              validator: (value) => value == null || value.trim().isEmpty
                  ? 'Enter the student name'
                  : null,
            ),
            _textField(
              'Student ID',
              _idController,
              icon: Icons.badge_outlined,
              validator: (value) => value == null || value.trim().isEmpty
                  ? 'Enter the student ID'
                  : null,
            ),
            _textField(
              'Email Address',
              _emailController,
              icon: Icons.email_outlined,
              keyboardType: TextInputType.emailAddress,
              validator: (value) {
                if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty) {
                  return 'Enter the email address';
                }
                if (!RegExp(r'^[^@]+@[^@]+\.[^@]+$').hasMatch(value.trim())) {
                  return 'Enter a valid email address';
                }
                return null;
              },
            ),

            DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
              initialValue: _program,
              isExpanded: true,
              validator: (value) => value == null ? 'Select a program' : null,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                label: _fieldLabel('Program'),
                prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.school_outlined),
              ),
              items: _programs
                  .map(
                    (program) =>
                        DropdownMenuItem(value: program, child: Text(program)),
                  )
                  .toList(),
              onChanged: (value) => setState(() => _program = value),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),

            DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
              initialValue: _yearLevel,
              validator: (value) =>
                  value == null ? 'Select a year level' : null,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                label: _fieldLabel('Year level'),
                prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.calendar_month_outlined),
              ),
              items: _yearLevels
                  .map(
                    (year) => DropdownMenuItem(value: year, child: Text(year)),
                  )
                  .toList(),
              onChanged: (value) => setState(() => _yearLevel = value),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),

            _textField(
              'Grade (0–100)',
              _gradeController,
              icon: Icons.grade_outlined,
              keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(
                decimal: true,
              ),
              validator: (value) {
                final grade = double.tryParse(value?.trim() ?? '');
                if (grade == null || grade < 0 || grade > 100) {
                  return 'Enter a grade between 0 and 100';
                }
                return null;
              },
            ),

            _textField(
              'Contact Number (Optional)',
              _contactController,
              icon: Icons.phone_outlined,
              keyboardType: TextInputType.phone,
              isRequired: false,
            ),
            _textField(
              'Address (Optional)',
              _addressController,
              icon: Icons.home_outlined,
              isRequired: false,
            ),

            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            FilledButton.icon(
              onPressed: _saving ? null : _saveStudent,
              icon: _saving
                  ? const SizedBox(
                      width: 18,
                      height: 18,
                      child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
                    )
                  : const Icon(Icons.save_outlined),
              label: Text(
                _saving
                    ? 'Saving...'
                    : widget.student == null
                    ? 'Save Student'
                    : 'Update Student',
              ),
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                minimumSize: const Size.fromHeight(52),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
