==> week_5/lib/screens/device_dashboard_screen.dart <==
import 'dart:io';
import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:sensors_plus/sensors_plus.dart';

import '../services/device_history_service.dart';
import 'camera_screen.dart';
import 'gallery_screen.dart';
import 'sensor_screens.dart';

class DeviceDashboardScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const DeviceDashboardScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<DeviceDashboardScreen> createState() => _DeviceDashboardScreenState();
}

class _DeviceDashboardScreenState extends State<DeviceDashboardScreen> {
  late Future<MediaHistoryEntry?> _latestImage;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _latestImage = _loadLatestImage();
  }

  Future<MediaHistoryEntry?> _loadLatestImage() async {
    final entries = await DeviceHistoryService.getMediaHistory();
    return entries.isEmpty ? null : entries.first;
  }

  Future<void> _open(Widget page) async {
    await Navigator.push<void>(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => page),
    );
    if (mounted) setState(() => _latestImage = _loadLatestImage());
  }

  String _axisValue(double? value) =>
      value == null ? '—' : value.toStringAsFixed(2);

  Widget _status(String label, bool active) => Chip(
    avatar: Icon(
      active ? Icons.check_circle : Icons.hourglass_top,
      size: 16,
      color: active ? const Color(0xFF2E7D32) : Colors.orange,
    ),
    label: Text('$label: ${active ? 'Active' : 'Waiting'}'),
    side: BorderSide.none,
    backgroundColor: active ? const Color(0xFFE8F5E9) : const Color(0xFFFFF3E0),
    labelStyle: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
  );

  Widget _sensorVectorCard({
    required String title,
    required IconData icon,
    required double? x,
    required double? y,
    required double? z,
  }) => Card(
    child: Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              Icon(icon, color: const Color(0xFF800000)),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Text(title, style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          Text(
            'X  ${_axisValue(x)}     Y  ${_axisValue(y)}     Z  ${_axisValue(z)}',
          ),
        ],
      ),
    ),
  );

  Widget _sectionNavigation(String label, Widget page, IconData icon) =>
      OutlinedButton.icon(
        onPressed: () => _open(page),
        icon: Icon(icon),
        label: Text(label),
      );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
    appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Device Monitoring')),
    body: ListView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      children: [
        Wrap(
          spacing: 6,
          runSpacing: 0,
          children: [
            _status('Camera', true),
            StreamBuilder<UserAccelerometerEvent>(
              stream: userAccelerometerEventStream(),
              builder: (context, snapshot) =>
                  _status('Accelerometer', snapshot.hasData),
            ),
            StreamBuilder<GyroscopeEvent>(
              stream: gyroscopeEventStream(),
              builder: (context, snapshot) =>
                  _status('Gyroscope', snapshot.hasData),
            ),
            StreamBuilder<MagnetometerEvent>(
              stream: magnetometerEventStream(),
              builder: (context, snapshot) =>
                  _status('Compass', snapshot.hasData),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 4),
        Row(
          children: [
            Expanded(
              child: FilledButton.icon(
                onPressed: () => _open(const CameraScreen()),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.camera_alt_outlined),
                label: const Text('Take Photo'),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Expanded(
              child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                onPressed: () => _open(const GalleryScreen()),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.photo_library_outlined),
                label: const Text('Select Photo'),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 14),
        Card(
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text(
                  'Latest Image',
                  style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                FutureBuilder<MediaHistoryEntry?>(
                  future: _latestImage,
                  builder: (context, snapshot) {
                    final entry = snapshot.data;
                    if (entry == null || !File(entry.path).existsSync()) {
                      return Container(
                        height: 140,
                        width: double.infinity,
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: Theme.of(context).scaffoldBackgroundColor,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                        ),
                        child: const Center(
                          child: Icon(Icons.image_outlined, size: 40),
                        ),
                      );
                    }
                    return Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        ClipRRect(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                          child: Image.file(
                            File(entry.path),
                            height: 180,
                            width: double.infinity,
                            fit: BoxFit.cover,
                          ),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 6),
                        Text('${entry.name} · ${entry.capturedAt.toLocal()}'),
                      ],
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        StreamBuilder<UserAccelerometerEvent>(
          stream: userAccelerometerEventStream(),
          builder: (context, snapshot) => _sensorVectorCard(
            title: 'Movement Data (X, Y, Z)',
            icon: Icons.sensors_outlined,
            x: snapshot.data?.x,
            y: snapshot.data?.y,
            z: snapshot.data?.z,
          ),
        ),
        StreamBuilder<GyroscopeEvent>(
          stream: gyroscopeEventStream(),
          builder: (context, snapshot) => _sensorVectorCard(
            title: 'Gyroscope (X, Y, Z)',
            icon: Icons.rotate_90_degrees_ccw_outlined,
            x: snapshot.data?.x,
            y: snapshot.data?.y,
            z: snapshot.data?.z,
          ),
        ),
        StreamBuilder<MagnetometerEvent>(
          stream: magnetometerEventStream(),
          builder: (context, snapshot) {
            final event = snapshot.data;
            final heading = event == null
                ? null
                : (math.atan2(event.y, event.x) * 180 / math.pi + 360) % 360;
            const points = ['N', 'E', 'S', 'W'];
            final direction = heading == null
                ? '—'
                : points[((heading + 45) / 90).floor() % 4];
            return Card(
              child: ListTile(
                leading: const Icon(
                  Icons.explore_outlined,
                  color: Color(0xFF800000),
                ),
                title: const Text('Compass Direction'),
                subtitle: Text(
                  heading == null
                      ? 'Waiting for magnetometer…'
                      : '$direction · ${heading.toStringAsFixed(0)}°',
                ),
              ),
            );
          },
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        Text(
          'Sensor dashboards',
          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 6),
        Wrap(
          spacing: 8,
          runSpacing: 8,
          children: [
            _sectionNavigation(
              'Accelerometer',
              const AccelerometerScreen(),
              Icons.sensors_outlined,
            ),
            _sectionNavigation(
              'Gyroscope',
              const GyroscopeScreen(),
              Icons.rotate_90_degrees_ccw_outlined,
            ),
            _sectionNavigation(
              'Compass',
              const CompassScreen(),
              Icons.explore_outlined,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ],
    ),
  );
}

==> week_5/lib/screens/sensor_screens.dart <==
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:sensors_plus/sensors_plus.dart';

import '../services/device_history_service.dart';

enum _SensorKind { accelerometer, gyroscope, compass }

class AccelerometerScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const AccelerometerScreen({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) =>
      const _SensorMonitorScreen(kind: _SensorKind.accelerometer);
}

class GyroscopeScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const GyroscopeScreen({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) =>
      const _SensorMonitorScreen(kind: _SensorKind.gyroscope);
}

class CompassScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const CompassScreen({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) =>
      const _SensorMonitorScreen(kind: _SensorKind.compass);
}

class _AxisSample {
  const _AxisSample(this.x, this.y, this.z, this.timestamp);

  final double x;
  final double y;
  final double z;
  final DateTime timestamp;
}

class _SensorMonitorScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const _SensorMonitorScreen({required this.kind});

  final _SensorKind kind;

  @override
  State<_SensorMonitorScreen> createState() => _SensorMonitorScreenState();
}

class _SensorMonitorScreenState extends State<_SensorMonitorScreen> {
  StreamSubscription<_AxisSample>? _subscription;
  _AxisSample? _current;
  _AxisSample? _previous;
  _AxisSample? _peak;
  final List<SensorHistoryEntry> _history = [];
  final Map<String, int> _directionCounts = {'N': 0, 'E': 0, 'S': 0, 'W': 0};
  DateTime? _lastPersisted;
  String? _direction;
  double? _heading;
  String? _error;

  String get _sensorKey => switch (widget.kind) {
    _SensorKind.accelerometer => 'accelerometer',
    _SensorKind.gyroscope => 'gyroscope',
    _SensorKind.compass => 'compass',
  };

  String get _title => switch (widget.kind) {
    _SensorKind.accelerometer => 'Accelerometer',
    _SensorKind.gyroscope => 'Gyroscope',
    _SensorKind.compass => 'Magnetometer & Compass',
  };

  Stream<_AxisSample> _sensorStream() {
    const period = SensorInterval.normalInterval;
    return switch (widget.kind) {
      _SensorKind.accelerometer => userAccelerometerEventStream(
        samplingPeriod: period,
      ).map((event) => _AxisSample(event.x, event.y, event.z, DateTime.now())),
      _SensorKind.gyroscope => gyroscopeEventStream(
        samplingPeriod: period,
      ).map((event) => _AxisSample(event.x, event.y, event.z, DateTime.now())),
      _SensorKind.compass => magnetometerEventStream(
        samplingPeriod: period,
      ).map((event) => _AxisSample(event.x, event.y, event.z, DateTime.now())),
    };
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    unawaited(_loadHistory());
    _subscription = _sensorStream().listen(
      _onSample,
      onError: (Object error) {
        if (mounted) setState(() => _error = 'Sensor unavailable: $error');
      },
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _subscription?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _loadHistory() async {
    final entries = await DeviceHistoryService.getSensorHistory(_sensorKey);
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      _history
        ..clear()
        ..addAll(entries.reversed.take(12));
      if (widget.kind == _SensorKind.compass) {
        for (final entry in entries) {
          final direction = entry.direction;
          if (direction != null && _directionCounts.containsKey(direction)) {
            _directionCounts[direction] = _directionCounts[direction]! + 1;
          }
        }
      }
    });
  }

  void _onSample(_AxisSample sample) {
    final heading = widget.kind == _SensorKind.compass
        ? (math.atan2(sample.y, sample.x) * 180 / math.pi + 360) % 360
        : null;
    final direction = heading == null ? null : _directionFor(heading);
    setState(() {
      _previous = _current;
      _current = sample;
      if (_peak == null ||
          sample.x.abs() > _peak!.x.abs() ||
          sample.y.abs() > _peak!.y.abs() ||
          sample.z.abs() > _peak!.z.abs()) {
        _peak = _AxisSample(
          math.max(_peak?.x.abs() ?? 0, sample.x.abs()),
          math.max(_peak?.y.abs() ?? 0, sample.y.abs()),
          math.max(_peak?.z.abs() ?? 0, sample.z.abs()),
          sample.timestamp,
        );
      }
      if (heading != null && direction != null && direction != _direction) {
        _direction = direction;
        _directionCounts[direction] = (_directionCounts[direction] ?? 0) + 1;
      }
      _heading = heading;
      _error = null;
    });

    final last = _lastPersisted;
    if (last == null || sample.timestamp.difference(last).inSeconds >= 1) {
      _lastPersisted = sample.timestamp;
      final record = SensorHistoryEntry(
        sensor: _sensorKey,
        x: sample.x,
        y: sample.y,
        z: sample.z,
        timestamp: sample.timestamp,
        direction: direction,
      );
      unawaited(DeviceHistoryService.recordSensor(record));
      setState(() {
        _history.insert(0, record);
        if (_history.length > 12) _history.removeLast();
      });
    }
  }

  String? _directionFor(double heading) {
    if (heading >= 315 || heading < 45) return 'N';
    if (heading < 135) return 'E';
    if (heading < 225) return 'S';
    return 'W';
  }

  String _value(double? value) =>
      value == null ? '—' : value.toStringAsFixed(2);

  Widget _axesCard(String title, _AxisSample? sample, IconData icon) => Card(
    child: Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              Icon(icon, color: const Color(0xFF800000)),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Text(title, style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: [
              _axisValue('X', _value(sample?.x)),
              _axisValue('Y', _value(sample?.y)),
              _axisValue('Z', _value(sample?.z)),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    ),
  );

  Widget _axisValue(String axis, String value) => Column(
    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
    children: [
      Text(axis, style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall),
      Text(value, style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium),
    ],
  );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
    appBar: AppBar(title: Text(_title)),
    body: ListView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      children: [
        Row(
          children: [
            Container(
              width: 9,
              height: 9,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: _current == null ? Colors.orange : Colors.green,
                shape: BoxShape.circle,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Text(
              _current == null ? 'Waiting for sensor' : 'Live updates active',
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium,
            ),
            const Spacer(),
            if (_current != null)
              Text(
                '${_current!.timestamp.toLocal().hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:${_current!.timestamp.toLocal().minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:${_current!.timestamp.toLocal().second.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}',
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall,
              ),
          ],
        ),
        if (_error != null) ...[
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text(
            _error!,
            style: TextStyle(color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error),
          ),
        ],
        const SizedBox(height: 10),
        _axesCard('Current X, Y, Z', _current, Icons.sensors_outlined),
        _axesCard('Peak absolute values', _peak, Icons.show_chart),
        if (widget.kind == _SensorKind.gyroscope)
          _axesCard('Previous values', _previous, Icons.history),
        if (widget.kind == _SensorKind.compass) ...[
          Card(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              child: Column(
                children: [
                  const Icon(
                    Icons.explore_outlined,
                    size: 38,
                    color: Color(0xFF800000),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  Text(
                    _direction == null
                        ? '—'
                        : '$_direction · ${_heading!.toStringAsFixed(0)}°',
                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall
                        ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                  ),
                  const Text('Cardinal heading'),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          Card(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
              child: Wrap(
                spacing: 20,
                children: [
                  for (final direction in const ['N', 'E', 'S', 'W'])
                    Text('$direction · ${_directionCounts[direction]}'),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        Text(
          widget.kind == _SensorKind.compass
              ? 'Direction history'
              : widget.kind == _SensorKind.gyroscope
              ? 'Rotational movement logs'
              : 'Movement history',
          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 6),
        if (_history.isEmpty)
          const Text('Sensor readings will be saved here as they arrive.')
        else
          for (final entry in _history)
            ListTile(
              dense: true,
              leading: Icon(
                widget.kind == _SensorKind.compass
                    ? Icons.explore_outlined
                    : Icons.sensors_outlined,
              ),
              title: Text(
                widget.kind == _SensorKind.compass && entry.direction != null
                    ? 'Direction ${entry.direction}'
                    : 'X ${entry.x.toStringAsFixed(2)} · Y ${entry.y.toStringAsFixed(2)} · Z ${entry.z.toStringAsFixed(2)}',
              ),
              subtitle: Text(entry.timestamp.toLocal().toString()),
            ),
      ],
    ),
  );
}

==> week_5/lib/screens/gallery_screen.dart <==
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:image_picker/image_picker.dart';
import 'package:permission_handler/permission_handler.dart';

import '../services/device_history_service.dart';

class GalleryScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const GalleryScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<GalleryScreen> createState() => _GalleryScreenState();
}

class _GalleryScreenState extends State<GalleryScreen> {
  final _picker = ImagePicker();
  late Future<List<MediaHistoryEntry>> _historyFuture;
  bool _picking = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _historyFuture = DeviceHistoryService.getMediaHistory();
  }

  void _reload() {
    setState(() => _historyFuture = DeviceHistoryService.getMediaHistory());
  }

  Future<void> _pickPhotos() async {
    if (_picking) return;
    setState(() => _picking = true);
    try {
      final permission = await Permission.photos.request();
      if (!permission.isGranted && !permission.isLimited) {
        if (mounted) {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            SnackBar(
              content: Text(
                permission.isPermanentlyDenied
                    ? 'Photo library access is blocked. Enable it in app settings.'
                    : 'Photo library permission is required to select images.',
              ),
              action: permission.isPermanentlyDenied
                  ? SnackBarAction(
                      label: 'Settings',
                      onPressed: openAppSettings,
                    )
                  : null,
            ),
          );
        }
        return;
      }

      final selected = await _picker.pickMultiImage(imageQuality: 90);
      for (final image in selected) {
        await DeviceHistoryService.saveImage(image, source: 'gallery');
      }
      if (selected.isNotEmpty) _reload();
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text('Could not select photos: $error')),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _picking = false);
    }
  }

  String _formatSize(int bytes) {
    if (bytes < 1024) return '$bytes B';
    if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return '${(bytes / 1024).toStringAsFixed(1)} KB';
    return '${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toStringAsFixed(1)} MB';
  }

  Future<void> _remove(MediaHistoryEntry entry) async {
    await DeviceHistoryService.removeImage(entry);
    if (mounted) _reload();
  }

  Widget _thumbnail(MediaHistoryEntry entry) => ClipRRect(
    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
    child: SizedBox(
      width: 72,
      height: 72,
      child: File(entry.path).existsSync()
          ? Image.file(File(entry.path), fit: BoxFit.cover)
          : const ColoredBox(
              color: Color(0xFFE5E7EB),
              child: Icon(Icons.broken_image_outlined),
            ),
    ),
  );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
    appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Gallery')),
    body: FutureBuilder<List<MediaHistoryEntry>>(
      future: _historyFuture,
      builder: (context, snapshot) {
        final history = snapshot.data ?? const <MediaHistoryEntry>[];
        final gallery = history
            .where((entry) => entry.source == 'gallery')
            .toList();
        final recent = gallery.take(3).toList();
        return ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
          children: [
            FilledButton.icon(
              onPressed: _picking ? null : _pickPhotos,
              icon: _picking
                  ? const SizedBox(
                      width: 18,
                      height: 18,
                      child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
                    )
                  : const Icon(Icons.photo_library_outlined),
              label: Text(_picking ? 'Opening gallery…' : 'Select Photos'),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            Text(
              'Last three selected',
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            if (recent.isEmpty)
              const Text('Selected images will appear here.')
            else
              Row(
                children: [
                  for (final entry in recent) ...[
                    _thumbnail(entry),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  ],
                ],
              ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            Text(
              'Selected image history',
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            if (snapshot.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting)
              const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
            else if (gallery.isEmpty)
              const Text('No gallery images have been selected yet.')
            else
              for (final entry in gallery)
                Card(
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
                    child: Row(
                      children: [
                        _thumbnail(entry),
                        const SizedBox(width: 10),
                        Expanded(
                          child: Column(
                            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                            children: [
                              Text(
                                entry.name,
                                maxLines: 1,
                                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                style: const TextStyle(
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                ),
                              ),
                              Text('Size · ${_formatSize(entry.sizeBytes)}'),
                              Text(
                                'Selected · ${entry.capturedAt.toLocal()}',
                                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall,
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                        IconButton(
                          tooltip: 'Remove image',
                          onPressed: () => _remove(entry),
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline),
                          color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error,
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
          ],
        );
      },
    ),
  );
}

import 'dart:io';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:image_picker/image_picker.dart';
import 'package:permission_handler/permission_handler.dart';

import '../services/device_history_service.dart';

class CameraScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const CameraScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<CameraScreen> createState() => _CameraScreenState();
}

class _CameraScreenState extends State<CameraScreen> {
  final _picker = ImagePicker();
  MediaHistoryEntry? _latest;
  bool _capturing = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadLatest();
  }

  Future<void> _loadLatest() async {
    final entries = await DeviceHistoryService.getMediaHistory();
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      _latest = entries.where((entry) => entry.source == 'camera').firstOrNull;
    });
  }

  Future<void> _capture() async {
    if (_capturing) return;
    setState(() => _capturing = true);
    try {
      final permission = await Permission.camera.request();
      if (!permission.isGranted) {
        if (mounted) {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            SnackBar(
              content: Text(
                permission.isPermanentlyDenied
                    ? 'Camera access is blocked. Enable it in app settings.'
                    : 'Camera permission is required to take a photo.',
              ),
              action: permission.isPermanentlyDenied
                  ? SnackBarAction(
                      label: 'Settings',
                      onPressed: openAppSettings,
                    )
                  : null,
            ),
          );
        }
        return;
      }

      final image = await _picker.pickImage(
        source: ImageSource.camera,
        imageQuality: 90,
      );
      if (image == null) return;
      final saved = await DeviceHistoryService.saveImage(
        image,
        source: 'camera',
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() => _latest = saved);
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text('Photo saved at ${saved.capturedAt}')),
      );
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text('Could not capture photo: $error')),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _capturing = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
    appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Camera')),
    body: ListView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      children: [
        Card(
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text(
                  'Latest captured image',
                  style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                if (_latest != null && File(_latest!.path).existsSync())
                  ClipRRect(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    child: Image.file(
                      File(_latest!.path),
                      height: 260,
                      width: double.infinity,
                      fit: BoxFit.cover,
                    ),
                  )
                else
                  Container(
                    height: 210,
                    width: double.infinity,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: Theme.of(context).scaffoldBackgroundColor,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    ),
                    child: const Center(
                      child: Icon(Icons.photo_camera_outlined, size: 48),
                    ),
                  ),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                Text(
                  _latest == null
                      ? 'No photo captured yet.'
                      : 'Captured · ${_latest!.capturedAt.toLocal()}',
                ),
                if (_latest != null)
                  Text(
                    'Saved privately · ${_latest!.path}',
                    maxLines: 2,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall,
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        FilledButton.icon(
          onPressed: _capturing ? null : _capture,
          icon: _capturing
              ? const SizedBox(
                  width: 18,
                  height: 18,
                  child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
                )
              : const Icon(Icons.camera_alt_outlined),
          label: Text(_capturing ? 'Opening camera…' : 'Take Photo'),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 6),
        Text(
          'Take another photo at any time. Each capture is added to the private dashboard image history.',
          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall,
        ),
      ],
    ),
  );
}

==> week_5/lib/services/storage_service.dart <==
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

class Student {
  final String name;
  final String id;
  final String email;
  final String program;
  final String yearLevel;
  final String contact;
  final String address;
  final String status;
  final double attendance;
  final double grade;

  String get course => program;
  String get contactNumber => contact;

  const Student({
    required this.name,
    required this.id,
    required this.email,
    required this.program,
    required this.yearLevel,
    this.contact = '',
    this.address = '',
    this.status = 'Active',
    this.attendance = 0.95,
    this.grade = 75,
  });

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
    'name': name,
    'id': id,
    'email': email,
    'program': program,
    'course': course,
    'yearLevel': yearLevel,
    'contact': contact,
    'contactNumber': contactNumber,
    'address': address,
    'status': status,
    'attendance': attendance,
    'grade': grade,
  };

  factory Student.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    return Student(
      name: json['name'] ?? '',
      id: json['id'] ?? '',
      email: json['email'] ?? '',
      program: json['course'] ?? json['program'] ?? '',
      yearLevel: json['yearLevel'] ?? '',
      contact: json['contactNumber'] ?? json['contact'] ?? '',
      address: json['address'] ?? '',
      status: json['status'] ?? 'Active',
      attendance: (json['attendance'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.95,
      grade: (json['grade'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 75,
    );
  }
}

class RecentActivity {
  final String title;
  final String detail;
  final DateTime timestamp;

  const RecentActivity({
    required this.title,
    required this.detail,
    required this.timestamp,
  });

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
    'title': title,
    'detail': detail,
    'timestamp': timestamp.toIso8601String(),
  };

  factory RecentActivity.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) => RecentActivity(
    title: json['title'] as String? ?? 'Activity',
    detail: json['detail'] as String? ?? '',
    timestamp:
        DateTime.tryParse(json['timestamp'] as String? ?? '') ?? DateTime.now(),
  );
}

class StorageService {

  static Student? selectProfileStudent(Iterable<Student> students) {
    return students
            .where((student) => student.name.toLowerCase().contains('novy'))
            .firstOrNull ??
        students.firstOrNull;

  static Future<List<RecentActivity>> getRecentActivity() async {
    final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final raw = preferences.getString(_activityKey);
    if (raw == null) {
      return [
        RecentActivity(
          title: 'Logged in to portal',
          detail: 'Cavite Campus Network',
          timestamp: DateTime.now().subtract(const Duration(minutes: 5)),
        ),
      ];
    }
    final decoded = jsonDecode(raw);
    if (decoded is! List) {
      throw const FormatException('Activity data must be a JSON list.');
    }
    final list = decoded
        .whereType<Map>()
        .map((item) => RecentActivity.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic>.from(item)))
        .toList();
    if (list.isEmpty) {
      return [
        RecentActivity(
          title: 'Logged in to portal',
          detail: 'Cavite Campus Network',
          timestamp: DateTime.now().subtract(const Duration(minutes: 5)),
        ),
      ];
    }
    return list;
  }

  static Future<void> recordActivity(String title, String detail) async {
    final activities = await getRecentActivity();
    activities.insert(
      0,
      RecentActivity(title: title, detail: detail, timestamp: DateTime.now()),
    );
    final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await preferences.setString(
      _activityKey,
      jsonEncode(activities.take(10).map((item) => item.toJson()).toList()),
    );
  }

  static Future<List<Student>> getStudents() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final raw = prefs.getString(_key);

    if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty) {
      return <Student>[];
    }

    final decoded = jsonDecode(raw);

    if (decoded is! List) {
      throw const FormatException('Student data must be a JSON list.');
    }

    return decoded
        .whereType<Map>()
        .map((item) => Student.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic>.from(item)))
        .toList();
  }

  /// Returns the seeded student records separately.
  /// These records must never be written into the custom student list.
  static List<Student> getMockStudents() {
    return List<Student>.from(defaultStudents);
  }

  static Future<Student?> getProfile() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final raw = prefs.getString(_profileKey);
    if (raw != null) {
      final decoded = jsonDecode(raw);
      if (decoded is Map) {
        return Student.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic>.from(decoded));
      }
    }

    final existingProfile = selectProfileStudent(await getStudents());
    if (existingProfile != null) {
      await prefs.setString(_profileKey, jsonEncode(existingProfile.toJson()));
    }
    return existingProfile;
  }

  static Future<void> saveProfile(Student student) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final saved = await prefs.setString(
      _profileKey,
      jsonEncode(student.toJson()),
    );
    if (!saved) throw StateError('The profile could not be saved locally.');
    await recordActivity('Profile updated', student.name);
  }

  static Future<void> saveStudent(Student student) async {
    final students = await getStudents();

    final duplicate = students.any((existing) => existing.id == student.id);

    if (duplicate) {
      throw Exception('A student with this ID is already registered.');
    }

    students.add(student);

    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setString(
      _key,
      jsonEncode(students.map((s) => s.toJson()).toList()),
    );
    await recordActivity('Student registered', student.name);
  }

  static Future<void> updateStudent(String existingId, Student student) async {
    final students = await getStudents();
    final existingIndex = students.indexWhere(
      (existing) => existing.id == existingId,
    );
    if (existingIndex < 0) {
      throw Exception('The student record could not be found.');
    }
    final duplicate = students.any(
      (existing) => existing.id == student.id && existing.id != existingId,
    );
    if (duplicate) {
      throw Exception('A student with this ID is already registered.');
    }
    students[existingIndex] = student;

    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setString(
      _key,
      jsonEncode(students.map((item) => item.toJson()).toList()),
    );
    await recordActivity('Student profile updated', student.name);
  }

  static Future<void> deleteStudent(String id) async {
    final students = await getStudents();
    students.removeWhere((student) => student.id == id);

    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setString(
      _key,
      jsonEncode(students.map((s) => s.toJson()).toList()),
    );
    await recordActivity('Student record deleted', id);
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:path_provider/path_provider.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import 'package:image_picker/image_picker.dart';

class MediaHistoryEntry {
  const MediaHistoryEntry({
    required this.path,
    required this.name,
    required this.source,
    required this.capturedAt,
    required this.sizeBytes,
  });

  final String path;
  final String name;
  final String source;
  final DateTime capturedAt;
  final int sizeBytes;

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
    'path': path,
    'name': name,
    'source': source,
    'capturedAt': capturedAt.toIso8601String(),
    'sizeBytes': sizeBytes,
  };

  factory MediaHistoryEntry.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) =>
      MediaHistoryEntry(
        path: json['path'] as String? ?? '',
        name: json['name'] as String? ?? 'image',
        source: json['source'] as String? ?? 'gallery',
        capturedAt:
            DateTime.tryParse(json['capturedAt'] as String? ?? '') ??
            DateTime.now(),
        sizeBytes: (json['sizeBytes'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
      );
}

class SensorHistoryEntry {
  const SensorHistoryEntry({
    required this.sensor,
    required this.x,
    required this.y,
    required this.z,
    required this.timestamp,
    this.direction,
  });

  final String sensor;
  final double x;
  final double y;
  final double z;
  final DateTime timestamp;
  final String? direction;

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
    'sensor': sensor,
    'x': x,
    'y': y,
    'z': z,
    'timestamp': timestamp.toIso8601String(),
    'direction': direction,
  };

  factory SensorHistoryEntry.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) =>
      SensorHistoryEntry(
        sensor: json['sensor'] as String? ?? 'sensor',
        x: (json['x'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0,
        y: (json['y'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0,
        z: (json['z'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0,
        timestamp:
            DateTime.tryParse(json['timestamp'] as String? ?? '') ??
            DateTime.now(),
        direction: json['direction'] as String?,
      );
}

class DeviceHistoryService {
  static const _mediaKey = 'week5_device_media_history';
  static const _sensorKeyPrefix = 'week5_sensor_history_';

  static Future<MediaHistoryEntry> saveImage(
    XFile image, {
    required String source,
  }) async {
    final documents = await getApplicationDocumentsDirectory();
    final directory = Directory('${documents.path}/device_media');
    await directory.create(recursive: true);
    final capturedAt = DateTime.now();
    final extension = image.name.contains('.')
        ? image.name.substring(image.name.lastIndexOf('.'))
        : '.jpg';
    final name = 'image_${capturedAt.microsecondsSinceEpoch}$extension';
    final file = await File(image.path).copy('${directory.path}/$name');
    final entry = MediaHistoryEntry(
      path: file.path,
      name: name,
      source: source,
      capturedAt: capturedAt,
      sizeBytes: await file.length(),
    );
    final entries = await getMediaHistory();
    entries.add(entry);
    await _saveMediaHistory(entries);
    return entry;
  }

  static Future<List<MediaHistoryEntry>> getMediaHistory() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final raw = prefs.getString(_mediaKey);
    if (raw == null) return [];
    try {
      final decoded = jsonDecode(raw);
      if (decoded is! List) return [];
      return decoded
          .whereType<Map>()
          .map(
            (item) =>
                MediaHistoryEntry.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic>.from(item)),
          )
          .where((entry) => File(entry.path).existsSync())
          .toList()
        ..sort((a, b) => b.capturedAt.compareTo(a.capturedAt));
    } on FormatException {
      return [];
    }
  }

  static Future<void> removeImage(MediaHistoryEntry entry) async {
    final file = File(entry.path);
    if (await file.exists()) await file.delete();
    final entries = await getMediaHistory()
      ..removeWhere((item) => item.path == entry.path);
    await _saveMediaHistory(entries);
  }

  static Future<void> _saveMediaHistory(List<MediaHistoryEntry> entries) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setString(
      _mediaKey,
      jsonEncode(entries.map((entry) => entry.toJson()).toList()),
    );
  }

  static Future<void> recordSensor(SensorHistoryEntry entry) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final key = '$_sensorKeyPrefix${entry.sensor}';
    final entries = await getSensorHistory(entry.sensor);
    entries.add(entry);
    final recent = entries.length > 100
        ? entries.sublist(entries.length - 100)
        : entries;
    await prefs.setString(
      key,
      jsonEncode(recent.map((item) => item.toJson()).toList()),
    );
  }

  static Future<List<SensorHistoryEntry>> getSensorHistory(
    String sensor,
  ) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final raw = prefs.getString('$_sensorKeyPrefix$sensor');
    if (raw == null) return [];
    try {
      final decoded = jsonDecode(raw);
      if (decoded is! List) return [];
      return decoded
          .whereType<Map>()
          .map(
            (item) =>
                SensorHistoryEntry.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic>.from(item)),
          )
          .toList();
    } on FormatException {
      return [];
    }
  }
}

==> week_5/lib/services/portal_data_service.dart <==
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:connectivity_plus/connectivity_plus.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

import 'storage_service.dart';

/// Shared JSONPlaceholder source used by the student and faculty directories.
class PortalDataService {
  static const _usersCacheKey = 'jsonplaceholder_users_cache';
  static Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>>? _inFlightUsersRequest;

  // JSONPlaceholder-compatible offline snapshot for first launch without a
  // connection. Successful API responses replace this with a full cache.
  static const List<Map<String, dynamic>> _offlineUsers = [
    {
      'id': 1,
      'name': 'Leanne Graham',
      'email': 'Sincere@april.biz',
      'phone': '1-770-736-8031 x56442',
      'address': {'city': 'Gwenborough'},
      'company': {'name': 'Romaguera-Crona'},
    },
    {
      'id': 2,
      'name': 'Ervin Howell',
      'email': 'Shanna@melissa.tv',
      'phone': '010-692-6593 x09125',
      'address': {'city': 'Wisokyburgh'},
      'company': {'name': 'Deckow-Crist'},
    },
    {
      'id': 3,
      'name': 'Clementine Bauch',
      'email': 'Nathan@yesenia.net',
      'phone': '1-463-123-4447',
      'address': {'city': 'McKenziehaven'},
      'company': {'name': 'Romaguera-Jacobson'},
    },
    {
      'id': 4,
      'name': 'Patricia Lebsack',
      'email': 'Julianne.OConner@kory.org',
      'phone': '493-170-9623 x156',
      'address': {'city': 'South Elvis'},
      'company': {'name': 'Robel-Corkery'},
    },
  ];

  static List<Map<String, dynamic>> get mockUsers =>
      _offlineUsers.map((user) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(user)).toList();

  static Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> fetchUsers() {
    final currentRequest = _inFlightUsersRequest;
    if (currentRequest != null) return currentRequest;

    final request = _loadUsers();
    _inFlightUsersRequest = request;
    return request.whenComplete(() {
      if (identical(_inFlightUsersRequest, request)) {
        _inFlightUsersRequest = null;
      }
    });
  }

  /// Allows a fresh read from the cache as soon as connectivity changes, even
  /// if a request that started while online is still waiting on a timeout.
  static void resetInFlightRequest() {
    _inFlightUsersRequest = null;
  }

  static Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> _loadUsers() async {
    try {
      final connectivity = await Connectivity().checkConnectivity();
      final hasNetwork = connectivity.any(
        (result) => result != ConnectivityResult.none,
      );
      if (!hasNetwork) return await _getCachedOrBundledUsers();

      final response = await http
          .get(
            Uri.https('jsonplaceholder.typicode.com', '/users'),
            headers: const {'Accept': 'application/json'},
          )
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 8));
      if (response.statusCode != 200) {
        throw Exception(
          'JSONPlaceholder returned HTTP ${response.statusCode}.',
        );
      }
      final users = _decodeUsers(response.body);
      if (users.isEmpty) {
        throw const FormatException('JSONPlaceholder returned no users.');
      }
      try {
        final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
        await preferences.setString(_usersCacheKey, jsonEncode(users));
      } catch (_) {
        // Keep the live response if local caching is unavailable.
      }
      return users;
    } catch (_) {
      return _getCachedOrBundledUsers();
    }
  }

  static Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> _getCachedOrBundledUsers() async {
    try {
      final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final cached = preferences.getString(_usersCacheKey);
      if (cached != null) {
        final users = _decodeUsers(cached);
        if (users.isNotEmpty) return users;
      }
    } catch (_) {
      // Use the bundled snapshot if preferences are unavailable.
    }
    return _offlineUsers
        .map((user) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(user))
        .toList();
  }

  static List<Map<String, dynamic>> _decodeUsers(String body) {
    final decoded = jsonDecode(body);
    if (decoded is! List) {
      throw const FormatException('JSONPlaceholder users response is invalid.');
    }
    return decoded
        .whereType<Map>()
        .map((item) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(item))
        .toList();
  }

  static Student toStudent(Map<String, dynamic> user, int index) {
    final id = (user['id'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? index + 1;
    final address = user['address'] is Map
        ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(user['address'] as Map)
        : <String, dynamic>{};
    const programs = ['BSIT-WM', 'BSIT-NS', 'BSCS-DS', 'BSCS-SE'];
    return Student(
      name: user['name'] as String? ?? 'Student $id',
      id: 'JP-${id.toString().padLeft(4, '0')}',
      email: user['email'] as String? ?? 'student$id@example.test',
      program: programs[(id - 1) % programs.length],
      yearLevel: '${(id - 1) % 4 + 1}${_ordinal((id - 1) % 4 + 1)} Year',
      contact: user['phone'] as String? ?? '',
      address: address['city'] as String? ?? '',
      attendance: 0.80 + ((id * 7) % 20) / 100,
    );
  }

  static String _ordinal(int number) {
    if (number == 1) return 'st';
    if (number == 2) return 'nd';
    if (number == 3) return 'rd';
    return 'th';
  }
}

==> week_5/lib/services/file_service.dart <==
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:path_provider/path_provider.dart';

import 'storage_service.dart';

class FileService {
  static const _fileName = 'student_info.txt';

  /// Required app Documents copy, accessible through Android Studio's
  /// Device File Explorer.
  static Future<Directory> _internalExportDirectory() async {
    final directory = await getApplicationDocumentsDirectory();
    await directory.create(recursive: true);
    return directory;
  }

  static Future<File> _writeAndVerify(String content) async {
    final directory = await _internalExportDirectory();
    final file = File('${directory.path}/$_fileName');
    await file.writeAsString(content, flush: true);
    if (!await file.exists() || await file.length() == 0) {
      throw FileSystemException(
        'Export file was not written successfully',
        file.path,
      );
    }
    if (await file.readAsString() != content) {
      throw FileSystemException('Export file verification failed', file.path);
    }
    return file;
  }

  static Future<String> _reportContents() async {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final timestamp =
        '${now.year}-${now.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${now.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')} '
        '${now.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:${now.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:${now.second.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';

    final students = await StorageService.getStudents();
    final records = students.isEmpty
        ? 'No student records.'
        : students
              .map(
                (student) => [
                  'Name: ${student.name}',
                  'ID: ${student.id}',
                  'Program: ${student.program}',
                  'Year: ${student.yearLevel}',
                  'Email: ${student.email}',
                  if (student.contact.isNotEmpty) 'Contact: ${student.contact}',
                  if (student.address.isNotEmpty) 'Address: ${student.address}',
                  'Status: ${student.status}',
                  'Attendance: ${(student.attendance * 100).round()}%',
                ].join('\n'),
              )
              .join('\n\n');

    return 'STUDENT INFORMATION\n'
        'Generated: $timestamp\n'
        'Student count: ${students.length}\n\n'
        '$records\n';
  }

  static Future<File> exportStudents() async {
    final content = await _reportContents();
    final file = await _writeAndVerify(content);
    try {
      await StorageService.recordActivity(
        'Student records exported',
        'Saved to app-private Documents storage',
      );
    } catch (_) {
      // A history-write failure does not invalidate the saved file.
    }
    return file;
  }

  static Future<File?> _existingExport() async {
    final directory = await _internalExportDirectory();
    final file = File('${directory.path}/$_fileName');
    return await file.exists() ? file : null;
  }

  static Future<String> readExportedFile() async {
    final file = await _existingExport();
    if (file == null) {
      return 'No exported file yet.\n\nTap Export Student Records to create one.';
    }
    return file.readAsString();
  }

  static Future<String> getFilePath() async {
    final directory = await _internalExportDirectory();
    return '${directory.path}/$_fileName';
  }
}

==> week_5/lib/services/public_holiday_service.dart <==
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

class PublicHoliday {
  const PublicHoliday({required this.date, required this.name});

  final DateTime date;
  final String name;

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {'date': _dateKey(date), 'name': name};

  factory PublicHoliday.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) => PublicHoliday(
    date: DateTime.parse(json['date'] as String),
    name: json['name'] as String? ?? 'Public holiday',
  );

  static String _dateKey(DateTime value) =>
      '${value.year.toString().padLeft(4, '0')}-'
      '${value.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-'
      '${value.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
}

class HolidayCalendarData {
  const HolidayCalendarData({
    required this.holidays,
    required this.isOffline,
    required this.year,
  });

  final List<PublicHoliday> holidays;
  final bool isOffline;
  final int year;
}

class PublicHolidayService {
  static String _cacheKey(int year) => 'nager_ph_holidays_$year';

  static Future<HolidayCalendarData> fetch({required int year}) async {
    final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    try {
      final response = await http
          .get(
            Uri.https('date.nager.at', '/api/v3/PublicHolidays/$year/PH'),
            headers: const {'Accept': 'application/json'},
          )
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 12));
      if (response.statusCode != 200) {
        throw Exception('Nager.Date returned HTTP ${response.statusCode}.');
      }

      final decoded = jsonDecode(response.body);
      if (decoded is! List) {
        throw const FormatException('Invalid Nager.Date response.');
      }
      final holidays =
          decoded
              .whereType<Map>()
              .map((entry) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(entry))
              .map((entry) {
                final date = DateTime.tryParse(entry['date'] as String? ?? '');
                final name =
                    entry['localName'] as String? ??
                    entry['name'] as String? ??
                    'Public holiday';
                if (date == null) return null;
                return PublicHoliday(
                  date: DateTime(date.year, date.month, date.day),
                  name: name,
                );
              })
              .whereType<PublicHoliday>()
              .toList()
            ..sort((first, second) => first.date.compareTo(second.date));

      await preferences.setString(
        _cacheKey(year),
        jsonEncode(holidays.map((holiday) => holiday.toJson()).toList()),
      );
      return HolidayCalendarData(
        holidays: holidays,
        isOffline: false,
        year: year,
      );
    } catch (_) {
      final cached = preferences.getString(_cacheKey(year));
      if (cached != null) {
        try {
          final decoded = jsonDecode(cached);
          if (decoded is List) {
            final holidays = decoded
                .whereType<Map>()
                .map(
                  (entry) =>
                      PublicHoliday.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic>.from(entry)),
                )
                .toList();
            return HolidayCalendarData(
              holidays: holidays,
              isOffline: true,
              year: year,
            );
          }
        } catch (_) {
          // An invalid cache is treated like an empty offline result.
        }
      }
      return HolidayCalendarData(
        holidays: const [],
        isOffline: true,
        year: year,
      );
    }
  }
}

==> week_5/lib/services/app_preferences.dart <==
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:math';
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:crypto/crypto.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

class AppPreferences extends ChangeNotifier {
  static const _darkModeKey = 'dark_mode';
  static const _mockDataKey = 'mock_data';
  static const _profilePhotoKey = 'profile_photo';
  static const _rememberMeKey = 'remember_me';
  static const _savedUserIdKey = 'saved_user_id';
  static const _savedPasswordKey = 'saved_password';
  static const _authAccountsKey = 'auth_accounts_v1';
  static const _activeSessionEmailKey = 'active_session_email';

  ThemeMode _themeMode = ThemeMode.light;
  bool _useMockData = false;
  bool _rememberMe = false;
  String _savedUserId = '';
  String _savedPassword = '';
  Map<String, dynamic> _authAccounts = {};
  String? _activeUserEmail;
  String? _activeUserName;
  String? _profilePhotoBase64;

  ThemeMode get themeMode => _themeMode;
  bool get isDarkMode => _themeMode == ThemeMode.dark;
  bool get useMockData => _useMockData;
  bool get rememberMe => _rememberMe;
  String get savedUserId => _savedUserId;
  String get savedPassword => _savedPassword;
  bool get hasActiveSession => _activeUserEmail != null;
  String? get activeUserEmail => _activeUserEmail;
  String? get activeUserName => _activeUserName;
  String? get profilePhotoBase64 => _profilePhotoBase64;

  Uint8List? get profilePhotoBytes {
    final encoded = _profilePhotoBase64;
    if (encoded == null) return null;
    try {
      return base64Decode(encoded);
    } on FormatException {
      return null;
    }
  }

  Future<void> load() async {
    final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final isDark = preferences.getBool(_darkModeKey) ?? false;
    _themeMode = isDark ? ThemeMode.dark : ThemeMode.light;
    _useMockData = preferences.getBool(_mockDataKey) ?? false;
    _rememberMe = preferences.getBool(_rememberMeKey) ?? false;
    _savedUserId = _rememberMe
        ? preferences.getString(_savedUserIdKey) ?? ''
        : '';
    _savedPassword = _rememberMe
        ? preferences.getString(_savedPasswordKey) ?? ''
        : '';
    final accountsJson = preferences.getString(_authAccountsKey);
    if (accountsJson != null) {
      try {
        final decoded = jsonDecode(accountsJson);
        if (decoded is Map) {
          _authAccounts = Map<String, dynamic>.from(decoded);
        }
      } on FormatException {
        _authAccounts = {};
      }
    }
    final sessionEmail = preferences.getString(_activeSessionEmailKey);
    final session = sessionEmail == null ? null : _authAccounts[sessionEmail];
    if (session is Map) {
      _activeUserEmail = sessionEmail;
      _activeUserName = session['name'] as String?;
    } else {
      await preferences.remove(_activeSessionEmailKey);
      _activeUserEmail = null;
      _activeUserName = null;
    }
    _profilePhotoBase64 = preferences.getString(_profilePhotoKey);
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> createLocalAccount({
    required String name,
    required String email,
    required String password,
  }) async {
    final cleanName = name.trim();
    final cleanEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (cleanName.isEmpty) {
      throw const FormatException('Full name is required.');
    }
    if (!_isInstitutionalEmail(cleanEmail)) {
      throw const FormatException('Use your @lpunetwork.edu.ph email.');
    }
    if (password.length < 8) {
      throw const FormatException(
        'Password must contain at least 8 characters.',
      );
    }
    if (_authAccounts.containsKey(cleanEmail)) {
      throw StateError('An account with this email already exists.');
    }

    final random = Random.secure();
    final salt = List.generate(
      16,
      (_) => random.nextInt(256),
    ).map((byte) => byte.toRadixString(16).padLeft(2, '0')).join();
    _authAccounts[cleanEmail] = {
      'name': cleanName,
      'salt': salt,
      'passwordHash': _passwordHash(salt, password),
    };
    await _persistAccountsAndSession(cleanEmail);
  }

  Future<void> authenticateLocalAccount({
    required String email,
    required String password,
  }) async {
    final cleanEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!_isInstitutionalEmail(cleanEmail)) {
      throw const FormatException('Use your @lpunetwork.edu.ph email.');
    }
    if (password.isEmpty) throw const FormatException('Password is required.');
    final account = _authAccounts[cleanEmail];
    if (account is! Map) {
      throw StateError(
        'No local account was found for this email. Sign up first.',
      );
    }
    final salt = account['salt'] as String? ?? '';
    final expected = account['passwordHash'] as String? ?? '';
    final actual = _passwordHash(salt, password);
    if (!_constantTimeEquals(expected, actual)) {
      throw StateError('The email or password is incorrect.');
    }
    await _persistAccountsAndSession(cleanEmail);
  }

  Future<void> logout() async {
    final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await preferences.remove(_activeSessionEmailKey);
    _activeUserEmail = null;
    _activeUserName = null;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  bool _isInstitutionalEmail(String email) => RegExp(
    r'^[^\s@]+@lpunetwork\.edu\.ph$',
    caseSensitive: false,
  ).hasMatch(email);

  String _passwordHash(String salt, String password) =>
      sha256.convert(utf8.encode('$salt:$password')).toString();

  bool _constantTimeEquals(String first, String second) {
    if (first.length != second.length) return false;
    var difference = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < first.length; i++) {
      difference |= first.codeUnitAt(i) ^ second.codeUnitAt(i);
    }
    return difference == 0;
  }

  Future<void> _persistAccountsAndSession(String email) async {
    final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final accountsSaved = await preferences.setString(
      _authAccountsKey,
      jsonEncode(_authAccounts),
    );
    final sessionSaved = await preferences.setString(
      _activeSessionEmailKey,
      email,
    );
    if (!accountsSaved || !sessionSaved) {
      throw StateError('The account session could not be saved locally.');
    }
    final account = _authAccounts[email] as Map;
    _activeUserEmail = email;
    _activeUserName = account['name'] as String?;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> setProfilePhoto(Uint8List? bytes) async {
    final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    if (bytes == null) {
      await preferences.remove(_profilePhotoKey);
      _profilePhotoBase64 = null;
    } else {
      final encoded = base64Encode(bytes);
      final saved = await preferences.setString(_profilePhotoKey, encoded);
      if (!saved) {
        throw StateError('The profile photo could not be saved locally.');
      }
      _profilePhotoBase64 = encoded;
    }
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> setDarkMode(bool enabled) async {
    final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await preferences.setBool(_darkModeKey, enabled);
    _themeMode = enabled ? ThemeMode.dark : ThemeMode.light;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> setRememberMe(
    bool enabled,
    String userId,
    String password,
  ) async {
    final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await preferences.setBool(_rememberMeKey, enabled);
    if (enabled && userId.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      await preferences.setString(_savedUserIdKey, userId.trim());
    } else {
      await preferences.remove(_savedUserIdKey);
      await preferences.remove(_savedPasswordKey);
    }
    if (enabled && userId.trim().isNotEmpty && password.isNotEmpty) {
      await preferences.setString(_savedPasswordKey, password);
    }
    _rememberMe = enabled;
    _savedUserId = enabled ? userId.trim() : '';
    _savedPassword = enabled ? password : '';
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> setUseMockData(bool enabled) async {
    _useMockData = enabled;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await preferences.setBool(_mockDataKey, enabled);
    } catch (error) {
      debugPrint('Could not persist mock data preference: $error');
    }
  }

  Future<void> clearLocalStorage() async {
    final preferences = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await preferences.clear();
    _themeMode = ThemeMode.light;
    _useMockData = false;
    _profilePhotoBase64 = null;
    _rememberMe = false;
    _savedUserId = '';
    _savedPassword = '';
    _authAccounts = {};
    _activeUserEmail = null;
    _activeUserName = null;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}
