import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'services/app_preferences.dart';
import 'theme/app_theme.dart';

class AuthPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const AuthPage({super.key, required this.preferences});

  final AppPreferences preferences;

  @override
  State<AuthPage> createState() => _AuthPageState();
}

class _AuthPageState extends State<AuthPage> {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final _nameController = TextEditingController();
  final _emailController = TextEditingController();
  final _passwordController = TextEditingController();
  final _confirmController = TextEditingController();
  bool _isSignup = false;
  bool _obscurePassword = true;
  bool _isLoading = false;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _nameController.dispose();
    _emailController.dispose();
    _passwordController.dispose();
    _confirmController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _switchMode(bool signup) {
    setState(() {
      _isSignup = signup;
      _formKey.currentState?.reset();
      _nameController.clear();
      _passwordController.clear();
      _confirmController.clear();
    });
  }

  String? _validateEmail(String? value) {
    final email = value?.trim() ?? '';
    if (email.isEmpty) return 'Institutional email is required.';
    if (!RegExp(
      r'^[^\s@]+@lpunetwork\.edu\.ph$',
      caseSensitive: false,
    ).hasMatch(email)) {
      return 'Use your @lpunetwork.edu.ph email.';
    }
    return null;
  }

  String? _validateName(String? value) {
    if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty) return 'Full name is required.';
    return null;
  }

  String? _validatePassword(String? value) {
    if (value == null || value.isEmpty) return 'Password is required.';
    if (_isSignup && value.length < 8) {
      return 'Use at least 8 characters.';
    }
    return null;
  }

  Future<void> _submit() async {
    final form = _formKey.currentState;
    if (form == null || !form.validate()) return;
    setState(() => _isLoading = true);
    try {
      if (_isSignup) {
        await widget.preferences.createLocalAccount(
          name: _nameController.text,
          email: _emailController.text,
          password: _passwordController.text,
        );
      } else {
        await widget.preferences.authenticateLocalAccount(
          email: _emailController.text,
          password: _passwordController.text,
        );
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      final message = error
          .toString()
          .replaceFirst('StateError: ', '')
          .replaceFirst('FormatException: ', '');
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
          .showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(message)));
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoading = false);
    }
  }

  Widget _requiredLabel(String label) => RichText(
    text: TextSpan(
      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.labelLarge,
      children: [
        TextSpan(text: label),
        const TextSpan(
          text: ' *',
          style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFFD32F2F)),
        ),
      ],
    ),
  );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
    body: SafeArea(
      child: Center(
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 24, 20, 28),
          child: ConstrainedBox(
            constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 364),
            child: AutofillGroup(
              child: Form(
                key: _formKey,
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: [
                    Image.asset(
                      'assets/img/lpu-logo.png',
                      width: 60,
                      height: 60,
                      errorBuilder: (_, _, _) => const Icon(
                        Icons.school_outlined,
                        size: 54,
                        color: AppTokens.maroonPrimary,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    Text(
                      _isSignup ? 'Create your account' : 'Welcome back',
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall
                          ?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    Text(
                      _isSignup
                          ? 'Sign up with your LPU-Cavite student email.'
                          : 'Log in to continue to your student portal.',
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                        color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 26),
                    if (_isSignup) ...[
                      _requiredLabel('Full name'),
                      const SizedBox(height: 6),
                      TextFormField(
                        controller: _nameController,
                        textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.words,
                        autofillHints: const [AutofillHints.name],
                        textInputAction: TextInputAction.next,
                        validator: _validateName,
                        decoration: const InputDecoration(
                          hintText: 'Enter your full name',
                          prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.person_outline),
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 15),
                    ],
                    _requiredLabel('Institutional email'),
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    TextFormField(
                      controller: _emailController,
                      keyboardType: TextInputType.emailAddress,
                      textInputAction: TextInputAction.next,
                      autofillHints: const [AutofillHints.username],
                      autocorrect: false,
                      validator: _validateEmail,
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(
                        hintText: 'name@lpunetwork.edu.ph',
                        prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.alternate_email),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 15),
                    _requiredLabel('Password'),
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    TextFormField(
                      controller: _passwordController,
                      obscureText: _obscurePassword,
                      textInputAction: _isSignup
                          ? TextInputAction.next
                          : TextInputAction.done,
                      autofillHints: [
                        _isSignup
                            ? AutofillHints.newPassword
                            : AutofillHints.password,
                      ],
                      autocorrect: false,
                      enableSuggestions: false,
                      validator: _validatePassword,
                      decoration: InputDecoration(
                        hintText: 'Enter your password',
                        prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.lock_outline),
                        suffixIcon: IconButton(
                          tooltip: _obscurePassword
                              ? 'Show password'
                              : 'Hide password',
                          onPressed: () => setState(
                            () => _obscurePassword = !_obscurePassword,
                          ),
                          icon: Icon(
                            _obscurePassword
                                ? Icons.visibility_outlined
                                : Icons.visibility_off_outlined,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (_isSignup) ...[
                      const SizedBox(height: 15),
                      _requiredLabel('Confirm password'),
                      const SizedBox(height: 6),
                      TextFormField(
                        controller: _confirmController,
                        obscureText: _obscurePassword,
                        autofillHints: const [AutofillHints.newPassword],
                        textInputAction: TextInputAction.done,
                        validator: (value) {
                          if (value == null || value.isEmpty) {
                            return 'Confirm password is required.';
                          }
                          if (value != _passwordController.text) {
                            return 'Passwords do not match.';
                          }
                          return null;
                        },
                        decoration: const InputDecoration(
                          hintText: 'Re-enter your password',
                          prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.lock_outline),
                        ),
                        onFieldSubmitted: (_) => _submit(),
                      ),
                    ] else ...[
                      const SizedBox(height: 8),
                      Align(
                        alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
                        child: Text(
                          'Local account sign-in',
                          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall
                              ?.copyWith(
                                color: Theme.of(context)
                                    .colorScheme
                                    .onSurfaceVariant,
                              ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                    const SizedBox(height: 22),
                    SizedBox(
                      height: 50,
                      child: FilledButton(
                        onPressed: _isLoading ? null : _submit,
                        child: _isLoading
                            ? const SizedBox.square(
                                dimension: 20,
                                child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                                  strokeWidth: 2,
                                  color: Colors.white,
                                ),
                              )
                            : Text(_isSignup ? 'Sign Up' : 'Log In'),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    Wrap(
                      alignment: WrapAlignment.center,
                      crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          _isSignup
                              ? 'Already have an account? '
                              : 'Don’t have an account? ',
                        ),
                        TextButton(
                          onPressed: () => _switchMode(!_isSignup),
                          child: Text(_isSignup ? 'Log in' : 'Sign up'),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    Text(
                      '* Required field',
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                        color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    ),
  );
}

==> week_5/lib/settings_page.dart <==
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:connectivity_plus/connectivity_plus.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:image_picker/image_picker.dart';

import 'registration_page.dart';
import 'services/app_preferences.dart';
import 'services/file_service.dart';
import 'services/storage_service.dart';
import 'theme/app_theme.dart';
import 'widgets/profile_avatar.dart';

class SettingsPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const SettingsPage({
    super.key,
    required this.preferences,
    required this.onRefreshCache,
    this.showAppBar = true,
  });

  final AppPreferences preferences;
  final Future<void> Function() onRefreshCache;
  final bool showAppBar;

  @override
  State<SettingsPage> createState() => _SettingsPageState();
}

class _SettingsPageState extends State<SettingsPage> {
  late Future<Student?> _profileFuture;
  bool _exporting = false;
  bool _clearing = false;
  bool _refreshing = false;
  bool _changingMockData = false;
  final ImagePicker _imagePicker = ImagePicker();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadProfile();
  }

  void _loadProfile() {
    _profileFuture = StorageService.getProfile();
  }

  Future<void> _exportStudents() async {
    setState(() => _exporting = true);
    try {
      await FileService.exportStudents();
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text(
            'File exported successfully to ${await FileService.getFilePath()}',
          ),
          duration: const Duration(seconds: 4),
          backgroundColor: AppTokens.maroonPrimary,
          action: SnackBarAction(
            label: 'OK',
            textColor: Colors.white,
            onPressed: () {},
          ),
        ),
      );
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
          .showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Export failed: $error')));
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _exporting = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _logOut() async {
    final confirmed = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Log out?'),
        content: const Text(
          'Your local account will remain saved on this device.',
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
            child: const Text('Cancel'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
            child: const Text('Log Out'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (confirmed == true) await widget.preferences.logout();
  }

  Future<void> _clearLocalStorage() async {
    final confirmed = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Clear local storage?'),
        content: const Text(
          'This permanently removes saved student records and app preferences '
          'from this device.',
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
            child: const Text('Cancel'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
            child: const Text('Clear data'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (confirmed != true) return;

    setState(() => _clearing = true);
    try {
      await widget.preferences.clearLocalStorage();
      await widget.onRefreshCache();
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(_loadProfile);
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(
        context,
      ).showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('Local storage cleared.')));
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text('Could not clear local storage: $error')),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _clearing = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _refreshCache() async {
    setState(() => _refreshing = true);
    try {
      await widget.onRefreshCache();
      await StorageService.recordActivity(
        'Dashboard data refreshed',
        'Manual refresh',
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(content: Text('Dashboard data refreshed.')),
      );
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text('Could not refresh dashboard data: $error')),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _refreshing = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _networkDiagnostics() async {
    final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
    try {
      final results = await Connectivity().checkConnectivity();
      final hasNetwork = results.any(
        (result) => result != ConnectivityResult.none,
      );
      if (!hasNetwork) {
        if (!mounted) return;
        await showDialog<void>(
          context: context,
          builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
            title: const Text('Network diagnostics'),
            content: const Text(
              'No network connection is available. Student and faculty data will use the last locally cached JSONPlaceholder records.',
            ),
            actions: [
              TextButton(
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                child: const Text('Done'),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        );
        return;
      }
      final response = await http
          .get(Uri.parse('https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users'))
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));
      if (!mounted) return;
      await showDialog<void>(
        context: context,
        builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
          title: const Text('Network diagnostics'),
          content: Text(
            'Network: ${results.map((result) => result.name).join(', ')}\n'
            'API check: HTTP ${response.statusCode}',
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
              child: const Text('Done'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      messenger.showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text('Network diagnostics failed: $error')),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _editProfile(Student? student) async {
    await Navigator.push<void>(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (_) =>
            RegistrationPage(student: student, isProfileEditor: true),
      ),
    );
    if (mounted) {
      setState(_loadProfile);
      await widget.onRefreshCache();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _editProfilePhoto() async {
    final source = await showModalBottomSheet<ImageSource>(
      context: context,
      showDragHandle: true,
      builder: (sheetContext) => SafeArea(
        child: Wrap(
          children: [
            ListTile(
              leading: const Icon(Icons.photo_library_outlined),
              title: const Text('Choose from photos'),
              onTap: () => Navigator.pop(sheetContext, ImageSource.gallery),
            ),
            ListTile(
              leading: const Icon(Icons.photo_camera_outlined),
              title: const Text('Take a photo'),
              onTap: () => Navigator.pop(sheetContext, ImageSource.camera),
            ),
            if (widget.preferences.profilePhotoBase64 != null)
              ListTile(
                leading: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline),
                title: const Text('Remove photo'),
                onTap: () async {
                  await _removeProfilePhoto();
                  if (sheetContext.mounted) Navigator.pop(sheetContext);
                },
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
    if (source == null) return;

    try {
      final photo = await _imagePicker.pickImage(
        source: source,
        maxWidth: 512,
        maxHeight: 512,
        imageQuality: 75,
      );
      if (photo == null) return;
      final Uint8List bytes = await photo.readAsBytes();
      await widget.preferences.setProfilePhoto(bytes);
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text('Could not update profile photo: $error')),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _removeProfilePhoto() async {
    try {
      await widget.preferences.setProfilePhoto(null);
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text('Could not remove profile photo: $error')),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _changeDarkMode(bool enabled) async {
    try {
      await widget.preferences.setDarkMode(enabled);
      await StorageService.recordActivity(
        enabled ? 'Dark mode enabled' : 'Dark mode disabled',
        'Display settings',
      );
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(
        context,
      ).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Could not update theme: $error')));
    }
  }

  Future<void> _changeMockData(bool enabled) async {
    if (_changingMockData || enabled == widget.preferences.useMockData) return;
    setState(() => _changingMockData = true);
    try {
      await widget.preferences.setUseMockData(enabled);
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text(
              enabled
                  ? 'Mock data enabled for Users and Faculty.'
                  : 'Live directory data restored.',
            ),
            duration: const Duration(seconds: 2),
          ),
        );
      }
      _recordMockDataActivity(enabled);
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text('Could not update data mode: $error')),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _changingMockData = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _recordMockDataActivity(bool enabled) async {
    try {
      await StorageService.recordActivity(
        enabled ? 'Mock data enabled' : 'Mock data disabled',
        enabled
            ? 'Using JSONPlaceholder directory data'
            : 'Using saved portal data',
      );
    } catch (error) {
      debugPrint('Could not record mock data activity: $error');
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: widget.preferences,
      builder: (context, child) {
        final content = ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
          children: [
            const Text(
              'Settings',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 26, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            FutureBuilder<Student?>(
              future: _profileFuture,
              builder: (context, snapshot) {
                if (snapshot.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting) {
                  return const Card(
                    child: Padding(
                      padding: EdgeInsets.all(20),
                      child: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
                    ),
                  );
                }
                if (snapshot.hasError) {
                  return Card(
                    child: ListTile(
                      title: const Text('Unable to load profile'),
                      subtitle: Text('${snapshot.error}'),
                      trailing: IconButton(
                        tooltip: 'Retry',
                        onPressed: () => setState(_loadProfile),
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                }
                final student = snapshot.data;
                final name = student?.name ?? 'Novy Chariz Tablac';
                final nameParts = name
                    .trim()
                    .split(RegExp(r'\s+'))
                    .where((part) => part.isNotEmpty)
                    .toList();
                final initials = nameParts.isEmpty
                    ? 'NT'
                    : nameParts.length > 1
                    ? '${nameParts.first[0]}${nameParts.last[0]}'.toUpperCase()
                    : nameParts.first[0].toUpperCase();

                return Card(
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                    child: Row(
                      children: [
                        ProfileAvatar(
                          bytes: widget.preferences.profilePhotoBytes,
                          initials: initials,
                          radius: 30,
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 14),
                        Expanded(
                          child: Column(
                            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                            children: [
                              Text(
                                name,
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                  fontSize: 16,
                                ),
                              ),
                              Text(
                                student?.id ?? '2023-1-00123',
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  color: Theme.of(context)
                                      .colorScheme
                                      .onSurfaceVariant,
                                ),
                              ),
                              Text(
                                student?.program ?? 'BSIT-WM',
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  color: Theme.of(context)
                                      .colorScheme
                                      .secondary,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                ),
                              ),
                              Text(
                                student?.email ?? 'novy.tablac@lpu.edu.ph',
                                maxLines: 1,
                                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  color: Theme.of(context)
                                      .colorScheme
                                      .onSurfaceVariant,
                                  fontSize: 12,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                        PopupMenuButton<String>(
                          tooltip: 'Edit profile',
                          onSelected: (action) {
                            if (action == 'photo') _editProfilePhoto();
                            if (action == 'details') _editProfile(student);
                          },
                          itemBuilder: (context) => const [
                            PopupMenuItem(
                              value: 'photo',
                              child: Text('Edit profile photo'),
                            ),
                            PopupMenuItem(
                              value: 'details',
                              child: Text('Edit account details'),
                            ),
                          ],
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.edit_outlined),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                );
              },
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 20),
            _sectionTitle('App & Data'),
            Card(
              child: Column(
                children: [
                  ListTile(
                    leading: const Icon(Icons.logout),
                    title: const Text('Log Out'),
                    subtitle: Text(
                      widget.preferences.activeUserEmail ?? 'End this session',
                    ),
                    onTap: _logOut,
                  ),
                  const Divider(height: 1, indent: 16, endIndent: 16),
                  ListTile(
                    leading: const Icon(Icons.file_download_outlined),
                    title: const Text('Export Student Records to File'),
                    subtitle: const Text(
                      'Save a plain-text file on this device',
                    ),
                    trailing: _exporting
                        ? const SizedBox(
                            width: 20,
                            height: 20,
                            child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
                          )
                        : const Icon(Icons.chevron_right),
                    onTap: _exporting ? null : _exportStudents,
                  ),
                  const Divider(height: 1, indent: 16, endIndent: 16),
                  SwitchListTile(
                    secondary: const Icon(Icons.dark_mode_outlined),
                    title: const Text('Dark mode'),
                    value: widget.preferences.themeMode == ThemeMode.dark,
                    onChanged: _changeDarkMode,
                  ),
                  const Divider(height: 1, indent: 16, endIndent: 16),
                  ListTile(
                    leading: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline),
                    title: const Text('Clear Local Storage'),
                    subtitle: const Text(
                      'Remove saved records and preferences',
                    ),
                    trailing: _clearing
                        ? const SizedBox(
                            width: 20,
                            height: 20,
                            child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),

                        : const Icon(Icons.chevron_right),

                            height: 20,

                    trailing: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right),
                    onTap: _networkDiagnostics,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        );
        if (!widget.showAppBar) return content;
        return Scaffold(
          appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Settings')),
          body: content,
        );
      },

  Widget _sectionTitle(String title) => Padding(

==> week_5/lib/widgets/student_card.dart <==
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../services/storage_service.dart';

class StudentCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const StudentCard({
    super.key,
    required this.student,
    this.onTap,
    this.onDelete,
  });

  final Student student;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;
  final VoidCallback? onDelete;

  String _getInitials(String name) {
    final parts = name
        .trim()
        .split(RegExp(r'\s+'))
        .where((part) => part.isNotEmpty)
        .toList();
    if (parts.isEmpty) return 'S';
    if (parts.length == 1) return parts.first[0].toUpperCase();
    return parts.first[0].toUpperCase();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final bool isActive =
        student.status.toLowerCase() != 'inactive' &&
        student.status.toLowerCase() != 'warning';
    final int attendancePercent = (student.attendance * 100).round();

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: theme.cardColor,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(color: theme.dividerColor),
        boxShadow: isDark
            ? null
            : [
                BoxShadow(
                  color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.03),
                  blurRadius: 4,
                  offset: const Offset(0, 2),
                ),
              ],
      ),
      child: Material(
        color: Colors.transparent,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        child: InkWell(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          onTap: onTap,
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Row(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    CircleAvatar(
                      radius: 20,
                      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF800000),
                      child: Text(
                        _getInitials(student.name),
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          color: Colors.white,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          fontSize: 16,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 10),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          Text(
                            student.name,
                            maxLines: 1,
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 15,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 2),
                          Text(
                            '${student.id} • ${student.course} • Grade ${student.grade.toStringAsFixed(1)}',
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 11,
                              color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 4),
                          Row(
                            children: [
                              Icon(
                                Icons.email_outlined,
                                size: 12,
                                color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(width: 4),
                              Expanded(
                                child: Text(
                                  student.email,
                                  maxLines: 1,
                                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 11,
                                    color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                          if (student.contact.isNotEmpty) ...[
                            const SizedBox(height: 2),
                            Row(
                              children: [
                                Icon(
                                  Icons.phone_outlined,
                                  size: 12,
                                  color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                                ),
                                const SizedBox(width: 4),
                                Text(
                                  student.contact,
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 11,
                                    color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ],
                            ),
                          ],
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                        horizontal: 8,
                        vertical: 3,
                      ),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: isDark
                            ? (isActive
                                  ? const Color(0xFF24382A)
                                  : const Color(0xFF40272A))
                            : (isActive
                                  ? const Color(0xFFE8F5E9)
                                  : const Color(0xFFFFEBEE)),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                      ),
                      child: Text(
                        isActive ? 'Active' : 'Inactive',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 10,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                          color: isActive
                              ? (isDark
                                    ? const Color(0xFFE0B0B0)
                                    : const Color(0xFF2E7D32))
                              : (isDark
                                    ? const Color(0xFFD88A8A)
                                    : const Color(0xFFC62828)),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (onDelete != null)
                      IconButton(
                        tooltip: 'Delete student',
                        onPressed: onDelete,
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline),
                        color: theme.colorScheme.error,
                        visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Expanded(
                      child: ClipRRect(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                        child: LinearProgressIndicator(
                          value: student.attendance.clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble(),
                          minHeight: 5,
                          backgroundColor: theme.dividerColor,
                          valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(
                            isActive
                                ? (isDark
                                      ? const Color(0xFFE0B0B0)
                                      : const Color(0xFF2E7D32))
                                : (isDark
                                      ? const Color(0xFFD88A8A)
                                      : const Color(0xFFC62828)),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 10),
                    Text(
                      '$attendancePercent%',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 11,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class QuickActionButton extends StatelessWidget {
  const QuickActionButton({
    super.key,
    required this.label,
    required this.icon,
    required this.onTap,
    this.iconColor = const Color(0xFF800000),
    this.statusDotColor,
    this.statusText,
  });

  final String label;
  final IconData icon;
  final VoidCallback onTap;
  final Color iconColor;
  final Color? statusDotColor;
  final String? statusText;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: theme.cardColor,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(color: theme.dividerColor),
        boxShadow: isDark
            ? null
            : [
                BoxShadow(
                  color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.02),
                  blurRadius: 3,
                  offset: const Offset(0, 1),
                ),
              ],
      ),
      child: Material(
        color: Colors.transparent,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        child: InkWell(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          onTap: onTap,
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8, horizontal: 6),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
              children: [
                Stack(
                  clipBehavior: Clip.none,
                  children: [
                    Icon(
                      icon,
                      color: isDark ? const Color(0xFFE0B0B0) : iconColor,
                      size: 24,
                    ),
                    if (statusDotColor != null)
                      Positioned(
                        right: -3,
                        top: -2,
                        child: Container(
                          width: 8,
                          height: 8,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: statusDotColor,
                            shape: BoxShape.circle,
                            border: Border.all(
                              color: theme.cardColor,
                              width: 1.5,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                Text(
                  label,
                  maxLines: 2,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 11.5,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                    color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                  ),
                ),
                if (statusText != null) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 1),
                  Text(
                    statusText!,
                    maxLines: 2,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 8.5,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                      color: statusDotColor ?? Colors.grey.shade600,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class KpiCard extends StatelessWidget {

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class CcsProgramData {
  final String code;
  final String name;
  final int count;
  final IconData icon;
  final Color iconColor;
  final Color iconBackgroundColor;
  final String statusText;

  const CcsProgramData({
    required this.code,
    required this.name,
    required this.count,
    required this.icon,
    required this.iconColor,
    required this.iconBackgroundColor,
    this.statusText = 'Actively Enrolled',
  });
}

class CcsProgramStatsGridWidget extends StatelessWidget {
  const CcsProgramStatsGridWidget({
    super.key,
    this.programs = defaultPrograms,
    this.onProgramSelected,
  });

  final List<CcsProgramData> programs;
  final ValueChanged<String>? onProgramSelected;

  static const List<CcsProgramData> defaultPrograms = [
    CcsProgramData(
      code: 'BSCS-DS',
      name: 'Data Science',
      count: 100,
      icon: Icons.storage_rounded,
      iconColor: Color(0xFFE85D04),
      iconBackgroundColor: Color(0xFFFFEEE5),
    ),
    CcsProgramData(
      code: 'BSCS-SE',
      name: 'Software Engineering',
      count: 90,
      icon: Icons.code_rounded,
      iconColor: Color(0xFF2563EB),
      iconBackgroundColor: Color(0xFFEAF0FF),
    ),
    CcsProgramData(
      code: 'BSIT-NS',
      name: 'Network & Security',
      count: 120,
      icon: Icons.shield_outlined,
      iconColor: Color(0xFF0096C7),
      iconBackgroundColor: Color(0xFFE5F7FC),
    ),
    CcsProgramData(
      code: 'BSIT-WM',
      name: 'Web & Mobile Development',
      count: 150,
      icon: Icons.public_rounded,
      iconColor: Color(0xFF7B2CBF),
      iconBackgroundColor: Color(0xFFF3EAFE),
    ),
  ];

  Widget _buildCard(BuildContext context, CcsProgramData program) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final cardColor = isDark ? const Color(0xFF262626) : Colors.white;
    final textColor = isDark
        ? const Color(0xFFFAFDEA)
        : const Color(0xFF171717);
    final secondaryTextColor = Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant;
    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: cardColor,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(color: Theme.of(context).dividerColor),
        boxShadow: isDark
            ? null
            : [
                BoxShadow(
                  color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.03),
                  blurRadius: 4,
                  offset: const Offset(0, 2),
                ),
              ],
      ),
      child: Material(
        color: Colors.transparent,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        child: InkWell(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          onTap: () => onProgramSelected?.call(program.code),
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
              children: [
                Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      program.code,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 14,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        color: textColor,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 2),
                    Text(
                      program.name,
                      maxLines: 2,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 9,
                        color: secondaryTextColor,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                Row(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
                  children: [
                    Container(
                      width: 44,
                      height: 44,
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: isDark
                            ? const Color(0xFF333333)
                            : program.iconBackgroundColor,
                        shape: BoxShape.circle,
                      ),
                      child: Icon(
                        program.icon,
                        color: isDark
                            ? const Color(0xFFE0B0B0)
                            : program.iconColor,
                        size: 24,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 10),
                    Expanded(
                      child: FittedBox(
                        alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                        fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
                        child: Text(
                          '${program.count}',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 26,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                            color: textColor,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 6),
                Text(
                  program.statusText,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 10,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                    color: secondaryTextColor,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Text(
          'CCS Programmes',
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: 16,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
            color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurface,
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        LayoutBuilder(
          builder: (context, constraints) => GridView.builder(
            shrinkWrap: true,
            physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
            itemCount: programs.length,
            gridDelegate: SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
              crossAxisCount: 2,
              crossAxisSpacing: 12,
              mainAxisSpacing: 12,
              mainAxisExtent: constraints.maxWidth < 360 ? 156 : 148,
            ),
            itemBuilder: (context, index) =>
                _buildCard(context, programs[index]),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

==> week_5/lib/widgets/faculty_card.dart <==
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class FacultyCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const FacultyCard({
    super.key,
    required this.name,
    required this.department,
    required this.email,
    required this.phone,
    this.initials,
    this.onEmailTap,
    this.onCallTap,
  });

  final String name;
  final String department;
  final String email;
  final String phone;
  final String? initials;
  final VoidCallback? onEmailTap;
  final VoidCallback? onCallTap;

  String _deriveInitials() {
    if (initials != null && initials!.isNotEmpty) return initials!;
    // Strip prefixes like Dr., Prof.
    final clean = name.replaceAll(
      RegExp(r'^(Dr\.|Prof\.|Mr\.|Ms\.|Mrs\.)\s*'),
      '',
    );
    final parts = clean.trim().split(RegExp(r'\s+'));
    if (parts.isEmpty) return 'F';
    return parts.first[0].toUpperCase();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    const maroonColor = Color(0xFF800000);
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: theme.cardColor,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(color: theme.dividerColor),
        boxShadow: isDark
            ? null
            : [
                BoxShadow(
                  color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.03),
                  blurRadius: 4,
                  offset: const Offset(0, 2),
                ),
              ],
      ),
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Row(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                CircleAvatar(
                  radius: 20,
                  backgroundColor: maroonColor,
                  child: Text(
                    _deriveInitials(),
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      color: Colors.white,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      fontSize: 16,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        name,
                        maxLines: 1,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 15,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 2),
                      Text(
                        department,
                        maxLines: 2,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 11,
                          color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 4),
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          Icon(
                            Icons.email_outlined,
                            size: 12,
                            color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 4),
                          Expanded(
                            child: Text(
                              email,
                              maxLines: 1,
                              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 11,
                                color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 2),
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          Icon(
                            Icons.phone_outlined,
                            size: 12,
                            color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 4),
                          Text(
                            phone,
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 11,
                              color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: SizedBox(
                    height: 32,
                    child: ElevatedButton.icon(
                      style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: maroonColor,
                        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                        elevation: 0,
                        padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                        ),
                      ),
                      onPressed: onEmailTap,
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.email_outlined, size: 14),
                      label: const Text(
                        'Email',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 12,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                Expanded(
                  child: SizedBox(
                    height: 32,
                    child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                      style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                        foregroundColor: isDark
                            ? const Color(0xFFE0B0B0)
                            : maroonColor,
                        side: BorderSide(
                          color: isDark ? const Color(0xFFE0B0B0) : maroonColor,
                        ),
                        padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                        ),
                      ),
                      onPressed: onCallTap,
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.phone_outlined, size: 14),
                      label: const Text(
                        'Call',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 12,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

==> week_5/lib/widgets/profile_avatar.dart <==
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class ProfileAvatar extends StatelessWidget {
  const ProfileAvatar({
    super.key,
    required this.bytes,
    required this.initials,
    this.radius = 22,
    this.backgroundColor = const Color(0xFF800000),
    this.foregroundColor = Colors.white,
  });

  final Uint8List? bytes;
  final String initials;
  final double radius;
  final Color backgroundColor;
  final Color foregroundColor;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final image = bytes;
    return CircleAvatar(
      radius: radius,
      backgroundColor: backgroundColor,
      child: image == null
          ? Text(
              initials.isEmpty ? 'NT' : initials,
              style: TextStyle(
                color: foregroundColor,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
              ),
            )
          : ClipOval(
              child: Image.memory(
                image,
                width: radius * 2,
                height: radius * 2,
                fit: BoxFit.cover,
                errorBuilder: (context, error, stackTrace) => Center(
                  child: Text(
                    initials.isEmpty ? 'NT' : initials,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: foregroundColor,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
    );
  }
}

==> week_5/lib/widgets/student_kpi_row_widget.dart <==
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class StudentKpiRowWidget extends StatelessWidget {
  const StudentKpiRowWidget({
    super.key,
    this.totalStudents = 0,
    this.activeStudents = 0,
    this.avgAttendance = '0%',
  });

  final int totalStudents;
  final int activeStudents;
  final String avgAttendance;

  Widget _statCard(
    BuildContext context, {
    required String title,
    required String value,
  }) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    return SizedBox(
      height: 92,
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 10),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: theme.cardColor,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          border: Border.all(color: theme.dividerColor),
        ),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            SizedBox(
              height: 26,
              child: Align(
                alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                child: Text(
                  title,
                  maxLines: 2,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 10,
                    height: 1.15,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                    color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            Row(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: FittedBox(
                    fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
                    alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                    child: Text(
                      value,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 27,
                        height: 1,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                        color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, constraints) {
        const columns = 3;
        final gap = 8.0;
        final width = (constraints.maxWidth - gap * (columns - 1)) / columns;
        return Wrap(
          spacing: gap,
          runSpacing: gap,
          children: [
            SizedBox(
              width: width,
              child: _statCard(
                context,
                title: 'Total students',
                value: '$totalStudents',
              ),
            ),
            SizedBox(
              width: width,
              child: _statCard(
                context,
                title: 'Active students',
                value: '$activeStudents',
              ),
            ),
            SizedBox(
              width: width,
              child: _statCard(
                context,
                title: 'Avg. attendance',
                value: avgAttendance,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

class SwipeableWeekCalendarWidget extends StatefulWidget {
  const SwipeableWeekCalendarWidget({
    super.key,
    required this.selectedDate,
    required this.onDateSelected,
    this.eventText = 'No upcoming events.',
    this.holidays = const [],
    this.holidaysOffline = false,
  });

  final DateTime selectedDate;
  final ValueChanged<DateTime> onDateSelected;
  final String eventText;
  final List<PublicHoliday> holidays;
  final bool holidaysOffline;

  static const Color maroonColor = Color(0xFF800000);

  @override
  State<SwipeableWeekCalendarWidget> createState() =>
      _SwipeableWeekCalendarWidgetState();
}

class _SwipeableWeekCalendarWidgetState
    extends State<SwipeableWeekCalendarWidget> {
  static const int _initialPage = 5000;
  late final PageController _pageController;
  late DateTime _referenceMonday;
  late DateTime _currentDisplayedMonth;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    // Anchor reference Monday to the Monday of widget.selectedDate
    _referenceMonday = _findMonday(widget.selectedDate);
    _currentDisplayedMonth = widget.selectedDate;
    _pageController = PageController(initialPage: _initialPage);
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant SwipeableWeekCalendarWidget oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.selectedDate != widget.selectedDate) {
      _currentDisplayedMonth = widget.selectedDate;
      final newMonday = _findMonday(widget.selectedDate);
      final differenceInDays = newMonday.difference(_referenceMonday).inDays;
      final targetPage = _initialPage + (differenceInDays / 7).round();
      if (_pageController.hasClients &&
          _pageController.page?.round() != targetPage) {
        _pageController.jumpToPage(targetPage);
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _pageController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  DateTime _findMonday(DateTime date) {
    return DateTime(
      date.year,
      date.month,
      date.day,
    ).subtract(Duration(days: date.weekday - 1));
  }

  DateTime _getMondayForPage(int page) {
    final weekOffset = page - _initialPage;
    return _referenceMonday.add(Duration(days: weekOffset * 7));
  }

  String _monthName(int month) {
    const months = [
      'January',
      'February',
      'March',
      'April',
      'May',
      'June',
      'July',
      'August',
      'September',
      'October',
      'November',
      'December',
    ];
    return months[month - 1];
  }

  String _weekdayAbbreviation(int weekday) {
    const weekdays = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thur', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'];
    return weekdays[weekday - 1];
  }

  Future<void> _openMonthYearPicker() async {
    final picked = await showDatePicker(
      context: context,
      initialDate: widget.selectedDate,
      firstDate: DateTime(2020),
      lastDate: DateTime(2035),
      builder: (context, child) {
        final appTheme = Theme.of(context);
        final isDark = appTheme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
        return Theme(
          data: appTheme.copyWith(
            colorScheme: appTheme.colorScheme.copyWith(
              primary: isDark
                  ? const Color(0xFFE0B0B0)
                  : SwipeableWeekCalendarWidget.maroonColor,
              onPrimary: isDark ? const Color(0xFF171717) : Colors.white,
              onSurface: appTheme.colorScheme.onSurface,
            ),
          ),
          child: child ?? const SizedBox(),
        );
      },
    );

    if (picked != null) {
      widget.onDateSelected(picked);
      final targetMonday = _findMonday(picked);
      final offset = (targetMonday.difference(_referenceMonday).inDays / 7)
          .round();
      final targetPage = _initialPage + offset;
      if (_pageController.hasClients) {
        _pageController.animateToPage(
          targetPage,
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
          curve: Curves.easeInOut,
        );
      }
      setState(() {
        _currentDisplayedMonth = picked;
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final displayedTitle =
        '${_monthName(_currentDisplayedMonth.month)} ${_currentDisplayedMonth.year}';

    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: theme.cardColor,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        border: Border.all(color: theme.dividerColor),
        boxShadow: isDark
            ? null
            : [
                BoxShadow(
                  color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.03),
                  blurRadius: 4,
                  offset: const Offset(0, 2),
                ),
              ],
      ),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          // Month/Year Picker Button Header
          InkWell(
            onTap: _openMonthYearPicker,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 2, horizontal: 2),
              child: Row(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    displayedTitle,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 14,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 4),
                  Icon(
                    Icons.chevron_right,
                    size: 18,
                    color: isDark
                        ? const Color(0xFFE0B0B0)
                        : const Color(0xFF800000),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          // Swipeable Week View (PageView)
          SizedBox(
            height: 64,
            child: PageView.builder(
              controller: _pageController,
              onPageChanged: (page) {
                final monday = _getMondayForPage(page);
                final nextSelectedDate = monday.add(
                  Duration(days: widget.selectedDate.weekday - 1),
                );
                setState(() {
                  _currentDisplayedMonth = nextSelectedDate;
                });
                widget.onDateSelected(nextSelectedDate);
              },
              itemBuilder: (context, page) {
                final monday = _getMondayForPage(page);
                final days = List.generate(
                  7,
                  (i) => monday.add(Duration(days: i)),
                );

                return Row(
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                  children: days.map((day) {
                    final hasHoliday = widget.holidays.any(
                      (holiday) => DateUtils.isSameDay(holiday.date, day),
                    );
                    final isSelected =
                        day.year == widget.selectedDate.year &&
                        day.month == widget.selectedDate.month &&
                        day.day == widget.selectedDate.day;

                    return GestureDetector(
                      onTap: () {
                        widget.onDateSelected(day);
                      },
                      behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                      child: Column(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        children: [
                          Text(
                            _weekdayAbbreviation(day.weekday),
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 10,
                              color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 6),
                          Container(
                            width: 28,
                            height: 28,
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: isSelected
                                  ? (isDark
                                        ? const Color(0xFFE0B0B0)
                                        : SwipeableWeekCalendarWidget
                                              .maroonColor)
                                  : Colors.transparent,
                              shape: BoxShape.circle,
                            ),
                            alignment: Alignment.center,
                            child: Text(
                              '${day.day}',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 12,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                color: isSelected
                                    ? (isDark
                                          ? const Color(0xFF171717)
                                          : Colors.white)
                                    : theme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 3),
                          Container(
                            width: 4,
                            height: 4,
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: hasHoliday
                                  ? (isSelected
                                        ? theme.colorScheme.onPrimary
                                        : SwipeableWeekCalendarWidget
                                              .maroonColor)
                                  : Colors.transparent,
                              shape: BoxShape.circle,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    );
                  }).toList(),
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          const Divider(height: 1),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          _buildSelectedDateEvents(theme),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSelectedDateEvents(ThemeData theme) {
    final selectedHolidays = widget.holidays
        .where(
          (holiday) => DateUtils.isSameDay(holiday.date, widget.selectedDate),
        )
        .toList();
    if (selectedHolidays.isNotEmpty) {
      return Wrap(
        spacing: 6,
        runSpacing: 4,
        children: selectedHolidays
            .map(
              (holiday) => Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 5),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: const Color(0xFFF9EAEA),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                ),
                child: Row(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    const Icon(
                      Icons.celebration_outlined,
                      size: 14,
                      color: SwipeableWeekCalendarWidget.maroonColor,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 5),
                    Flexible(
                      child: Text(
                        holiday.name,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 11,
                          color: SwipeableWeekCalendarWidget.maroonColor,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            )
            .toList(),
      );
    }

    final message = widget.holidaysOffline
        ? widget.holidays.isEmpty
              ? 'Holiday dates are unavailable offline. Reconnect to sync.'
              : 'Offline · Showing saved Nager.Date holidays.'
        : widget.eventText;
    return Text(
      message,
      style: TextStyle(
        fontSize: 11,
        color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

  testWidgets('App loads Home Overview, switches tabs to Users and Faculty', (
    tester,
  ) async {
    final preferences = AppPreferences();
    await preferences.load();
    await preferences.setUseMockData(true);

    await tester.pumpWidget(LpuStudentApp(preferences: preferences));
    await tester.pump(const Duration(milliseconds: 200));

    // Verify Home tab elements
    expect(find.text('LPU-Cavite Student Dashboard'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('Novy Chariz Tablac'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('Overview'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('Quick Actions'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('World Clock'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('Academic Calendar'), findsOneWidget);

    // Verify correct student email
    expect(find.text('Email: 2024-2-02204@lpunetwork.edu.ph'), findsOneWidget);

    // Switch to Users tab
    await tester.tap(find.text('Users'));
    await tester.pump(const Duration(milliseconds: 200));

    expect(find.text('Students'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('Program Stats'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('Total Students'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('Active Students'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('Avg. Attendance'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('+4%'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('Student List'), findsOneWidget);

    // Switch to Program Stats toggle
    await tester.tap(find.text('Program Stats'));
    await tester.pump(const Duration(milliseconds: 200));

    expect(find.text('CCS Programmes'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('BSCS-DS'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('BSCS-SE'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('BSIT-NS'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('BSIT-WM'), findsOneWidget);

    // Switch to Faculty tab
    await tester.tap(find.text('Faculty'));
    await tester.pump(const Duration(milliseconds: 200));

    expect(find.text('Dr. Jane Doe'), findsWidgets);
    expect(find.text('Email'), findsWidgets);
    expect(find.text('Call'), findsWidgets);

    // Switch to Settings tab
    await tester.tap(find.text('Settings'));
    await tester.pump(const Duration(milliseconds: 200));

    expect(find.text('Settings'), findsWidgets);

    // Tear down to cancel periodic timer
    await tester.pumpWidget(const SizedBox());
    await tester.pump(const Duration(milliseconds: 100));
  });
